*Assalamu'alaikum fans we're back again da yardan Allah, Allah yasa ku SHAK'U da wannan labarin ma kaman yanda kuka SHAK'U da Hajiya Fad'ime ikon Allah Lol....  Allah shi bamu ikon rubuta khairan.. Ameen!*




Mari ya kuma kwasheta dashi a karo na babu adadi, lokaci guda ya kuma mak'uro wuyanta yana huci tamkar zaki....  Tuna tana kuka mai sauti har ya koma maras sauti sai zallan hawaye.

Dukda k'ak'arin da take hakan baisa ya saketa daga mak'urin da yayi mata ba....  Da k'arfin gaske yayi wurgi da ita da bugu da k'arfen bagrag dake gefe a cikin d'akin..... 

Cikin karaji yaci gaba da nunata da belt d'in hannunsa  yana fad'in "Be careful, I'm warning you duk ranar da kika kuma tuhumata a ina na kwana kinji na rantse sai na maki wulak'ancin da yafi na yau,  useless kawai... Ke wacece? Who the hell you think you are da har zaki tsareni da tambayan yanda na kwana...?  Ko ce maki akayi ni d'in d'anki Fawaz ne huh..?"

Yayi wata murmushi kafin yaci gaba da fad'in "Lallai Saudat kin sami kanki har ni kike tuhuma saikace kin mance wanene ni, yaci ace kin saba dani da halina tunda tun ina matashi d'an shekara 18 nake aurenki, kinga ak'alla yau kusan shekaru 25 muna tare..  Kar ki mance baduk'un mahaifinki sabida kud'in mahaifina ya lik'a min ke tun banida wayo tun bansan wanene ni ba ballantana na gane abu mai kyau da maras kyau..."

Takowa yayi har gabanta yanda take durk'ushe tana cazgan kuka wanda idan da sabo yabi jikinta dukda ba'a sabo da wahala....  Hannu yasa ya damk'o sumarta had'i da d'ago fuskarta kafin ya soma fad'in "Barikiji na fad'a maki bin matan banza wllhi yanzu na soma bazan daina ba koda zamu had'a nema da Fawaz,  sannan aurosu ne bazanyi ba, tunda nasan aurosu na nufin kwanciyar hankalin ki ne,  ni kuma sam kwanciyar hankalinki ne banaso,  kinsan inada mak'udan kud'ad'en da duk yanda naje zan sami mace irin wacce nake so ba irinki ba zabiyar banza da wofi...." Ya k'arashe yana mai ciro wasu pills a cikin aljihunsa....  Matse bakinta yayi yana danna mata pills d'in yake fad'in "Ki sha maganin nan tun kafin ranki ya b'aci.."

Wani irin kuka take tana girigza kai alamun bata so hakan bai hanasa danna mata su cikin bakinta ba,  haka dolen maganin suka wuce mak'ogoron ta babu ko ruwa dukda girman magungunan..... 

Yana gama tura mata su ya fashe da wata kafiran dariya shi kad'ai tamkar tab'ebb'e.....

INNAH ta dubesa a karo na biyu kafin ta tunsture da dariya tana mai ajjiye karan sigarin dake hannunta saman 'yar wata k'aramar plate dake bisa center table d'in... 

"Kayi min dai-dai Kabiru,  kar ka fasa d'irka ma tsinanniya maganin mahaukata har sai ta zama cikakkiyar mahaukaciya,  muddin tanada hankali tofah sam bazamu cimma burinmu akan NASIR ba,  a koda yaushe nayi yunk'urin kawar dashi shegiyar yarinyar nan Saudatu tana wuce min gaba....  Tunda kuwa tace fad'a dani ta d'auko aiko kaga ta d'au Dala babu gamo..."

Alh Kabir magidanci d'an shekaru 45 ya dubi mahaifiyar tasa wacce ak'alla bazata gaza shekaru sittin a duniya ba kafin yace "Wato Innah nasha fad'a maki wllhi akanki akan farin cikin ki babu abinda bazan yi ba tunda har na kawar da Sa'oud Santana a doron k'as....."   Bai kai aya ba Innah ta danne bakinsa ta rufe kafin taci gaba da fad'in "Koda wasa baniso na kuma jin ka furta kalami irin haka koda a keb'antaccen waje muke....."

Kallon juna sukayi ido cikin ido kafin suka kuma fashewa da wata kafiran dariya...... 


**************


Sanye yake cikin kayan training na sojoji a rantsettsiyar Base d'insu dake garin Bauchi wanda ko ina ka juya kalan shud'i kawai kake gani wato blue....  Matashi ne wanda ak'alla bazai gaza shekaru 34 a duniya ba, kallo d'aya zaka masa ka fahimci sam bashida jinin bak'in fata a tattare dashi, ma'ana duk yanda akayi wannan bawan Allah zama ce ta kawo k'asar bak'ak'e har ya koma d'an k'asa..... 

Wayace manne a kunnen sa na dama, basai ance maka answer waya yake ba. Daga looks d'in da yake dashi a fuskar sa zaka fahimce tsantsan tashin hankalin dake kwance saman fuskar sa.... 

Cikin nutsuwa da kwantar da hankalin mai sauraren nasa ya soma fad'in "Aunty Saudat kiyi hak'uri,  nasan kinayi,  da ace inada halin shigar da Yaya kotu da nayi,  but kinsan yin hakan na nufin Innah ta min baki...  Aunty Saudat ina tsananin tausayin ki sannan ina gujema ranar da Fawaz zai dawo k'asar nan ya tarar da abinda akema mahaifiyar sa,  bansan Yaya wani irin mutum bane amma kiyi hak'uri zanzo gidan ko gobe insha Allah kinji.....  Ki kwantar da hankalin ki....."

Ya jima yana tsaye a wajen yana nazarin abubuwar dake faruwa A DUNIYAR SU har baisan sanda amini kuma k'ani a gareshi ya k'araso yanda yake ba wanda shima basai ance maka Sojan bane,  shid'inma sanye yake cikin kayan training....  Dogon saurayi wanda yarinta sosai ya nuna a fuskar sa,  bazai wuce shekaru 25 ba duwa da shida.... 

"Captain lafiya kayi tsaye a nan ka bar horas da rundunar naka..."   cewan matashin Sojan saman da bai jima da k'arasowa wajen ba.... 

D'an bud'e madaidaitan idanunsa yayi kafin yace AFFAN waini baka mamakin abubuwan da suke faruwa A DUNIYAR MU rayuwa ta koma tamkar ta maguzawan farko, munyi watsi da d'abi'un da addinin mu ya koya mana,  mun koma tamkar zamanin jahiliya....."

Bai kai ayaba Affan ya dakatar dashi da fad'in "Kaga soldier pls don't start with your wa'azi,  haba kai kullum NASIR baka da aiki sai wa'azi,  kai inaga idan an kwana biyu ajjiye aikin Airforce zakayi ka koma malanta.... Yanzu bama wannan ba yanzu mukayi waya da Daddy yace min suna hanyarsu ta zuwa Bauchi gaba d'ayansu hardasu Mamy, inaga wannan karan kam har Jama'are zasuje gaba d'aya kasan maganace ta aure, so inaga ya kamata kaima kayi weekend d'in nan a gida koma ka soma sanar dasu Innah tun yanzu..."  ya k'arashe yana lank'washe yatsun hannunsa had'ida d'an motsa jiki wanda d'abi'ace tasu ta sojoji musamman idan suna atasaye.... 

D'an fuzar da iska Nasir yayi had'ida d'an yin still kafin ya jingina jikin k'arfen fence d'in da aka kewaye wajen dashi kana  ya furta "Allah Ya kawosu lafiya"  a tak'aice.... 

Affan ya rakasa da kallon mamaki domin wani sa'in miskilancin Nasir na damunsa,  Sam baida hayaniya, hidiman gabansa kawai yake bai shiga sabgan mutane....

*Kaduna*


Murmushi Mamy ta sakar mata lokaci guda tana juya d'iyar tata tana ganin yanda tayi kyau tamkar wata African Queen...  

"Sweetheart ina mai tabbatar maki duk miskilanci Nasir wannan karan kam dole ya hakace akanki,  kinga yanda kika cicciko kuwa gaskiya maganin Tasalla yana aiki, munje sai asaran kud'ad'enmu muke wajen sayan magunguna masu d'an karan tsada ashe ga sauk'i da arha har gida har d'aka...."

SHAREEFAH matashiyar mace 'yar kimanin shekaru 29 a duniya ta murmusa had'i da yin fari da idanu kafin ta soma fad'in "Nifah Mamy ba wannan ba damuwata yanzu bai wuce yanda aka soma maganar auren nan ba Nasir ya kuma watsa mana k'asa a ido,  don wllhi yace ya fasa aurena yanzu kam inaga k'aramin hauka zanyi, and Mamy what worries me the most shine INNAH case ce, zata iya hana Nasir aurena don nasan sarai bata mance wulak'ancin da na mata a Brazil ba...."

Mamy tayi murmushi kafin ta shafi gefen fuskar Shareefah tana mai fad'in "Haba daughter ki daina abu kaman bani na haifeki ba..... Nayi imani da Allah duk barikancin Innah Dije a bayana take, nasan meye imaninta ba komai bane illa kud'i dukda d'umbin dukiyar da mijinta ya mutu ya bari mata bata daina kwad'ayin wasu su shigo mata ba....."

Mammy tayi murmushi had'i da k'arasawa jikin wargajejen tagar wanda ya sha kwalliya da labulaye na alfarma kafin taci gaba da fad'in "Asm'au nake murucin kan dutse ban fito ba saida na shirya, maza k'arasa shirinki barin duba Daddyn ki......."

Daga haka ficewa tayi ta bar Shareefah cikeda farin cikin zata garin masoyinta abun k'aunar ta.... 

Karo suka kasanyi da juna lokaci guda Mamy take watsa mata mugun kallo domin duk sanda take k'ulla wani abin a gidan sai ta biyo hanyar ta.... 

A hasale take fad'in "Wai ke AZIMA shashashar ina ce inyi?  Kina tafiya kai a sama bagazan bagazan kamar ba mace ba.... "

Azima matashiyar budurwa wacce bazata gaza shekaru 24 ba tayi murmushi tana wasa da bakin gashinta wanda d'abi'arta ce kafin tace "Mamy kenan,  wai ke kullum a tsarge kike ne...? "    Ta sassauta murya kafin ta matso da kunnenta sautin bakin Mamy tana mai ci gaba da fad'i cikin sigan rad'a  "Fad'a min what are you up to this time around,  kinsan your secret is always safe with me,  oya fad'a min....."

Tsaki Mamy tayi had'i da yin k'wafa ta wuceta cikin sauri,  itakam ta kwaso ruwan tafasa kanta da hannunta abun har mamaki yake bata wai Azima ce ke shige mata hanci da k'udundune, Azima d'iyar d'an uwanta ta data d'aukota tun tana shekaru k'alilan ta maidata 'yar aikinta na k'arfi da yaji wai yau itace ke sakata fad'uwan gaba....  Lallai kuwa tun wuri gwara ta tari abin tasan yanda zatayi da yarinyar kafin ta zame ma rayuwar ta nightmare.....

Ko tankata baiyi ba har ta k'arashi tsiwar ta da masifar ta,  babu yanda ya iya he really needs the job,  rayuwan mahaifinsa na cikin garari dole ya shanye duk wani wulak'ancin da LUBNA zata masa a matsayinsa na driver d'inta, amma har cikin ransa ji yake kaman ya rufeta da d'an banzan duka ya fasa bakin rashin kunyar da wannan yarinyar murd'a d'aya zai mata ya kareraya ta.... 

Tana make a owners corner suke zagaya cikin Babbar Universityn ta Bauchi,  wato Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University.....  LUBNA SA'OUD SANTANA kenan budurwa 'yar kimanin shekaru 21 wacce ta taso cikin sangarta gata da soyayyar 'yan uwanta........

*Garin Jama'are,  jihar Bauchi*


Wasu 'yan mata guda biyu ke tsaye a wani babban gidan gona wanda babu kalan shanayen da babu,  kama daga shanunmu na gida har zuwa irin shanayen madaran nan wato Bulls. Wannan tampatsetsen gidan Gona bana kowa bane illa Alh Ali Safwan,  mahaifi ga AFFAN ALI SAFWAN da kuma SHAREEFAH ALI SAFWAN, wannan gidan gona Allah Ya albarkace da k'osassun shanu masu lafiya wanda a kullum akan cire zallan madara ganga ganga....

Cikin tsanaki wad'annan 'yanmata suke tafiya rik'e da kafad'un juna,  iskan damin yana hurasu, ga ciyayi sunyi kore shar gwanin ban sha'awa....  Ga dukkan alamu  suna cikin nishad'i domin kuwa kana iya jiyo sautin 'yan wak'e wak'en da suke cikin harshen fillanci.... 

D'aya daga cikin 'yanmatan ne ta tsuguna k'ark'ashin saniya guda nan ta soma tastan nonon saniyar cikin k'warewa....  Har lokacin basu daina 'yan wak'e wak'en su  ba,  ita kuwa d'ayar tsaye tayi tana sauraren 'yar uwar tata murmushi kwance saman fuskar ta.... 

Lokaci guda tayi fatali da bokatin da take tsatsan nonon saniyar wanda saida ya haifarma wacce take tsayen birkicewa...  Cikeda tashin hankali take lalume da hannayenta tana bud'e manyan idanunta wanda suke bud'e tas tamkar mai gani take fad'in "SALMA lafiya,  me ya sameki 'yar uwata....."   aya ta dasa wa maganar nata sanda ta jiyo muryar wacce ta kira da Salma tana fad'in "Adda Jamila oyoyo,  ina kika baro Falaq...."

Wacce Salma ta kirada Adda Jamila yatsina fuska tayi tana taunar chewing gum tana wani totttoshe hanci had'i da kauda kai gefe kafin ta soma fad'in "Ni dalla matsa min,  sai warin nono kike kin wani zo kin shafa min,  bansan sanda zaku waye ba sam,  kuna zuwa makaranta tamkar baku zuwa,  ko cemaku akayi a riga kuke,  sam bakuda banbanci da 'yan matan riga,"  Ta kai dubanta d'aya budurwar dake k'arasowa wajen nasu da k'yar kafin ta dawo da dubanta ga Salma wacce ta cika tayi fam kafin tace "Ita ma wancan makauniyar tatsan nonon take ko me....."  

Daidai lokacin da ILHAM ta k'araso rik'e da sandar ta na d'an jagora take fad'in "Addah sannu da zuwa, kin zo lafia...?

*漏Sameena Aleeyou...鉁嶐煆�*







A kufule Salma ta soma tafiya ta nufi sashen da gidansu yake wanda yake a cikin gidan gonar, Jamila na mata magana ko amsata bata tsaya yi ba,  wannan d'abi'ace ta SALMA duk yanda take ganin girman mutum idan ya zubar da girman take sa take yi tsaf, sannan bata barin kota kwana balle tayi tsami,  kowa ya shaide ta da wannan d'abi'a don tun tuni tun bata kawo iwar haka ba ita ke amshe wa 'yan uwan nata fad'a. 

SALMA matashiyar budurwa 'yar kimanin shekaru 19 a duniya itace d'iya ta biyu ga marigayi Jauro Yakubu wanda gaba d'aya illahirin ma'aikatan wannan gidan gona da iyalansa suke kiransa da Baffah kafin Allah yayi masa rausuwa, JAMILA me kimanin shekaru 25 a duniya itace d'iyar fari wacce tuni tayi aure a cikin garin Jama'aren tanada yarinya guda d'aya mai suna Falaq, sai autar su ILHAM 'yar kimanin shekaru 17 a duniya wacce Allah Ya jarabceta da matsalan rashin gani.....


Innoh (Kaman yanda suke kiran mahaifiyar tasu) tana zaune bisa darduma a farfajiyan gidan Salma ta shigo baki a ture tana mita... Innoh na tambayarta Lafia?  Inaa ko zarafin amsata bata samu ba sai masifa take da hausarta wanda fillanci yafi yawa a ciki....  Hango Falaq da tayi tana rarrafen ta gefen Innoh ya sanyata sakin murmushi ta k'arasa a guje kaman k'aramar yarinya ta suri yarinyar tana mata wasa yarinyar kuwa sai k'ek'yata dariya take,  har ta mance bak'in cikin da uwar yarinyar ta k'unsa mata  domin kuwa gaba d'ayansu Allah Ya jefa masu soyayyar Falaq cikin zukatansu... 

A tare Ilham da Jamila suka shigo yanda suka tarar daga Innoh har Salmar wasa suke kanyi ma Falaq... 

Ilham wacce sam bata gani sai muryoyinsu da take jiyo cikin kunnuwanta sai murmushi take tana mai rayawa a cikin zuciyar ta inama wataran Allah zai bud'e mata idanu taga Falaq,  sautin yarinyar yana mata dad'i a cikin kunnuwan ta... 

Innoh na hankalce da Ilham wacce ke tsaye tana murmushi tausayin d'iyar tata ya rufe ta,  a yayinda su Jamila da Salma sukayi nisa cikin nishad'i,  Allah sarki d'an uwa mai dad'i har sun mance fad'an da sukayi an ci gaba da raha.. 

Mik'ewa Innoh tayi ta kamo Ilham had'i da zaunar da ita cikin 'yan uwan nata, daga Jamila har Salma kallo suka bi Innoh da Ilham dashi,  zukatan su cikeda tausayin nak'ason da 'yar uwar tasu kedashi a halittan ta.. 

Da sauri Salma ta mik'a ma Ilham Falaq ta d'aurata bisa cinyarta...  Aiko nan Ilham ta shiga murmushi bai bayyana hak'wara lokaci guda tana shafa Falaq.... 

Shiru Jamila tayi abubuwa da dama suna ziyartan zuciyarta,  ta sani tabbas 'yan uwanta suna son d'iyarta Falaq,  inama yanda suke sonta haka mahaifinta ke sonta,  tunowa tayi da wa'adin da ya d'ibar mata idan bata sanda yanda zatayi da d'iyarta ba toh kuwa tana gab da barin gidan sa don shi ba sabida haihuwa ya aureta ba,  sabida holewa ya aureta yanda take kyakkyawan bafulatanar nan. Ciki wajen uku Alh Nuhu na zubar mata sai akan Falaq Allah yayi zata haifa,  gashi yanzu ta soma ganin canji daga gareshi.... 


**********


 "Kai kaga,  what's that your name again...  Kaga me ma kake da suna,  Deeni kake ko wa,  ni bana tafiya less than 180 ka k'ara speed,  wannan ai sai kasa na gaji...."

Batayi shiru ba k'awarta Faty KT dake zaune gefenta ta yamutsa fuska kafin tace "Ke ni wllhi duk jina nake ma na gaji saikace a amalanken shanu muke..."

Haba nan fah Lubna ta kuma harzuk'a ta shiga balbala masifa..... 

ZAHRADDEEN kuwa ya kawo iya wuya,  bai tankasu ba sai gyara seatbelt d'insa da yayi,  basu ko kula da hakan ba sai tsiwa sukeyi.... 

Wani irin kwasan motar yayi ya soma wasa da rayukansu bisa kwalta..... 

Mannewa da juna sukayi waje guda daga Lubnar har Fatyn sai ihu suke,  shiko kaman cewa suke ya k'ara,  ta mirror yake kallonsu yana munafukin dariya,  sai yayi kaman zai rage wuta sai ya kuma kwasan motar,  tuni Faty ta cire d'an kwali ta rik'e a hannu tana ihu,  shiko Deen k'arshema earpiece ya manne kunnuwar sa dasu.... 

Saida suka jigata ya gama race dasu kafin ya cakka wata uwar burki wanda saida ya haifar masu hautsinewar 'yan hanjinsu... 

Faty na nishi take duban Lubna da k'yar take fad'in 

"Babe kiyiwa Allah kicema wannan BABY DRIVER d'in ya ajiyeni,  wllhi ban shirya mutuwa ba....." ta k'arashe tana nishi... 

Haki Lubnar ma take tana fad'in "Babe bakiga ma abinda yayi ba,  toshe kunnuwan sa fah yayi da earpiece baima sauraren mu ..."


"Kai Baby Driver...!!!"  Suka fad'i a tare cikin had'e murya.... 

Ko kulasu baiyiba sai kwasan gudu suke  a hanyar Main Campus da zai kaika har Air Force Base....

A harzuk'e Lubna tayi tsalle ta komo frontseat,  earpiece d'in kunnensa ta fincike tana fad'in "Meye kasha a wannan kwanyar taka... Are you insane or what?   Baka ganin nan highway n....."

Batakai aya ba yaja burki ya kashe motar ya zare key d'in ya nufi cikin daji.... 

Baki hangame suka bisa da kallo har ya gangara cikin bishiyoyin.... 

Lallai wannan talakan babban  d'an rainin hankali ne... Lubna tace a cikin zuciyarta, a kufule ta fincike marfin motar ta fice tabi bayansa... 

Fati KT baki hangame take kallon ikon Allah...  Aiko bata isa zama ita kad'ai cikin mota a hanyar Gubi ba yanda ake satan mutane kaman kaya... 

"Bismillahi..."  ta fad'i had'i da bud'e marfin mota...  Tun daga nesa take sakawa mai babur hannu bibbiyu tana taresa.. 

_Ni kuwa Sameena nace yau su Fati KT babur za'a hau a koma cikin sch 馃ぃ... *Sha zumami* kuke ji yanda akwai zak'i nan take bibiya..._



Sai falfala gudu yake cikin motar sa k'irar 407 wanda take Blue kalansu na Sojin Sama,  lokaci guda yake sauraren wasan k'wallon k'afan da ake bugawa na duniya  wato World Cup a radion motar sa....  Daga can gefen kwalta ya hangi mota kaman na gidansu...  Toh amma mai zai kawo motar gidansu ta tsaya a nan,  kuma da alama babu kowa cikin motar,  shi gashi bama sanin lambobin motocin gidan yayi ba balle ya gane,  sam baiyi relaying akan dukiyan gado da mahaifinsu ya mutu ya bar masu ba,  'yar 407 d'insa da aka raba masu sojoji ya ishe sa,  sam Nasir ba mai son abin duniya bane,  harta dukiyansa wanda yake samu da guminsa rabinsa a charity foundation suke tafiya, wannan d'aya ne daga cikin kyawawan d'abi'u na Nasir Sa'oud Santana... 


Tun tana binshi tana kiran sunansa tana masifa tana fad'in ya bata car keys d'inta,  har ta gaji ta durk'usa a wajen tana kuka tana ambato Innahar ta.. 

Ta jima a wajen tana durk'ushe tana kuka kafin ta jiyo muryar sa yana fad'in 

"1/1 gobe ki sake min rashin kunya kiga abinda zan maki,  k'asan bridge zan wullaki gaba d'aya... Oya tashi mu tafi lafin ki kuma b'atamin rai...."

D'ago rinannun idanunta tayi tana hararansa kafin taja tsaki tace "Ku talakawa tsiyarku kenan da an jawoku inuwa sai ku tura mutum rana,  ba don ina tausayin Mama Tani ba wllhi da tuni nasa anyi firing d'in....."

Ganin yasa kai zai kuma kutsawa cikin daji yasata dasa aya ma zancenta tana binshi cikin sassarfa take fad'in

"Kaga,  ina kuma zakaje... Toh kaga na yarda 1/1 muje a haka,  kaga Faty na mota tana jiranmu...."

Suna tafe yana k'unshe dariyar sa domin kuwa gaba d'aya kukan da Lubna tayi mascara ya zazzago ya b'ata mata fuska,  abinka da farar mace sai ta koma tamkar Zombie.... 

Suna tsaka da neman Fati KT wayar Lubna tayi k'ara,  ba kowa bace illa Fatin,  nan ta sanar da ita cewa itakam ta koma cikin sch don ta lura wannan driver d'in nata ba mai lafiya bane... 

Gama wayarta da Faty keda wuya ta kirawo masoyinta Affan ta sanar dashi gata ta kusan shigowa Base d'insu....

Yana isowa gidan ko sashen Innah baije ba ya nufi sashen Yaya Kabiru

Sosai idanun Nasir suka kad'a sukayi jazir sanda yaga kalan cin zarafin da d'an uwansa yayima matar sa,  tausayin Aunty Saudat ya rufesa...

*_TIRK'ASHI_* WAI SHIN MENENE SUKA FARU SHEKARUN BAYA A GIDAN MARIGAYI SA'OUD SANTANA?? 

_*Waiwaye*_


A k'arshen k'arni na ashirin zuwa farkon k'arni na ashirin da d'aya turawan k'asar Faransa sun mamaye wata birni mai suna Casablanca dake k'asar Morocco, Kakannin Sa'oud Santana sun kasance daga cikin wad'ancan turawa  sun zauna a birnin Casablanca na tsawon shekaru... Banbance banbancen launin fata da na addini yayi tasiri sosai a wancan lokacin sabida sam larabawan gani suke turawan Faransa sun masu fin k'arfi suda k'asar su, mahaifin Sa'oud ya had'u da wata balarabiya 'yar asalin k'asar ta Morocco wanda a dalilin haka yasa ya karb'i addinin musulunci,  iyayen sa sunyi baran-baran dashi akan abinda yazo dashi.  Na farko sam basu ya auri wata jinsi da ba'a cikinsu take ba ma'ana basu so ya auro balarabiya,  na biyu karb'an addinin islama da yayi...  Hakan yasa suka sanya masa tak'unk'umi wanda yasa dole ya d'auki matar sa suka baro k'asar Morocco.

Sun zauna a k'asashen Africa ta arewa da dama cikin larabawa daga wannan garin zuwa wancan garin sakamakon kasuwanci da mahaifin Sa'oud keyi babu kama k'afan yaro,  dukda banbancin launin fata da yake samu daga wajen wasu larabawan..  A cikin tafiye-tafiyen nasa ne ya k'araso Africa ta yamma yanda ya yada zango a k'asar Nigeria.. 

Ya zauna a k'asar Borno tun a wancan lokacin tana Barno empire tana had'e da garuruwa da dama a arewa maso gabashin k'asar nan... 


Mahaifin Sa'oud wato Naseer Santana ya kasance yayi arziki sosai zuwa k'asar Nigeria da yayi wanda hakan ya sanyasa ya zauna a k'asar Nigeria bai kuma canza k'asa ba.. Ya had'u da wani mutum mai suna Baana,  wanda ya rik'e masa amanar dukiyar sa bisa gaskiya da rik'on amana har sun koma tamkar 'yan uwan juna, dad'i da k'ari a k'asar Nigeria ne matarsa mai suna Najwa ta haifo masa santalelen yaro na miji  don haka babu batun tafiye-tafiye da d'anyen goyo... Yaro yaci suna Sa'oud sannan ya taso cikin soyayyan iyayen sa da mak'ota da abokan arziki.... 


Sa'oud da iyayen sa suna zaune a k'asar Borno wata rana sak'o ya tadda Nasir cewa iyayen sa Allah Ya masu rasuwa sakamakon had'arin mota da sukayi... Haka ya tattari iyalansa gaba d'aya suka tafi birnin Casablanca, yayi kuka sosai sanin cewa iyayen sa a mushurikai suka mutu gashi babu halin yayi masu addu'a... 

Naseer Santana ya jima a can k'asar ta Morocco sanin dukiyar sa na hannun na gari, dama tilastawa na iyayen sa ne yasa shi barin k'asar bagatatan,  mai d'akinsa ma tafi son zama a k'asar su cikin 'yan uwanta...  

A haka suka shafe shekaru har Sa'oud ya kai shiga makaranta suka saka shi a nan birnin Casablanca... Daga baya iyayen sa sun dawo Nigeria yanda suka barsa a can yana karatu gaban Kakannin sa iyayen Babarsa.. 


Bayan wasu shekaru Sa'oud ya shak'u da kakannin sa sosai har yana jin bazai iya rabuwa dasu ba,  a haka har ya kai munzanin shiga jami'a,  I zuwa lokacin iyayen sa ma sun son d'ansu ya dawo garesu amma rana tsaka bazasu iya d'auke sa kwatsam ba yin hakan rashin kyautawa ne ma Dattijan... 

Bai baro k'asar Morocco ba har saida ya kusan kammala karatunsa na jami'a sannan kakannin sa suka aura masa Mace a dangi mai suna Hidaya 

Yakan d'aukota suzo k'asar Nigeria duba iyayen sa amma fir Hidaya takan nuna bata son k'asar Nigeria bata son bak'in mutum...  Haka Sa'oud zaiyita nuna mata cewa da fari da bak'i dama ko wani irin mutum duka Allah ne yayi su kuma yana son kayansa sannan babu wanda yafi wani a wajen Allah sai wanda yafisu tsoronsa...  Hidaya takan jisa kawai domin kuwa ita sam babu yanda za'ayi ta k'aunace bak'in fata.. 

Suna shekara ta biyu da aure Allah yayi ma kakanin Sa'oud rasuwa dole suka tattara suka dawo Nigeria wajen iyayen sa... 

Baana mai kula ko nace mai hidima ma Naseer yanada matar aure da d'iya k'wara d'aya tak mai suna Dije,... 

Dije tayi aure har ta haihu saidai sun rabu da mijin,  lokacin da Sa'oud da matar sa suka dawo k'asar nan sai aka basu Dije ta ringa taya Hidaya da aikin cikin gida tunda batada aure a lokacin...  Muzgunawa babu irin wanda Dije bata gani ba a wajen Hidaya,  har manna mata dusten guga mai zafin gaske ta tab'a yi sabida kawai ta tsanin bak'in mutum,  wani sa'in Sa'oud ne  yakan k'waci Dije,  gashi babu hali tazo da goyon jarirn d'anta shima sai ya karb'i nasa tsaraban a hannun Hidaya, idan Dije tace zata bar aikin mahaifiyarta ita ke tausar ta tana sanar da ita akwai ranar d'aukan fansa na nan na zuwa mata idan ta jure duk wani wuya har ta samu ta shiga gidan Sa'oud,  domin ita batada burin da ya wuce Dije ta auri Sa'oud.... A 'yan wad'annan lokuta Allah yayi ma mahaifin Sa'oud wato Naseer Santana rasuwa,  Sa'oud yayi kuka sosai wanda tun bayan rasuwar Naseer Najwa ma ta soma ciwo,  ba'a jima sosai ba itama tace ga garin ku... 

Kasa zaman Maiduguri Sa'oud yayi dole ya gangaro ya dawo k'asar Bauchi da zama, gashi har lokacin Allah bai basu haihuwa ba shida iyalinsa,  mutuwar iyayen Sa'oud sosai ya shiga jikin Hidaya sannan taga yanda bak'ak'en fata suka masu kara,  tabbas ta yarda musulmi d'an uwan musulmi ne, tun daga wancan lokacin ta daina hantaran bak'in fata... 

Sa'oud ya tattaro dukiyar mahaifin sa gaba d'aya ya dawo dasu k'asar Bauchi yanda ya gina shararren kampani wanda mutane da dama suna amfana dashi wajen zuba kasuwancin su a ciki mai suna *Santana Corporation*

Gaba d'aya suka dawo garin ta Bauchi harda Dattijo Baana da iyalansa Dije da mahaifiyarta da kuma d'anta Kabiru, dadowarsu Bauchi da kad'an mahaifin Dije ya rasu, sunci kuka sosai ita da mahaifiyarta yanda Sa'oud yayi alk'awarin bazai tab'a barinsu ba 

Yanzu kam sosai Hidaya ta sake dasu, bata hantaransu saima rok'onsu gafara da take yi, Kabir har ya koma tamkar d'anta,  tana son yaron domin abubuwa na mugunta data masa a baya sai tana ganin kaman Allah bazai tab'a yafe mata ba,  d'aukan yaron da take yi yasa ta shak'u sosai dashi,  tun yana jin tsoronta sabida farin fatar ta yana ganin kaman babban doll baby ce har ya saki jiki da ita yana ganinta zai soma murna,  duk wannan abunda ake zuciyar Dije bai warke daga gyambon d'aukar fansan da ya mamaye sa ba,  har yau idan ta d'aga bayanta akwai tabon da Hidaya ta mata da dutsen guga, sannan ta d'au alwashin saita rama ko ba dad'e ko ba jimawa muddin tana numfashi... 


Ana haka bayan wasu 'yan shekaru Hidaya ta sami ciki,  wai zo kaga murna wajen wad'annan bayin Allah,  wato Sa'oud da Hidaya,  haka akayita tarerayan cikin har ya girma,  Dije da mahaifiyar ta ma sun nuna soyayyar su sosai ga cikin Hidaya, haka Maman Dije tayita d'irka ma Hidaya wasu irin magunguna da sunan maganin zak'i ba don komai ba sai don Hidaya ta mutu d'iyarta ta auri Sa'oud,  idan tak'i sha haka zata kalallameta da baki tace rubutu ne zaisa ita da abinda ke cikinta suyi lafiya,  abinka da wacce ta jima bata haihu ba tuni sai ta karb'a ta kurb'e...


A haka wani rana zata wuce d'aki tana haurawa bene da k'yar tanayi tana hutawa,  daidai k'ofar d'akin su Dije ta jiyosu sai shewa suke suna fad'in tsinanniya ta kusan margayawa ta basu waje,  abubuwan da kunnen ta suka jiyo mata babu dad'in saurare,  dukda wasu hausar ba fahimta take ba,  take taji abinda ke cikinta na juya mata jin duk shirinsu akan su kasheta ne Dije ta auri mijinta,  wani irin k'ara ta Saki tana rirrik'e cikinta don bata so ta rasa abinda ke cikinta,  ta gwammaci ita ta mutu amma shi ya tsira... 

A tamanin suka fito rik'e da k'ugu suna dubanta,  duk a zatonsu bataji abubuwan da suke fad'i ba,  Maman Dije ta nufota da sauri tana tattare zani take fad'in "Mun shiga uku,  Hidaya nak'udar ce..."

Jada baya Hidaya take tana mannuwa jikin staircase take girgiza kai tana karkad'a hannu tana kame cikinta da hannu guda take furta "Kar ki zo kusana,  kar ki cutar da abinda ke cikina, naji komai, ashe ba son gaskiya kuke min ba,  shin ta yaya Sa'oud zai yarda da auren d'iyarki idan yaji bak'in aikin da kukayi,  nasan na maku laifi a baya sannan na cutar daku,  amma cutar da na maku baikai na d'aukar rai ba.. Shin dama haka Mutane suka koma A DUNIYAR MU,  meyasa baku rama iya abinda na maku ba meyasa zaku cutar da abinda ke cikina.... "   muryarta ya carke sanda ta kuma jin wani sabon murd'a na taso mata,  sosai ta rik'e staircase tana wani irin nishi...  Ganin haka yasa Maman Dije nufota a tamanin,  itako Hidaya ta razana da ganin yanayin matar cikin sauri ta matsa gefe aiko Maman Dije tana k'arasowa takai capka ma k'arafan staircase kan kace me tayi juyi ta apka k'asa... 

Wani irin gigitaccen k'ara Dije ta saki lokaci guda ta nufi mahaifiyarta dake mashasshara tana ambato sunanta dai-dai lokacin da Sa'oud ya shigo gidan,  ga Dije da mahaifiyarta a k'asa rai a hannun Allah ga matarsa saman bene tana nak'uda,  cikin sauri ya yarda abubuwan dake hannunsa dangin kayan wasa yaso ma Kabir da unborn child d'insu..  Kan matarsa yayi a tamanin yana jijjigata amma ina nishi da k'yar take,  cikin sauri ya sureta ya fice da ita,  wannan abu ba k'aramin bak'anta ran Dije yayi ba,  Matarsa ta kashe mata uwa,  sannan baibi ta kansu ba ya suri matar sa ya fice da ita,  tabbas idan mahaifiyarta ta mutu gaba d'aya sai ta d'au fansa akansu..... Kuka take sosai tana rungume da mahaifiyar ta,  lokaci guda Kabir ya k'araso a guje yana d'aukan kayan wasa,  wata uwar tsawa Dije ta daka masa wanda yasa sa watsar da kayan wasan babu shiri,  hannu tasa ta janyo d'anta ta had'e ta rungume da mahaifiyarta tana wani irin kuka..... 



Duk yanda akayi a ceto rayuwar Hidaya abu ya faskara,  Allah sarki Hidaya dai Allah yayi mata cikawa bayan anyi k'ok'arin ceton ran abinda ta haifa ta bari,  haka Sa'oud ya rungume jaririn cikin jikinsa yana kuka da duka zuciyar sa,  hak'ik'a yana son Hidaya so na gaskiya gashi mutuwa ta masu yankar k'auna... 


Sanda ya shigo gidan rungume da d'ansa Dije ma tana kwance saman gawar mahaifiyarta ga Kabir d'an shekaru goma na taya ta kuka,  sai lokacin Sa'oud ya lura da abinda ya faru,  wani sabon kuka ya kuma b'alle masa... 

Kusan tare-tare aka gabatar da komai na mutuwar Maman Dije da kuma Hidaya,  Allahu Akbar wannan shine tashin hankali wanda ba'a saka masa rana.... 

Haka rayuwar gidan ta koma tamkar babu masu rai cikinta sai Kabir dake kai komo a tsakani,  shi kuwa Sa'oud da k'arfi saida ya iya rainon jariri Dije koh kullum cikin jimamin mutuwar mahaifiyarta take,  idan ta jiyo sautin kukan jaririn da yaci sunan mahaifin Sa'oud wato Naseer har cikin k'ahon zuciyarta take jin tamkar ta shak'e yaron ya mutu ko zata huta,  batada burin da ya wuce ta d'auki fansar ta akan abinda Hidaya ta haifa ta bari,  zuciyarta ta kuma bushewa ta kuma k'ek'ashewa. Da wannan tunani ta mik'e ta fito parlor yanda ta tarar sai kokawan canza ma Naseer napkin Sa'oud keyi....  Tasa bayan hannu ta share hawayen taurin rai da suka zubo mata kafin tayi murmushi ta isa garesu ta amshe Naseer kan kace me har ta shirya yaron tsaf ya daina kuka.

Da murmushi Sa'oud ke dubanta had'i da yi mata godiya, yana mai tausaya mata na rashin mahaifiyarta da tayi..

A haka rayuwa taci gaba da tafiya masu Dije na kula da Naseer tamkar ita ta tsuguna ta haifesa,  idan Sa'oud ya nuna mata jin dad'insa bisa yanda take kula da Naseer sai ta nuna masa cewa ai d'a na kowa ne,  kuma tana tausayin duk wanda ya rasa mahaifiya sannan rana guda suka rasa mahaifansu ita da Naseer.. 

Murmushi kawai Sa'oud yakanyi yana mai jin wani abu a hankali cikin zuciyar sa gameda Dije,  a haka rayuwa taci gaba da tafiya masu har dai ya fayyace mata yana son aurenta,  itama tuni ta aminta dashi yanda suka tafi can Maiduguri aka d'aura masu aure suka dawo Bauchi gidansu da yaransu Kabeer da kuma Naseer.

Naseer bai ragewa mahaifinsa komai ba,  bashida tsananin kyau amma yanada structu irinta mazaje sannan kallo guda zaka masa ka gane tsan-tsan bature ne. Sa'oud da Dije sun yanke shawarin b'oye ma Naseer cewa ba Dije bane ta haifesa bayan ta masa magiyan kar ya sanar dashi ba itace ta haifesa ba,  Sa'oud ya kuma jin dad'i ganin yanda Dije ke son Naseer har ta kai ta barahi a matsayin d'anta,  ya tabbata Naseer bazaiyi kukan maraici ba. 

A haka yaran suka taso tamkar Yaya da k'ani dukda Kabir ya d'arama Naseer da shekaru kusan goma saidai d'aya bature ne d'aya bak'in fata ga sunan mahaifinsu iri guda,kasancewar shi Kabir d'in bai shiga makaranta da wuri ba shiyasa ya d'ara Naseer d'in da aji kad'an a primary school.  Idan yara sun damesu da tsokana fari da bak'i sai Kabeer yace shi Innar su ya biyo yayinda Naseer ya biyo Abbansu.  Wasu suk'i yarda sai sunzo gidan sun gane ma idanunsu su yarda. 


Tunda Naseer ya soma girma Innah ta soma hantaran sa akan d'anta Kabeer,  gashi sam Kabeer baida kunya bai ganin girman na gaba,  idan kaji an kawo k'arar fad'a cikin gidan toh Kabeer ne. 

A haka Kabeer ya kai shekaru goma sha takwas tuni ya soma bin 'yanmata yana lalata su,  sosai abin yake damun Sa'oud Santana,  idan yayi magana Innah tace aure yake so ayi masa,.

Wata rana Sa'oud ya had'u da k'anin mahaifin Hidaya a can k'asar Morocco wani zuwa da yayi duba dangi,  nan  Sa'oud ya buk'aci Suhail  ya biyosa Nigeria suyi aiki tare tunda iyalinsa bata jima da rasuwa ba kuma yana son canza environment ko zai mance abin, tuni Suhail ya amince da batun mijin 'yar uwar tasa suka biyo Sa'oud Nigeri shida d'iyarsa mai suna Saudat,  yarinya 'yar shekaru goma sha hud'u,  Sa'oud ya sanar dashi dokokin gidansa cewa kar ya tab'a sanar da Naseer cewa ba Dije bace ta haifesa..  Mamaki ne ya cika Suhail ganin shida d'iyar 'yar uwarsa amma bashida halin sanar dashi shi d'in uba yake ga mahaifiyar sa... 

Tunda Kabeer ya k'yalla idanu kan Saudat yake bobiyanta yana neman ya lalata yarinya gashi ba yarensa take ji ba domin kuwa ita da mahaifinta basu jin komai sai larabci..  Koda Suhail yayi magana Innah tayi kicin-kicin tace sharri zai k'ulla ma d'anta don yaga shine ya fito bak'in fata.... 

Haka Sa'oud yayita tausan Suhail k'arshe Suhail yace bazai iya ba zai koma can k'asar su domin kuwa sam Kabeer ya hana ma d'iyarsa sukuni dukda k'arancin shekarunta..  

Haka Kabeer ya tada masu hauka a gidan shidai saidai a Aura masa Saudat,  babu yanda Sa'oud baiyi ba ganin Kabeer ya cire maganar auren a ransa abu ya faskara, Innah kullum kuka tana rok'on Sa'oud ya taimaka ya shawo kan Suhail ya aura ma Kabeer Saudat don cewa yayi muddin ba'a aura masa Saudat ba toh kuwa zai kashe kansa.. 


Mahaifin Saudat kuwa da yaga sun damu har haka sai ya yanke masu dukiyar da zasu bada kaso biyu na cikin dukiyar Sa'oud Santana kafin ya bawa d'ansu Kabeer auren Saudat,  hankalin Innah sosai ya tashi da jin irin kud'ad'en da Suhail ya yanke,  amma yaya zatayi tanada k'udirin d'aukan fansa akan duk wani jinin Hidaya da zata sami dama akansa,  don haka batayi k'asa a gwiwa ba wajen ganin Alh Sa'oud ya biya wad'anan kud'ad'e da Suhail ya buk'ata.. 

Sa'oud ba don yaso ba akayi wannan aure, Saudat da batasan wainar da ake tuyawa ba sai gani tayi an rufe kanta an kawota d'akin mutumin da take tsananin tsoro,  mahaifinta kuwa tuni ya tattari dukiyar sa ya cika ma rigarsa iska...

Babu yanda Abbah Sa'oud baiyi ba Kabeer da matarsa su zauna a cikin gidan amma fir Innah tak'i yarda a cewarta yanda Kabeer yakeji da tashen balaga abin kunya za'atayi a cikin gidan gwara suje can gidansu daban basuji ba basu gani ba domin tanai masa kunyar d'an fari.. 

Haka babu tausayi a zuciyar Kabeer had'i da yarinta kullum yana aikin abu guda da k'aramar yarinya,  tun tana masa kuka yana biyeta har ya soma saka mata hannu idan kukan nata ya ishesa. Innah kuwa a kullum tana koya masa yanda zai muzguna ma Saudat,  Innah bata b'oye masa komai ba na nufinta wajen son d'aukar fansa ba akan Saudat.. 

A haka watan Saudat tara cif ta haifo yaronta namiji kyakkyawa mai kamanta,  tun kafin jinin bik'i ya d'auke mata Kabeer ya kuma far mata,  ala dole Innah ta d'auko mai kula ita Saudat d'in ganin Kabeer zai kasheta bata d'auki fansarta ba wajen azabtar da Saudat.. 

Da wannan Saudat ta sami sauk'in jarabar Kabeer, shiko tuni ya koma bin 'yanmatan sa da ya saba.  Shekaran Fawaz uku a duniya Innah ta haifo d'iyarta mai kama da Naseer sak mahaifinsu suka biyo,  saidai kawai Naseer ya nuna mata tsananin hasken fata.. Haka Lubna ta taso cikin soyayyan 'yan uwanta babu kaman Naseer yana son Fawaz da Lubna sosai, haka Alh Sa'oud soyayyan Fawaz da Lubna ya shiga zuciyarsa sosai... 


A haka Innah ta tak'ura aka tura Naseer makarantar kwana lokacin da yakai munzanin aji hud'u a standard,  shi kuma Kabeer a lokacin ya sami gurbin karatu a jami'ar Maiduguri hakan yasa Abbah Sa'oud yasa Saudat ta dawo gidan da zama... 



A haka rayuwa taci gaba da tafiya,  Innah bata yarda da ma'aikata kwanaki k'alilan suke ta sallamesu sabida bataso kowa ya shigo ratuwarta ya b'ata mata shirinta,..

Wani rana Abbah ya dawo daga sallan mangariba yaga abinda yayi tsananin girgiza sa ya tada masa hankali ya kuma basa tsoro,  ba komai ya gani ba illa Dije dake k'ok'arin biyar buk'atar kanta da matan d'anta da k'arfin tsiya...  Baisan sanda jikinsa ta d'auki rawa ba,  murya na rawa ya daka mata wani irin tsawa yana mai ambato sunan ta... 



A zabure ta mik'e daga kan Saudat dake faman kuka da duka zuciyarta.. 


Innah ta zuba  gwiwoyi a k'asa tana rok'onsa yayi hak'uri sharrin shaid'an ne.. 

Abbah baisan sanda hawaye suka shiga kwaranya masa ba,  wannan wani irin fitina ne ace mace na neman 'yar uwarta mace sannan k'arewan rashin tsoron Allah ki nemi matan d'anki da kika tsuguna kika haifa  ..... Innalillahi wa inna'ilaihirraji'un... 


Kuka Innah take tana rik'e da k'afafunsa take fad'in "Ka min rai Sa'oud sharrin shaid'an ne..."

Cikin kuka shima ya fizge rigar sa yana fad'in "Da me na rage ki Dije da har kike neman d'iyar d'anki,  shin dama wannan dalili ne yasa baki iya zama da ma'aikata,  shin kinsan girman zunubin neman jinsi,  wannan wacce irin fitina ce take faruwa A DUNIYAR MU....  

Kuka Innah take tana rok'onsa gafara,  Abbah bai fasa furta mata kalman saki ba,  dai-dai lokacin da Kabeer ya shigo gidan domin basu san yana tafe ba... 


Alh Sa'oud yaci gaba da fad'in "Nayi d'an da na sanin aurenki da nayi da kuma mallaka maki d'ana Naseer da nayi,  kin cuce ni kin ci amanata, Allah shi zai min sakayya tsakani na dake.. 


Kabeer yayi jifa da jakkar sa ya shigo ya rik'e mahaifiyar sa yana jijjigata yake fad'in "Innah why?  Meyasa kika fad'a masa gaskiya, meyasa kika sanar dashi burin mu akan shi,  meyasa kika sanar dashi bak'in aikin da kukayi akan matarsa Hidaya... Shikenan yanzu Innah komai ya kwab'e mana bazamu mallaki dukiyar sa ba....."   

Innah na kwab'arsa ya kasa shiru sai jijjigata yake don shi duk a zatonsa asirin Innar tasa ce ya tonu... 


I zuwa lokacin Abbah ya soma rik'e k'irjinsa da jin irin miyagun ayyukan da Dije da mahaifiyarta sukayi,   da k'yar ya soma tafiya yana rik'e da k'irjinsa har ya isa jikin table da wayan land-line ke bisa,  d'auka yayi da k'yar zaiyi dialing lambar 'yansanda suko sai kacaniya suke...  Ai Innah na hangosa a tamanin tayi kansa lokaci guda ta jawo irin k'anan table mahad'in center table da ake saka su tsakankanin kujeru ta rusa ma Abbah akansa,  ya saki k'aran azaba ya soma shure-shure wanda hakan ya sanya Saudat fitowa a guje...

Ganin yana yunk'urin tashi yasa Kabeer jawo wani table d'in ya shiga sauk'e masa akai,  tun yana k'ara had'i da salati har ya daina sai shiru kake ji....  Allah sarki Sa'oud Santana yace ga garinku Allah yayi masa cikawa a sanadin wad'annan azzalumai guda biyu... 


Saudat ta Saki wani irin k'ara ta juya d'aki a guje jikinta na wani irin rawa tamkar mazari...  Innah na huci tamkar zakanya tace da Kabeer "Bita kaci ubanta don na tabbata baka da sauran imani...."

A tamanin ya take mata baya ya shiga gana mata ukuban da bai tab'a gana mata irin sa ba..... 



Naseer bai tashi sanin mahaifinsa ya rasu ba saida wasu ma'aikatan kampanin Baban sa suka tafi har makaranta suka masa ta'aziya. A ranar ya dawo gida yana kuka maimakon yaji kalaman lallashi daga bakin Innar sa sai bala'i data balbale shi dashi tana fad'in dawowar sa gida bazai sa Abban su ya dawo ba... 


Tun daga wannan lokaci abubuwa suka kuma sauyawa,  tsanar da Innah tayima Naseer ta kuma fitowa fili sosai,..

A b'angaren Innah bata fasa bibiyar Saudat ba don dama bin 'yan uwanta mata da take yasa mijinta na farko mahaifin Kabeer ya saketa, Saudat bata samu sauk'i da fitinar Innah ba har saida Fawaz da Lubna suka soma girma,  Innah ta koma bin 'yan mata a waje... Sannan Kabeer ma ya rage gana mata azaba tunda Fawaz ya soma girma,  saidai lokacin da Fawaz yakai mumzanin shiga jami'a ya bar k'asar a lokacin Kabeer da Innah suka d'aura linzamin gallaza ma Saudat tsoron kada ta sami kanta da yawa wataran ta fallasa su bak'in aikin da sukayi a shekarun baya....

An saka bikin Naseer da Shareefah nan da sati uku masu zuwa,  shirye-shirye babu kama k'afan yaro a duka family guda biyun... List d'in events Shareefah ta masa paper guda,  tun yana k'irgawa kama daga kan English night,  Arabian night,  barbeque, crossing of sword....... Kai k'arshe d'ago kai yayi yana dubanta ganin events d'in sunk'i k'arewa... 

D'ago takardan yayi yana juya lokaci guda yana dubanta yake fad'in "Shareefah what's this?...  This is ridiculous wad'annan events d'in sunyi yawa,  look I want a simple wedding,  wannan shirme ne ai da shiririta,  mu da muke neman albarka a auren mu mai zaisa mu cika kayan shed'an haka...."   ya d'an girgiza kai kana yaci gaba da fad'in "You perfectly well know me,  kin sanni kin san ni wani irin mutum ne, so pls karma mu fara...."


Shareefah ta kuma tura baki gaba tana fitowa daga cikin kujeran tana kuma bank'aro k'irji waje take fad'in "Amma dai Naseer kasan fah nice d'iyar fari a gidan nan,  kuma kasan Mamy tana son hidima sosai,  haba Naseer a ido kanada wayewa sosai,  sannan kamannin ka irin na western people don Allah kar ka ba dani....."


Had'e hannayensa yayi waje guda had'i da d'aura hab'arsa kan hannun nasa yana dubanta,  shi wllhi ya zaci girma zai sa Shareefah tayi hankali amma da alama har yanzu batayi ba..  Jinjina kai yayi kafin ya soma fad'in "Kina jina,  kamanni ne kawai nake dashi na western people sabida jininsu da nake dashi a tattare dani,  amma d'abi'u na da Al'aduna sun banbanta da nasu,  kuma banda abinki  auren da babu hayaniya ciki yafi k'argo da albarka...."


Shareefah ta cika tayi fam, sai faman shure-shuren k'afafu take alamun taji haushi...  Ko kulata bai kuma yi ba,  sai shafa wayar salulansa da ya shiga yi... 


Daga parlorn dasu Innah da Mamy da kuma wata k'awar Mamyn ke zaune Innah na hango su Naseer da Shareefah ta cikin k'ofar glass d'in da ya raba corridor d'in dake tsakankaninsu... 


Lokaci guda Shareefah sukayi ido hud'u da Innah...  Murmushi Innah ta sakar mata had'i da kashe mata ido guda.. 
  
Gaban Shareefah ya kuma yankewa ya fad'i,  wannan matar ga dukkan alamu bata manta had'uwarsu a wancan karan ba,  amma kuwa itama dole ta fito mata a asalin 'yar barikin ta ta haka ne kawai zasu wanye... 



Murmushi Shareefah ma ta sakar mata had'i da kashe mata idanu guda.. 



Bayan su Innah sun tafi Hajiya Laure k'awar Mamy gyara zama tayi sosai tana duban Mamy kafin tace "Asma'u wai wannan mata mai suffan kafiran farin itace uwar Naseer d'in,  chab toh ai ni na zaci Sa'oud Santanan mata biyu ke garesa,  kinsan barikin wannan matar kuwa...?"  ta k'arashe tana rik'e hab'a... 


Murmushi Mamy tayi kafin tace "Haba Laure  nifa da kika ganni nan banga barikancin da zai firgita ni ko ya bani tsoro ba muddin zan sami masu gidan rana,  nasan Innah nasan imanin ta kud'i ne, shiyasa ko zan tsiyance sai Shareefah ta auri d'anta, don nima kud'in nake farauta a wajen su,  kinsan da kud'i ake neman kud'i.....,  

Hajiya Laure rik'e da hab'a tana duban k'awar tata tace "Oh kice sai kanadashi akeyi da kai A DUNIYAR MU..."

Dariya suka fashe dashi lokaci guda suna masu tafe hannaye. 

****************

Tunda suka dawo daga Jama'are tunanin 'yar bafulatanar nan ya hana Affan sukuni,  bashida burin da ya wuce ya kuma sanyata a idanun sa,  ya tuna sanda ta fad'a cikin kashin shanu.. Shi kad'ai yayi murmushi yana tuno kalan kukanta abin burgewa,  yeah babu k'arya he's feeling something for her,  as a matter of fact baik'i su kasance kullum tare ba,..

A haka Naseer ya shigo office d'in ya samesa... Kallon mamaki ya bisa dashi ganin ya k'ura ma glass cup d'in hannunsa idanu shi kad'ai sai juyawa yake,  Naseer ya murmusa kafin ya kai hannu ya amshi cup d'in yace "Hey you alright?"

D'an sauk'e ajiyan zuciya Affan yayi kafin yace "You know she's.... quite different,  ka gane duk 'yan matan da nayi ta banbanta dasu,  kai banma tab'a had'uwa da irinta ba,  yeah quite alright da yawa daga cikinsu sun fita kyau but she's just different...."

Dr Basheer yaci gaba da fad'in "Wato a gaskiya Alh matarka already ta sami cutar _Amnesia_ ma'ana loss of memory, a condition d'inta ba komai zata iya tunawa ba,     saidai lokaci zuwa lokaci ciwon zai dinga motsa mata tamkar ta mai hauka,  a halin yanzu shirunta zaifi maganar ta yawa,...  Amma kar ka damu insha Allah zamuyi iya k'ok'arinmu wajen ganin tunaninta ya dawo......."

Baikai aya ba Innah ta katse sa da fad'in "Toh uban 'yan shisshigi ai ba cewa mukayi ka mata magani ba so muke mu tabbatar ko tanada sauran hankali......."

Daidai lokacin Naseer ya shigo idanunsa jazir,  kallo yake kan faman binsu dashi d'aya bayan d'aya kafin ya sauk'e idanunsa kan Aunty Saudat wacce take zaune jigum saman kujera kanta ya karkace gefe guda tamkar wacce ta shekara ashirin tana jinya,  a haka har ya k'arasa gabanta ya durk'usa yana mai son tabbatar ma kansa da gaske Amnesia ne ya kamata,  a hankali yake fad'in "Aunty pls talk to me,  ni ne Naseer....."


Kallon sa kawai Aunty Saudat take ba tareda ta iya furta koda kalma guda ba,  Alh Kabeer da tuni ya k'wak'ulo hawayen k'arya k'arasawa yayi ya kamo Naseer yana fad'in "Brother I can't believe my wife's suffering from amnesia,  Naseer bana so matata ta mance da ni......."  ya k'arashe cikin shesshek'ar kuka.... 


Kallo kawai Naseer ke binsa da shi zuciyar sa tak'i aminta da kukan da d'an uwan nasa keyi....  Duban Innah yayi kafin ya k'arasa gabanta idanunsa jazir ya soma fad'in "Meyasa bakiso ayi mata magani,  meyasa kike son cutar da ita,  na kasance mai biyayya a gareki amma kiyi hak'uri wannan karan bazan maki biyayya wajen cutar da rai ba,  wllhi tallhi zan bada gudumawa ta tan hanyoyi daban-daban har sai naga Aunty Saudat ta sami lafiya....."   Baikai aya ba Kabeer ya rungumesa yana fad'in "Naseer nima bansan meyasa Innah tayi wancan maganar ba amma nima nayi alk'awarin rashin kyautatawa bazai kuma shiga tsakanina da matata ba...."  Ya k'arashe yana watsa ma Innah wani irin mugun kallo...  Innah kuwa ko a jikinta ko kunya babu ta bud'e murya tana fad'in "Lallai 'ya'ya sun zama marassa biyayya ga mahaifansu A DUNIYAR MU,  Naseer har ni kake kalla cikin ido kana min rashin kunya son ranka akan waccar matar,  matar da bakasan kalan rashin kunyar da cin zarafin da ta min ba a lokacin bakada wayo......"



Cikin sauri Naseer ya katseta da fad'in "Wai meyasa bamu hak'uri bamu yafiya A DUNIYAR MU,  meyasa burin d'aukan fansa ya cika zuciyoyin mu,...."  ya d'an sassauta murya kafin ya k'araso gaban Innah sosai yana mai k'ank'an da kai yake fad'in "Innah ko me ta maki na tabbata yarinta ce a wancan lokacin sannan da zakiyi hak'uri da shi yafi alkhairi,  Innah Aunty Saudat d'iyarki ce,  Innah wannan d'aya ne daga cikin dalilai na na tsoron aure, Yaya yayi repenting gameda abubuwan da ya aikata a baya tunda gashi har likita ya d'auko sabida Aunty Saudat wanda a baya ban tab'a ganin hakan ba,  Innah don Allah kema ki tausasa wa matar nan, ki janye bak'in k'ullin da kike dashi akan......."   baikai aya ba Innah ta daka masa wani irin tsawa kafin ta shiga nuna masa k'ofa tana fad'in "Fice min a parlor shahararre maras kunya,  wanda baisan daraja da kima ta mahaifiyar sa ba,  fita nace...."

Azeema ta kuma tambaya....

Toh wllhi tallhi kar wacce ta kuma tako k'afa tazo wajena da sunan d'aukan Ilham... Ungrateful idiots...."  ta k'arashe had'i da jan tsaki kaman zata bangaje Azeema haka ta fice daga d'akin Azeema tayi saurin bata hanya tana kallon ikon Allah...

Cikin sauri ta karya kan motar ta d'auki hanyar TH yanda likitoci basu yankewa....

Allah sarki Falaq suna sonta suna son zama da ita,  inama Affan na nan bai koma Base d'insu ba da ta rok'esa ya kaisu sunga Falaq, ko wani hali take ciki yanzu sai Allah...  Kaman Ilham tasan tunanin da take lalumo hannayen Salma tayi kana tace "Salma ki daina damuwa insha Allah Falaq zata sami lafiya muyi mata addu'a nasan soyayyar mu yana tareda ita a duk yanda take daga ita har Addah...."  ta k'arashe muryarta na rawa...

Wani babban abin takaicin wai shine sai anbi layi....  Nafisa ce ta fad'o mata rai nurse d'in da taso taimakon su lokacin jinyar Inno...  Cikin sauri Jamila ta mik'e ta nufi neman Nafisa...  Bata wani sha wahala ba kuwa ta sameta...

Cikin sauri suka nufi fannin yaran... Mutane aunkuwa yi layi saman benches don ganin likita...  Haka Nafisa ta rik'o hannun Jamila suka kutsa..

Nafisa ta d'an sauk'e ajiyan zuciya sanda ta murd'a k'ofar ta d'an lek'a,  gaisar da Dr's d'in tayi su Dr D'alha ne kawai suka amsa ta dama Dr D'alha yana d'an sonta ne,  Dr Fago yasan da zancen sai zolayarta yake...  Nan ta fad'a masu buk'atar ta... 

Dr Fago yace "Toh ai kuwa kinga duk da majinyata a gabanmu saidai idan Dr Santana zaiyi alfarma... Sai sannan ta juya tana kallon Fawaz wanda ke faman wani minor research a cikin wayar sa baima san sunayi ba....  Ai Jamila bata jira amsar Nafeesa ba ta shige wuff tana fad'in "Pls ku taimaka min kar na rasata..."

Muryar da ya jiyo ya sanyasa d'ago kansa lokaci guda ya bar abinda yake yana dubanta... 



Kallon files d'in gabansa yayi kafin yace "Akwai file d'inki a nan...?"

Ki koma sai kinyi submitting file an kiraku sannan ki shigo ko kinfi wad'anda suka rigaki zuwa nan ne...?"

Baki sake Jamila ke kallonsa don wannan idan bata fisa ba zasu zo sa'anni 

D'an girgiza kai tayi kafin tace "Kana nufin na fita...?"

Idanunsa naga wayarsa yake fad'in " I'll be saying it twice if I say it again..."

Lokaci guda idanun Jamila suka kad'a sukayi jazir,  zare shades d'in dake mak'ale idanunta tayi tanai ma Fawaz wani irin duba lokaci guda ta k'arasa sosai har gaban table d'in nasa zuciyarta ta shiga tuno mata lokacin mutuwar Inno, cikin karaji ta soma fad'in "You're all the same.... You see you're not even serious ba likitoci bane kurum basuda kula kuma baku da kula,  baki tashi kinzo da wuri ba kin wuce mutane da dama wanda wasu tun farar safiya suke nan saida ciwon d'iyarki yayi tsanani kika taho,  kika tsallake d'umbin mutanen dake bisa layi sabida son zuciya irin taki kika ce lallai saidai a soma ganin d'iyarki bayan suma suna son 'ya'yan sun nan kaman yanda kike son naki,  in fact sunma fiki son yarn nasu tunda sun riga ki zuwa..."

Baisan sanda bakinsa ya bud'e ya soma fad'in "Yauma ya bugeki koh,  dukan ki ya kumayi koh...  Madam I'm sorry to say your husband is an Animal.... Baisan me yake yi ba in fact...."  bai kai aya ba ta tsresa da fad'in "Dr pls Falaq ce ka ceci ratuwarta kada ta mutu pls...."

Ta k'arashe tana mik'a masa yarinyar... Cikin sauri Fawaz ya amsheta suka nufi cikin ward d'in,  tuni wasu nurses biyu sun take masa baya....

Ya d'an girgiza kai had'i da fuzar da iska,  sam wasu halittan mutane ne kurum dasu amma sun maida kansu dabbobi na k'arfi da yaji, yana buk'atan yayi serious magana da mijin matar nan...

This is complicated,  idan ba macen aure ba yaya za'ayi tayi furucin da tayi jiya akan mijin ta...?   Ya jima yana nazarin abin shi kad'ai tambayoyi k'unshe cikin zuciyar sa babu mai basa amsa

I don't know ko a gidan iyayen ki kike zaune, amma ki sani duk wad'anda suke tare da ke suna ganin yana cin zarafinki haka basu d'auki k'wakk'waran mataki ba suma basu k'aunarki kuma basu kishin kansu ba balle su san kishin ki,  d'iya mace is a great treasure ga wanda ya sani...  I'm sorry idan kalamaina sunyi maki zafi,  I'm just saying the fact,  wllhi da inada iko akanki da na shigar dashi k'ara sannan bazan gajiya ba sai na gansa rot behind bars paying for his damn crime...."


I zuwa lokacin bugun zuciyar Jamila ya k'aru sosai,  fuzge jakan tayi niyyan yi amma kuma sai ta kasa,  jikinta yayi wani irin mugun sanyi...  Fawaz kuwa sakar mata jakan yayi kafin yace "Alfarma d'aya tak zan nema wajen ki, kuma inaso kimin wannan alfarman ne ba don ke ba sai don Baby Falaq.."

Yinin ranar zubur tunanin likitan nan ke damunta,  idan kuwa ta tuno Alh Kabeer saidai taji zuciyar ta na mata k'una,  harga Allah bata tab'a jin abinda take ji gameda likitan ga ko wani namiji ba,  dukda bata isa tace ga abinda take ji ba amma kam yanayi ne maras fasaltuwa,  gaba d'aya sai ta zamto sukuku da ita, a 'yan kwanakin ko samarukan ta bata kulawa,  Alh Kabeer kuwa harga Allah ta gaji da zama dashi,  bata tab'a tsammanin akwai namijin da zai faye mata kud'i ba sai yanzu,  gashi tunda Dr Fawaz ya amshi lambarta bai kira ba,  dukda yace dama ya karb'a ne sabida yaji lafiyar Falaq d'in....  Kullum wulak'anci safe daban na dare daban Alh Kabeer ke mata duk a dalilin d'iyarta ita kuwa sam bata jin zata iya rabuwa da Falaq a yanzu,  watarana haka zai kwaso damuwar sa ya jibgeta son ransa, bata tab'a sanin rayuwar bariki k'arya bane sai yanzu,  tabbas ta yarda Duniya mayaudariya ce,  domin kuwa a 'yan kwanakin har wani irin rama tayi,  gashi yanzu ba wani kud'i yake bata ba saidai yazo ya sauk'e buk'atar sa akanta cikeda cin zarafi..... Affan ya d'an fuzar da iska yana duban Shareefah kafin yace "See... Haka kurum kin fito dani,  banyi niyyan zuwa barikin nan yau ba..."

Shareefah tace "But Affan baka tunanin this is somehow strange... Ka kira Naseer kaji a yanda yake,  sannan ka tambayesa idan yana tare da Salma nemanta ake a gida,  I'm quite sure idan basu tare hankalin sa zai tashi..."

Affan shiru yayi yana subanta kafin yasa hannu a aljihu ya ciro wayar sa,  lokaci guda ya shiga kiran layin Naseer.....


Naseer yana ganin Affan ne mai kira saida ya d'ago ya kuma duban Salma da tuni ta mik'e tabi Momy kitchen tana tayata shirya 'yar tray d'in da take shirin serving d'insu... 


Shiru yayi yana sauraron Affan d'in kafin yace "You mean ba'a san ta fito ba a gida...?"

Affan ya jinjina kai tamkar Naseer d'in na ganinsa kafin yace "Yeah kuna ta ina...?"

Take Naseer ya sanar dashi yanda suke.. 

Shareefah ta dubi Affan bayan sun ida wayar kana tace "You See,  kaga abinda nake fad'a koh... That mere girl lied to you,  she doesn't love,  dama na fad'a bibiyan Naseer take....."

"Enough please...!!"  Affan ya katse ta kafin ya zura wayar a aljihu yana fad'in "Muje..."


Mamaki ne ya cika Shareefah da Affan jin Salma wajen Momy Lami tazo.... Gaba d'aya Shareefah ta rasa bakin magana sai k'arasawa da tayi tana hugging Salma take fad'in "Salma wllhi we were all worried about you ne....  Ai bamusan wajen wannan matar kika zo ba...."  ta k'arashe tana mai kallon raini wa Momy Lami... 

Affan kuwa harara kurum yake faman watsa wa Shareefah,  kaman ya tokareta haka yake ji don takaici... 

Naseer ya girgiza kai ba tareda ya furta komai ba,  Momy ce ta janyo hannun Salma suka keb'e


"Salma ina sauraren ki,  wacece ita wancan maras d'a'an.."

Saida Salma ta sauk'e ajiyan zuciya kafin tace "Ita ce Soja zai Aura...."

Momy tayi shiru tana nazarin abun don kuwa sam bata hango soyayyar Shareefah a idanun Naseer ba,  sannan koda basu furta ba shida Salma tana jin wani babban Al'amari a tattare dasu...  

Bayan sun fito tafiya ne Shareefah ta janyo hannun Salma suka d'an tsaya daga baya,  tamkar mai rad'a take fad'i mata....  "Ki kallesu suna son junansu tamkar Yaya da kuma k'ani so please don't try to bash their heads, ki tsaya a matsayin ki, ki k'aunaci Affan da zuciya guda sabida ina mai tabbatar maki yana k'aunarki beyond your expectation, ni kuma na maki alk'awari I'll be by your side bazan goyi bayan Azeema ta kasance da Affan ba..."

Murmushi Salma tayi kafin tace "Yo dama ina zaki goyi bayan d'an uwanki ya auri k'azama irinki ai dole ki masa fatan samun na gari kaman yanda nima nake fatan Soja ya sami ta gari... Ina fata kin fahimce ni..."

Murmushin yak'e Shareefah tayi kafin tace "Salma k'arfin halinki ka iya janyo maki rayuwa mai cikeda k'unci A DUNIYAR MU... "

Salma bata kai ga amsata ba suka jiyo muryar Naseer na fad'in "Wai me kuke tattaunawa ne haka,  kuyi sauri kuzo ku wuce gida hadari ya soma rufe garin..."

Shareefah ta bisa da mayen murmushi kafin tace "Eh my Soldier muna k'arasowa.."

Duban Salma ta kuma Yi kafin ta d'an karkata kai tace "Idan kunne yaji toh fah tabbas jiki ya tsira..."

Salma bata furta komai ba sai kallon tsana data raka Shareefah dashi... 


Affan ya lura da yanayin Salma,  a hankali ya bud'e murya yace "Salma are you alright...?"

Lokaci guda suka had'a idanu itada Naseer,  su duka sunama juna kallon da basu san sunayi ba... Saurin saita kanta tayi had'i da yin murmushin da yafi kama da yak'e kafin ta shiga gyad'a masa kai tana fad'in "Eh... Eh lafiya ta Lou...."  Shareefah ta d'an dafata tana mayaudariyar murmushi take fad'in "Kasan budurwar taka da kunya Allah dai ya kaimu lokacin bikin ku da zaran anyi namu..."

Affan ne daketa faman murmushin jin dad'i ya sami zarafin amsawa da ameen,  Salma da Naseer kam sam basu sami zarafin amsawa ba... 

Gaba d'aya sukayi sallama ma Naseer suka wuce gida Shareefah sai rawar kai take uwa angon biri, shi kuwa gogan sai basarwa yake yayinda Salma ta tsinci kanta da jin haushin abinda Shareefar keyi.. 

*******

Ana sauran kwana biyu d'aurin auren ya tattaro ya dawo gida,  gaba d'aya gidan nasu ya zama busy sosai,  mutane shige da fice kawai ake... 

Jamila ta sami sauk'in tak'urin Alh Kabeer, i zuwa wannan lokaci ta amince ma zuciyar ta shakka babu soyayyar wannan likitan ne ya kamata lokaci guda,  haka kurum taji tana son k'aurace ma sab'on da take,  a iya rayuwarta tayi zaton kud'i shine jin dad'in rayuwa, a tunanin ta maza basu wulak'anta matan titi sai na cikin gida tunda ta gani wajen mijinta na fari uban d'iyarta Alh Nuhu,  sai gashi wanda ya sameta a layin ma na wulak'anta ta,  tabbas Inno tayi gaskiya data masu hud'ubar tsare mutuncin su,  yau da ace bata hau motar kwad'ayi ba tabbas tasan da hakan bai faru da ita ba....  Ta kuma goge hawayen nadaman da suka zubo mata kafin ta d'auki paper da pen tayi note ta ajiye bisa dining table... D'aukar d'iyarta tayi ta sab'a had'i da tattara kayanta kana ta cika ma rigarta iska,  ko motar da ya bata ma bata d'auka ba.. 

*****

Naseer ya kuma duban Fawaz yana d'an ware idanu had'i da yin murmushi kafin yace "So tell me,  a ina take surkar tawa...."

Dariya Fawaz ya d'anyi yana mai kai spoon d'in trifle bakinsa yake fad'in "Uncle bazaka yarda dani ba sabida ni kaina ban yarda da abinda zuciyata take sanar dani ba shiyasa ma ban kuma bin takan ta ba, I don't know,  it just can't happened...."

Kallon sa Naseer yake yana nazarin sa,  sai yake jin labarin soyayyar  Fawaz tamkar nashi ne da Salma,  wacce tuni ya yak'i zuciyar sa a tunanin sa....  Saida ya sauk'e ajiyan zuciya kafin shima yakai chocolate truffle bakinsa kana yace "Fawaz whatever your heart keeps telling you ka zauna sosai kayi tunani akai,  so tari mukan so abu ya zamana a k'arshe bamu samu,  Allah yafimu sanin abinda yasa ya hanamu abinda muke so,  tsarin Allah shine dai-dai...  Son ka sani a kullum kana tare da addu'o'in mu,  bani da burin da ya wuce naga rayuwar ku ta inganta fiye da tawa,  all of you..."

Murmushi Fawaz yayi kafin yace "Uncle na gode,  na gode da kyawawan shawarwarin ka,  kai d'in daban ne...."

Murmushi Naseer yayi kafin ya d'an yi kafin ya mik'a hannun sa saman sumar Fawaz had'i da d'an barbaza suman kana yace "Ka gama ci muje kasan inada commitments sosai yau kada ka b'ata min schedules d'ina..."

Saurin tuttura abincin desert d'in nasa yayi kafin ya mik'e yana fad'in "Ni na isa na b'ata schedules d'in Soja salon a jefani a guardroom.... Koda yake Aunty Shareefah bazata bari ba..."

Dariya maras sauti Naseer keyi kafin ya d'an kama kunnen Fawaz yana fad'in "Ka faye son wasa bansan yaya akayi kayi karatun likitancin ba ma...."

Fawaz yana d'an k'ara had'i da dariya yake kama kunnen sa yanda Naseer ya ja... 

******

Tun daga gate d'in gidan kake jiyo sautin Kid'a na tashi alamun ana shirye-shiryen biki,  yau kusan kwana uku kenan ana banka Kid'a a gidan Mamy tunda aka shiga satin bikin  

Fawaz ne ke driving yayinda Naseer ke zaune mazaunin mai zaman banza, sai faman zuba Fawaz keyi dukda ba wani amsa sa Naseer d'in keyi ba... 

Kaman wacce aka jefo ta sai ganinta suka gabansu dai-dai lokacin da zasu karya kwanan gidan Daddy,  itama kuma gidan ta nufa... 

Da k'arfin gaske Fawaz ya danna birki had'i da horn....  Bakisu d'auke da ambaton Allah.. Naseer fad'i yake "Careful Fawaz....."

Taimakon Allah d'aya basu bi kanta ba gashi harda yarinya a hannun ta...  A tare suka fito suka nufi yanda take... 

Gaba d'aya burki sukayi domin kuwa Naseer ya gane Baby Falaq,  shi kuwa Fawaz baki har na rawa yake furta "Uncle itace.. Itace wacce nake fad'a maka..."

Mik'ewa Jamila tayi saurin yi tana duban Fawaz fuskar ta d'auke da murmushi take fad'in "Dr....".

  
Kallonta sosai Fawaz yayi kafin yace "Hope dai bakuji ciwo ba..."

D'an girgiza kai tayi kana tace "A'a bamuji ciwo ba.."

"Ina zaki da kaya haka....?"  Fawaz ya kuma tambaya.. 

Sai sannan Naseer ya furta "Inaga dai kinji rok'on 'yan uwanki ne kin dawo wajen su..."  yayi maganar fuskar sa d'auke da murmushi.. 

D'an murmushin yak'e tayi dukda ba wani gane Naseer d'in tayi ba ta dai ga shida Fawaz sunada zubin turawa k'ila duk yanda akayi d'an uwansa ne sannan ko ba'a fad'a ba sunada danganta da Alh Ali Safwan tunda gashi har sun san da zancen su... Lokaci guda kuma zuciyarta ta shiga bugu da sauri tana tunanin kada su Salma sun sanar dasu zaman bariki take.... 

Cikin sauri ta saita kanta tana mai ci gaba da jan trolley d'inta take fad'in "Barin k'arasa ciki.. Na gode..."  Sauri sauri ta shige ba tareda ta kuma dubansu ba dukda mafarkin sake ganin likitan da ta dinga yi...

Har saida ta shige gate kafin Fawaz ya d'auke idanunsa daga dubanta... 


A tare suka nufi motar sukayi horn mai gadi ya bud'e masu...  Naseer ya d'anyi gyaran murya kana yace "So wannan itace labarin da ka bani d'azu..."

Fawaz yayi saurin jinjina kai kana yace "Uncle a ina ka santa,  sannan wani magana naji kayi gameda ita...?"

Naseer ya d'an murmusa sanda yake parking gidan kuwa akwai mutane da dama sai kai komo ake ko k'yallin Jamila basu hango ba kafin yace " it's a long story Fawaz ka bini bashi sai an gama da hidimar bikin nan...."

D'an jinjina kai Fawaz yayi ba tareda ya kuma furta komai ba,  don kuwa gaba d'aya ya shiga rud'ani... 

A parlorn Daddy Shareefah ta masu masauk'i duk burin Fawaz na yazo ya gaida Auntyn nasa sai ya zama wani sukuku dashi,  abubuwa da dama suna yawo a kwanyar sa... 

****

Jamila kuwa kasancewar dakwai 'yan biki shiyasa sam ba'a lura da shigowar ta ba sai 'yan uwanta,  haka suka rungume juna suka kulle kansu a d'aki suka ci kukan su,  ko babu komai burinsu ya cika 'yar uwar su ta dawo garesu.... 


Su Mamy basu tashi lura da zuwan Jamila ba sai dare lokacin 'yan kaikomon shirye-shiryen biki sun watse.. 

Mamy tamkar mahaukaciya haka ta dinga bore tana fad'in wllhi karuwan nan bata da matsuguni a gidan ta..  Ilham kuwa dake rungume da Falaq d'inta kuka ta dinga yi tana rok'on Mamy da tayi hak'uri ta bar Addar su ta zauna...  Mamy tamkar wacce ake ingizata,  su Azeema kuwa sai kallon ikon Allan suke...  Saida Daddy yayi magana guda ya tabbatar babu yanda Jamila zata tafi zata zauna da 'yan uwan ta kaman kowa a cikin gidan...  Haba nan fah Mamy ta kuma birkicewa ta shiga haurawa sama da cangwalellen k'afarta tana kwaso kayan su Salma tana watsar waje....  

Basu sami daman saita Mamy a gidan ba saida Affan ya kwarkwance mata gaba d'aya ya nuna mata shima zai bar gidan har ya shiga jibga kayan sa a mota tamkar Affan d'inta na da....  Duk hak'urin da Mamy ke bashi yak'i ji yak'i gani,  dama haka yake idan ransa ya b'aci... 

Mamy ta kuma rik'o rigarsa tana fad'in "Affan ka min rai kada ka tafi..."

Fizge rigarsa ya kuma yi yana wani irin huci yake fad'in "Zan tafi a karni a filin yak'i sai ki huta,... Ina son Salma,  ina son aurenta soon,  a haka ne da wannan d'abi'ar taki zan aureta cikin kwanciyan hankali....  Bazaki tab'a barin rayuwata cikin kwanciyar hankali ba gwara na tafi ki rasa ni gaba d'aya ki huta...."

Girgiza kai Mamy take tana fad'in "Wllhi Affan na tuba na yarda su zauna... Idan ka tafi aka kashe ka nima binka zanyi Affan..."

Ganin tana kuka sosai ya sanya Affan karkatowa had'i da rungumeta,  yana son Mamynsa sosai amma baison halinta ko kad'an... 

K'wallan da Salma ke k'ok'arin mayarwa ya kasa komawa saida ya zubo,  Affan ya cancanci ya mallake ta koda babu d'igon soayyar sa a zuciyarta,  tabbas ta yarda Affan masoyinta ne,  ta yarda zai iya komai wajen kareta da 'yan uwanta..  

A hankali Jamila ta tako ta rungume Salma ganin hawaye na zuba bisa k'uncin ta... 

Duk wannan drama da ake yi Daddy bai fito ya saurara ba,  don yanaji k'iris ya rage bak'in cikin Asma'u ya haifar masa da mummunar cuta.. A halin da ake ciki ma ba wani jin dad'in jikinsa yake ba....  Ya yanke shawarin zaije ya sameta da dare suyi magana sosai bayan kowa ya kwanta,  don tunda ta soma hidiman biki ta k'aurace wa d'akin Daddy sabida idan tanacan bazata samu ta dinga waya da Laure son ranta ba,  ta turata can bakin border a had'o wa Shareefah kayan mallakan miji ta hanya tsafi da Asiri,  Laure kuwa sana'a ta bud'e mata don duk wani gudumawa da ake kawowa tuni Mamy take tura mata... 


Ko kad'an basuji alamun tab'a k'ofan parlor ba,  da shike sun jima suna kallo suna hira a parlorn har suka soma aikata sab'on nasu a parlor,  sam basuyi tunanin akwai mai shigowa ba... 

Kasa ci gaba da tura keken sa yayi sai hawaye dake gangaro masa... Innalillahi wa Inna ilaihirraji'un..  Cikin kunnuwar sa yake jiyo sautin Shareefah tana fad'i ma Azeema "Baby zanyi kewarki na d'an lokuta,  da zaran an gama zaman amarci zamu ci gaba daga yanda muka tsaya..."  Ta k'arashe su duka suna masu sunbatu ma juna 

Jiri ne ke neman kada Daddy daga saman wheelchair d'insa...  Shareefah,  Shareefah dai d'iyarsa,  ko tsawon shekaru nawa suka d'auka suna aikata wannan mummunar sab'o a gidansa wa ya sani,  wai itace yake shirin aurar da ita a gobe.... 


Ikon Allah ne ya isar da Daddy parlorn sa amma yanda yaga rana haka yaga dare... 


A b'angaren Salma ma bata wani sami bacci ba tunanin rayuwar dake shirin tunk'aran Soja ya hanata sukuni...  Dole tayi shiru a d'aura auren nan ko don Daddy da Affan,  suna da zuciya mai kyau,  sanin abun zai iya jefa rayuwar su cikin garari musamman Daddy... 

******
Yayinda aka ci gaba da shagalgulan biki,  shiko Daddy tunanin hanyar da zai b'ullo wa lamarin yake,  da ace fad'a masa akayi ba gani yayi ba,  toh kuwa shakka babu zai musa...  Saidai kuma shid'in ganau ne ba jiyau ba,  tabbas aura wa Naseer Shareefah akwai babban cutarwa a ciki,  sannan tabbas bazai iya fitowa fili ya sanar da Naseer ga laifin da d'iyarsa keyi ba....  Gaba d'aya Daddy Ya sauya 

Su Shareefah amarya kuwa tuni ancigaba da shagulgulan events


****

Kallon Mamy kurum yake yanda take faman rawan k'afa,  tun farar safiya algaita ke faman tashi a gidan...  Musamman ta shirya Daddy yau babu hantara balle tsangwama..  Abinda ya d'an bawa Mamy mamaki shine duk yanda Daddy Ya d'aukaki auren nan a baya taga yau ya sauya,  ya koma wani iri haka nan,  ko magana baya yi... Tuni ta danganta hakan da kewar Shareefah da zaiyi... 


A b'angaren Innah ma fah babu sauk'i yau har hula ita ta saka wa Naseer  ta feshe sa da turaruka.. Fawaz da Lubna kuwa sai zolayar su suke.. Irin Innah na murna za'a kuma yin surka.. Cikin zuciyar Innah kuwa fad'i take _Wannan surkar zuwanta yafi mata zuwan ko wacce surk dad'i,  zata yarda Naseer k'wallon mangoro ta huta da k'uda..._

Kana ganin Naseer kaga ango,  babbar rigar ta amshe sa abinka da wanda bai saba sakawa ba sai yayi matuk'ar masa kyau..  Duk yanda ya wuce watsa k'amshi yake, Marok'a kuwa tun daga gida suke biye dashi suna wasa sa.. Fari mai farin Aniya...


K'arfe sha d'aya na safiyar ranar asabar aka hallara a masallacin juma'a dake gefen gidan Daddy don d'aura auren Naseer Sa'oud Santana da kuma amaryar sa Shareefah Ali Safwan.. 


Daga gidan Mamy kana iya jiyo loudspeaker d'in masallacin... 



Bibbiyu Mamy ta soma gani sanda taji sunan da bata tab'a tsammani ba na tashi cikin loudspeaker ma'ana da ita ake d'aurin auren... 

Wani k'ara ta saki tamkar zararriya lokaci guda tayi watsi da crutches d'inta tana shirin zubewa a k'asa jama'an dake wajen suka tallafe ta...

Daga Naseer har Affan mik'ewa sukayi cikin wani irin yanayi...  Kallon juna suke yayinda masu algaita suka ci gaba da busawa daga waje domin kuwa tuni an d'aura aure....  


Girgiza kai Affan yake hawaye na kwararo masa lokaci guda,  ji yake tamkar mafarki yake ba gaskiya bane... Ta yaya za'a masa irin wannan butulci da cin amana....  Kasa furta komai yayi sanda ya tabbatar gaskiya ne ba mafarki ba.... Baisan yaya akayi ya fice ba shidai kurum yasan duniyar ta soma juya masa,  bibbiyo yake kallon jama'an dake tare a wajen kunnuwar sa 
suna jiyo masa sauti tamkar daga nesa-nesa..... Idan ba wani ikon Allah ba yana gab da zubewa.. 


Fifita ake kanyima Mamy masu Kid'an data kwaso kuwa basu daina ba,  mutane sai mamaki suke domin kuwa kafin a sanar da wannan d'aurin aure Mamy tafi kowa takawa dukda macogal d'in k'afarta sai gashi tayi watsi da crutches lokaci guda... 


Hannu aka Mamy ke ihu tana birgima a k'asa tamkar 'yar bori take fad'in ta shiga uku ta mutu ta lalace...  Mutane kuwa sai fifita suke mata 

Batasan sanda tayi fatali da makeup kit d'in mai shera mata kwalliya ba sanda Azeema ta kai mata labarin da d'uminta, ta fito tana wani irin ihu tayi hanyar waje saidai kafin ta fice Azeema ta shiga kiran masu Kid'an nan su taimaka mata a shigar da Shareefah d'aki a kulle....  Taro fah ta birkice gaba d'aya

Duk wannan bidiri da ake su Salma basu sani ba suna can d'akin su,  ita tana jimamin Soja ya zama mijin Aunty Shareefah yayinda Ilham da Jamila ke shiryawa,  da shike akwai sautin kid'a na tashi a cikin gidan shiyasa sam basu jiyo k'aran speaker d'in masallacin ba,  mutanen dake haraban gidan ne kawai suka iya jiyowa... 


Wani fincika Shareefah tayi ta nufi d'akinsu Salma yanda kasan sabuwar kamun hauka... 


A tamanin suka mik'e gaba d'aya suna rarraba idanu..... Azeema sai k'ok'arin janye Shareefah take ....


Kai tsaye Salma ta nufa tana wani irin kuka mai sauti take fad'in "Salma kin cuce ni,  ke azzaluma ce,  kin rantse sai kin rabani da Soja.... Ki zuba ruwa a k'asa ki sha... Amma wllhi wllhi wllhi ni Shareefah bazan tab'a barinku ku rayu cikin aminci A DUNIYAR MU ba,  wllhi sai na zame maku fitina ta ko....."   bata iya k'arasawa ba sai zubewa da tayi a wajen....  Azeema tayi saurin tallabo ta yayinda Jamila ta taya ta...... 

Gaba d'aya sun zama confused babu kaman Salma wacce garin ya soma juya mata,  bata fahimci komai ba a duk abubuwan da Shareefah ta fad'i.....  Batasan yaya akayi ba amma ta ganta zaune saman gado Ilham na rik'e da hannayen ta.... 



Murmushi Daddy keyi hawaye na neman kwararowa daga idanunsa sanda suka fito daga cikin masallacin yana mik'a wa Naseer hannu wanda ya koma tamkar mutum mutumi tun bayan shud'ewar wasu dak'ik'ai.... Wai yau shi Naseer Santana shine ya zamto mijin SALMA...  Yau rana ce da ya kamata a d'aura aurensa da Shareefah sai kuma akasin hakan,  sannan da ace ba mahaifin Shareefah bane yayi wannan aure tabbas zaice b'atan suna yayi amma sai gashi sadakin da ya bayar domin auran Shareefah an d'aura masa aure da watan ta..... 

Kasa mik'a ma Daddy hannu yayi suyi masabaha sai girgiza kai da yake cikin tsananin rud'ani yake furta "Daddy I'm confused..... I need an explanation... Daddy please what's going on.... Daddy don Allah ka sanar dani..."

Cikin sauri Fawaz ya k'araso ya rik'e uncle d'in nasa tausayin sa fal zuciyar sa...


Alh Ali Safwan hannu yasa ya goge hawayen da suka zubo masa kafin yace "Naseer ka sani bazan tab'a cutar da kai ba,  sannan ka sani a rubuce take SALMA itace matarka,  ina fata zakayi na'am da canjin da na maka....."

Naseer ya ci gaba da girgiza kai yana fad'in "Daddy still ban gane ba,  ban gane komai ba....."

Hannun Naseer dake tsaye kansa Alh Ali ya kamo kafin yace "Mu shiga cikin gida na maka bayani....  

Kasancewar dakwai mutane da dama a bakin masallacin da kuma gate d'in gidan yasa basu samu shigewa cikin gidan lokaci guda ba saida Daddy Ya tsaya yana gaisawa da jama'a yana masu godiya,  shi kuwa Naseer tamkar wani hoto haka yake rik'e da wheelchair d'in Daddyn, Fawaz na biye dasu don bazai iya barin Uncle d'in nasa cikin wannan yanayi ba... 

Fawaz ne ya d'an keb'e da wani abokin Naseer d'in Captain Sadiq suka d'anyi magana... Kafin Captain Sadiq ya sami sauran Friends d'in nasu 


Kaman wata mahaukaciya haka ta dinga koran mutane 'yan biki tana fad'in biki ya watse,  wasu har dukansu da crutches d'inta take tana fad'in su fice su bar mata gida,  masu Kid'a ma haka ta fafure su,  Mamy ta koma tamkar zautacciya... Dama babu danginta da ta gayyata balle na mijinta,  waye ma zaizo hidimar Mamy matan da bata so kowa nata ya rab'eta,  Azeema dai da ta zame mata k'arfen k'afa itace ke tare dasu tamkar wacce tasha fitsarin kaza sabida rashin zuciya da kuma son abun duniya da ya rufe mata idanu ko soyayyar d'an Mamy da ya rufe mata idanu.... 


A d'ari biyu Azeema ta nufo k'asa tana k'walla kira wa Mamy tana nuna mata hanyar cikin gida tana fad'in "Mamy kizo kar mu rasa Shareefah sai sumewa take... Mamy don Allah kizo..."


Ai babu shiri Mamy ta sab'i crutches d'inta ta soma cangwalawa ta nufi ganin d'iyarta kafin ta dira masu Salma ta masu uwar watsi tunda tasan yau kam saidai Affan ya goya mata baya.... 

Mamy tayi kan Shareefah tana kuka take fad'in "Shareefah ta kar ki tafi ki barni,  an zalunce mu kam amma ki sani d'aukan fansa ya zame mana wajibi...." sai faman bubbuga fuskar Shareefah take tana hawaye.. 


Azeema dake gefe murmushin jin dad'i kurum take domin kuwa plan d'inta ya tafi dai-dai,  A daren da Daddy Ya kamasu tsaf taji zuwan Daddy tak'i tayi alerting Shareefah sabida tasan babu yanda za'ayi Daddy yaga tana wannan laifi ya aura mata Naseer,  sannan tasan Daddy bazaiyi tunanin bawa Naseer makauniya ba sabida zaiga kaman ko don ba shi ya haifesa bane yasa ya bashi mai nakasa,  sannan tasan bazai tab'a bawa Naseer Jamila ba sabida Naseer auren budurwa ya nema Daddy bazai sauya masa da bazawara ba... Tasan dole Salma ce kawai Daddy zaiyi replacing d'inta da Shareefah... Idan kuwa haka ta kasance tasan Affan bazai tab'a samun Salma ba k'areshe dole itace zata mallaki kayan ta..... Ta kuma yin wani murmushi tana duban Shareefah da Mamy da suka koma abin tausayi lokaci guda....  Bata mance ranar data lab'e taji suna fad'in da zaran Shareefah ta auri Naseer zasu san yanda zasuyi su rabu da ita....  Tabbas ganinta kawai suke amma ta wuce tunanin su nesa ba kusa ba.....

Daddy ya umarci Naseer ya haura dashi parlornsa na sama...

Naseer ya dubi Fawaz kana ya masa alama kan ya jira sa a waje....

Jamila ce kawai ta sami zarafin girgiza masa kai kana tace "Dr dole mu bar gidan nan don tsira da rayuwar Mu, bazan iya bari rayuwar 'yar uwata ya shiga garari ba....."  Ta k'arashe tana kuma rik'o hannun Salma wacce gaba d'aya hankalinta baya tare da ita,  kana ganinta zaka iya shaida hakan.. Gani take abubuwan kaman a wasan kwaikwayo suke faruwa koma da ace mafarki ne da sai tafi aminta wa zuciyarta,  tabbas ta kasa yarda hakan a gaske yake faruwa... 

Fawaz ya d'an girgiza kai kafin yace "A'a a halin yanzu Uncle shike da iko da Salma,  don Allah kuyi hak'uri ku koma cikin gida insha Allah komai zai zama normal..."

Aya ya dasa wa maganar nasa hango Mamy da sukayi ta nufi sashen Mamy tamkar zata tashi sama,  sai ka rantse bada crutches take tafiya ba..... 

Ko kallo basu ishe Mamy ba tasa kai sai tafiya take,  gaba d'aya suka bita da kallo daga Jamila har Fawaz idan ka d'auke Salma da ba fahimtar komai take ba,  Ilham kuwa ba gani take ba,  damuwar halin da 'yar ywarta ke ciki shi ya cika zuciyarta... 


Gyaran murya Daddy yayi zai soma magana Mamy ta turo k'ofar ta shigo tana wani irin tururi da huci tankar zakanya, ko kallo Naseer bai isheta ba,  idanunta naga Ali Safwan tamkar wacce zata rufesa da duka haka take dubansa.... 

Ganin yanayin Mamy d'in yasa Daddy d'an dafa Naseer wanda yayi zaman rak'umi a gefensa bisa carpet kafin yace "Naseer kayi hak'uri kaje gida,  zan nemeka zuwa dare sannan na baka matarka ka tafi da ita..."

Jinjina kai Naseer yayi ba tareda ya iya furta koda kalma kafin ya mik'e ya fice ba tareda ya iya duban Mamy ba,  itama Mamy d'in ko kallo bai isheta ba,  har i zuwa lokacin idanunta na bisa Ali Safwan.... 


Salma tana hango Naseer ya fito daga sashen Daddy k'irjinta ya buga tamkar an sauk'e guduma... Kafin su ankara sai gani sukayi ta runtuma a guje ta koma cikin gida...   Sai sannan Jamila da Fawaz suka kula da abinda ya sanyata gudu hango Naseer da tayi ne...  Fawaz ya d'an dubi Jamila dake rungume da Falaq hannunta guda rik'e da Ilham kafin yace "Ki kula da 'yar uwarki don Allah,  tana buk'atar kulawan ki sosai,  barin k'arasa wajen Uncle Naseer...."

Zan wuce dubo Affan kaga baya cikin gidan nan,  kuma na kira can barikin mu ance baije can ba,  sannan baya d'aga wayata...."  Shiru ya d'anyi had'i da dafe kai.. 

Fawaz kuwa girgiza kai yayi kana yace "Uncle bazan iya tafiya na barka cikin wannan halin ba,  idan nemo Affan zakaje saidai mu tafi tare, in fact I can't even let you drive a halin da kake ciki..."

Naseer ya d'an fuzar da iska yana duban Fawaz kafin ya d'an jijjiga kafad'unsa yace "Fawaz zan I...  I can go through this, I know I can....  Na sani komai muk'addari daga Allah.. Sannan Allah baya d'aurawa rai abinda bazata iya ba,  kar ka damu Son,  na gode da kulawar ka,  kaje gida pls, kaima kana buk'atar hutu...."


D'an jinjina kai kurum Fawaz yayi ba wai don yayi niyyan tafiyar ba,  tausayin Uncle d'in nasa fal zuciyarsa,  k'arfin hali kawai yake amma kam babu wanda irin wannan abu zai faru dashi ba tareda wani k'wakk'waran bayani ba ya zama dai-dai.. Saidan kawai dama Uncle d'in nasa jarumi ne,  shi ya sani...

Sallama sukayi kafin had'i da fatan alkhairi ma juna kafin suka shige moticinsu...

Ya jima yana zaune k'asar bishiyan hawaye na neman gangaro masa,  tabbas da zaiyi kukan da sai yafi jin dad'i akan k'uncin da ta tare masa cikin zuciyar sa...  A hankali yake furta "Why all this... Why... Why..  Shareefah was right... Gaskiya ta fad'i da tace suna son juna,  Naseer na tabbata samun Daddy kayi ka sanar dashi Salma kake so,  nasan Daddy Na,  nasan kalan kyautatawar sa,  nasan bazai tab'a maka abinda baka so ba Naseer, ...... I was stupid da na yarda ba son Salma kake bar.... Meyasa zaka min haka,  sabida nayi breaking heart d'in 'yar uwarka Lubna,  shine bari ka rama ta hanyar rabani da Salma.. The love of my life... Why Naseer... Meyasa zaka min haka...."  Muryar sa ta soma rawa lokaci guda... 

Wani irin huci Affan ya shiga yi,  lokaci guda ya dunk'ule hannunsa ya shiga kai duka ma bishiyar da iyaka k'arfinsa... Hawayen azaba suna tsartsafowa daga idanun sa... 


******


Girgiza kai Daddy yayi hawaye na kuma zubo masa yake fad'in "Kin sani Asma'u kika kasa sanar dani,  why... Meyasa,  meyasa baki sanar dani ba, sabida ha'inci da son zuciya... A haka ne kike so mu baiwa Naseer mu cuci bawan Allah,  sabida d'iyarmu ce, na tabbata bazaki so Affan ya auri Azeema ba abokiyar fasik'ancin nata... Kuma wllhi kinji na rantse da mahallici na sai na sanar da Naseer dalilina na hanasa auren tilon d'iyata mace na kuma Aura masa Salma.... Sannan nasan idan nayi bayani wa Affan zai fahimce ni inhar na isa dashi..Don haka ki fice min a d'aki banson ganin ki Asma'u...."  ya k'arashe yana goge k'wallan dake ciko idanunsa... 

Mamy na huci taci gaba da fad'in "Kai Ali wllhi wllhi baka isa ba,  dole ka warware auren shiriritan da kayi..... Kai nifa yanzu bakada sauran amfani a wajena domin kuwa baka da komai yanzu,  sai zama bisa keken guragu,  duk fad'i tashin da nake na ganin Shareefah ta auri Naseer inace sabida rayuwar mu ta inganta nake,  banda tsiya babu komai a tattare da kai,  sun tsafe ka sun baka a damun fura ka sha,  ka gwammaci rayuwar wancan tsinanniyar yarinyar ta inganta akan na d'iyarka... Toh wllhi baka isa ba,  bazan tab'a bari ka sanar da Naseer komai ba...."

Shareefah tana mik'ewa ta nufo parlor a tamanin nan ta tarar dasu Salma sunyi jigum-jigum kaman masu makoki.. Kwalliyan fuskar ta duk ta zazzago ta koma tamkar Zombie... Mamy bata fasa turasa tana cangwala crutches d'inta take fad'in "Uwar da na sani ne..
