Tana kaiwa nan ta gungura keken nasa ya soma gangarowa daga saman bene... Sai huci take tana hura Hanci... Lokaci guda Azeema ta saki gigitaccen k'ara sai sannan Mamy ta kula da ita...

Shareefah kuwa ganin mahaifinta na kwance cikin jini ga keken sa a gefe ya sanyata sakin wani mahaukacin k'ara tayi kansa tana jijjigasa tana kuka sosai take ambato sunan sa....

Jamila ce ta ciro wayarta a rud'e tayi dialing lambar Fawaze... Baiko isa gida ba yaga wayar Jamila... Hankali tashe ya karya kan motar sanda yaji abunda take sanar dashi daga cikin wayar,  ga koke-koke  da yake jiyowa daga cikin wayar.... 

Mamy ma a tamanin ta kwanta saman Daddy da Shareefah tana kuka sosai sai ka rantse iyakacin gaskiyarta kenan... Azeema ce kurum ke watsa wa Mamy mugun kallo...

Duk joints d'in da yake tunanin zai sami Affan wajen bai same sa bar.. Yana tsaka da driving wayar Fawaz ya shigo masa.. Nan Fawaz d'in ke sanar dashi abinda ke faruwa...

Azabane ya ishe sa baisan sanda ya had'a Innah waje guda yayi jifa da ita ta bugu da jikin kujera ba..

Baikai aya ba Affan dake faman turiri ya dunk'ule hannu yakai ma Deeni wata wawan naushi a hanci wanda saida yasa Deeni juyin masa kafin ya zube a k'asa... Daga haka motar sa ya wuce cikin sassarfa lokaci guda ya bar k'ofan gidan a guje....

Deeni shi ya saving d'ina...."

Ina ce duk akan ta ne,  sabida ita ka koma something else.. Fine,  zan saketa da zaran Daddy Ya sami lafiya ya fayyace mana komai... And I promise babu abinda zai shiga tsakani na ita... I won't allow you to go astray a dalilin rasa macen da kake so... "

Saida ya d'an fuzar da iska had'i da bud'e hannaye kafin yaci gaba da fad'in "I....I... I know you love him..... And yeah... He loves you as well,  Salma Affan yana sonki... Ko kad'an banso na zamto sanadin rabuwar ku....."   Kasa ci gaba da maganan yayi lokaci guda 


Salma kuwa izuwa lokacin ta kasa rik'e kukan da take k'ok'arin rik'ewa..... Kuka take tana k'ok'arin toshe bakinta bata so sautin kukan nata ya fito  .....


K'uri Naseer ya mata tausayinsu su duka biyu na ratsa zuciyar sa....  A tunanin sa sabida tsananin son Affan da Salma keyi take wannan kuka... Gashi a b'angaren sa soyayyar ta kullum growing yake cikin zuciyar sa bayan giftawan ko wani dak'ik'a.... 


A hankali ya mik'e daga kujeran da yake zaune a kai ya k'araso gaban kujeran da take ya d'an durk'usa gabanta.....  Kukan Salma ya k'aru... Duk juriya irinta Naseer hawaye ne yaji suna neman ciko idanunsa sabida tausayin kansa da rayuwar da zaiyi babu Salma a tare dashi,  gashi dai ya sameta amma ya sani su biyun are not meant to be together.... Yana son farin cikin Salma sannan yana son farin cikin Affan,  bazai zamto sanadin yankewan farin cikinsu ba... 

Cikin sanyin murya ya soma fad'in "I promise bazan zamto sanadin k'uncin ku A DUNIYAR MU ba,  Salma both you and Affan kunada matsayi a wajena....  Zan iya sadaukar da farin cikin ratuwata ma dukan ku biyu,  as far as zaku kasance cikin farin ciki....."   Kasa ci gaba da magana yayi jiyo sautin kukan nata k'aruwa yake...... Gaba d'aya zuciyar sa ta kuma yin weak,  izuwa lokacin bazai iya juran ganin kukan nata ba... Bai san yaya akayi ba shidai kawai ya tsinci kansa yana mai rungumar ta...   Sosai ya matse ta cikin jikinsa, murya na rawa yake fad'in "Please ki daina kukan nan....  It hurts....  It really does hurt... Look I promise da zaran Daddy ya sami lafia... I.... I'll divorce.....you,  and.... and finally zaki kasance da Affan... the love of your life...."   

Bai saketa ba bata daina kukan da take ba.... Duk dauriya irinta Naseer saida yaji siriryar hawaye tana neman fitowa daga idanunsa... Tsananin tausayin su yake ji su duka uku,  shi kansa,  Affan da kuma Salma.. Tabbas da zuciya tana shawartan mutum kafin ta soma son wani abu ko k'in wani abu, tabbas da basuyi tarayya akan soyayyan mace guda ba shida aminin sa.... 



Sandarewa Affan yayi yana kallon su yanda Naseer ya rungume Salma kaman zai maidata cikin sa... Zuciyan Affan ta kuma karaya,... Tabbas sabida maganar da Naseer ya fad'a masa ya sa shi zuwa gidan,  Naseer ya sanar dashi babu abinda zai shiga tsakanin sa da Salma hasalima sakinta zaiyi..... Sai gashi ya tadda akasin haka....  He was stupid da ya yarda ma ransa Naseer zai saki Salma.....  Zuciyarsa ta shiga masa zafi....  Cikin sauri ya juya ya fice daga gidan yana kallon hanya bibbiyu..... 



Saurin k'watan kanta tayi daga rik'on da Naseer ya mata lokaci guda ta mik'e ta nufi k'ofa har lokacin idanunta basu daina zuban ruwa ba..... 

Saurin mik'ewa yayi ya tare gabanta lokaci guda rinannun idanunsa akanta... 

"Soja please....."  ta kasa ci gaba da maganar. 

Girgiza mata kai yayi kana yace "No Salma bazan barki ki fice kina kuka ba....  Baki san kukan ki yanada zafi da rad'ad'i ba....?"

Yanayin maganar nasa ya sanyata saurin d'ago idanu tana dubansa... Lokaci guda kuma ta sauk'e kanta k'asa....  Ta sami kanta tana mai jinjina kai had'i da goge hawayen fuskar ta... 

Murmushi Naseer yayi kafin ya d'an sassauta murya yace "Look up,  d'ago kanki na gani ko hawayen ya k'are gaba d'aya..."

Murmushi tayi still kanta a k'asa.. 

Naseer ya soma takowa daf da ita... Bugun k'irjinta ya k'aru...  Saida ya k'araso dap ita sosai yana ganin tsakiyar kanta kafin ya d'an rage tsawonsa yasa hannu ya tallafo fuskar ta lokaci guda yasa hannu ya shiga share mata hawayen su duka sunyi k'uri ma juna ba tareda sanin sunyi d'in ba.... 

Salma ce ta d'anyi yunk'urin matsawa baya saidai kuma tuni Naseer ya rik'o kunkuminta yana duban Face d'inta sosai itama cikeda tsoro take dubansa... 

A hankali yake sakin sassanyar murmushi kana yace "Duk sanda kika kuma yin kuka ko bani a wajen zan jiyo ki so ko kin koma gida babu kuka kinji....."

Murmushi tayi wanda yafi kama da yak'e dukda ragowar hawayen dake idanunta kafin ta shiga gyad'a masa kai da sauri tana k'ok'arin k'watan jikinta take fad'in "Soja..please.... Let go..."

Murmushin  ya sakar mata kafin ya cikata a hankali had'i da saita kansa...  "Muje na maidaki gida...."   ya fad'i yana d'aukan wayar sa saman kujera..... 

Ai Salma kam tuni tayi gaba ta fice a zaton ta Momy Lami tana nan waje har lokacin tana jiransu.. Tsigar jikinta sai faman tashi yake tunda Naseer ya rungume ta.. Ta kasa yarda da abinda ya faru tsakanin su biyun,  maganganun da Naseer ya fad'a mata suka shiga yawo a kwanyarta lokaci guda zuciyarta ta shiga mata zogi wato dai Soja baya sonta, Aunty Sharefah yake so... 

Muryarsa ta jiyo yana fad'in "Muje koh...".


Ba tareda ta dubesa ba baki a ture tace "Toh ai banga Momy ba..."

Naseer ya d'an murmusa had'i shafa sumar kansa kana yace " Tasan a good company ta barki shiyasa ta tafi...."  ya k'arashe teasingly 

Bata kuma cewa komai ba don shirun nata yafi mata sauk'i... Tafiya suke su duka biyun babu mai cewa komai,  kowannen su da tunanin da yake cikin zuciyar sa.. Salma kuwa sai buga sauri take don ko kad'an bata so su jera da Sojan saidai abinka da Soja wanda dama tafiyar nasa yafi kama da sassarfa sam ta kasa tsere masa... 

*******


Murmushi Affan ya saki sanda ya tuno kalan rungumar da ya ga Naseer yama Salma... Lokaci guda yayi jifa da kwalban giyan ta fad'i ta fashe...  Is like shi kad'ai ne ke shan wahala su suna can suna cin soyayyar su... Lokaci yayi da zai tarwatsa masu farin cikin da suke ciki.... Ya saki wata murmushi kafin ya soma furta  "Naseer idan Salma bata cikin kwanciyar hankali toh kuwa tabbas kaima bazaka kasance cikin kwanciyar hankali ba...  Zan tarwatsa Farin cikin da kuke ciki kaman yanda kuka tarwatsa min nawa...  I want to see you suffering...."   ya k'arashe yana hura hanci... Hanyar da zaibi don wahalar dasu ya shiga nemowa.... Lokaci guda ya saki murmushi sanda ya tuna makauniyar k'anwar Salma... A fili ya furta "Yeah.. The blind one...."   Lokaci guda kuma yayi bursting cikin tsananin dariya had'i da zubewa saman kujera... 


******


Jamila na murmushi ta kuma dungurin Salma ganin har lokacin sam babu walwala a tattare da ita kafin tace "Ke wllhi kun bala'in dacewa baki gani ba sanda kuka jero...."

Salma dai bata ce komai ba sai tab'e baki da tayi....  Jamila ta kuma murmusawa had'i da kashe mata idanu kana tace "Zama ki daina wannan nok'e-nok'en ne sabida ni nasan kina son sa...."

Wani kallo Salma ta galla mata. In a furious tune take fad'in "Ni nace ina son shi... Allah Ya sawwak'e ni....  Wllhi bana sonshi nima kaman yanda baya sona, Addah Wllhi Anty Shareefah Soja yake so...."  ta k'arashe hawaye na neman zubo mata... 
Tausayin ta Ya cika Jamila,  a hankali ta rungumeta tana lallashin ta.... 


Da dare Naseer kasa barci yayi, idan ya runtse idanu saidai ya hango fuskar Salma tana kuka...  Haka kurum zuciyar sa ta dinga raya masa k'ila har yanzu kuka take.. Gaba d'aya sai yaji zuciyar sa na masa zafi...  Uwa uba da ya tuno kalaman da ya fad'a mata... Anya kuwa ba kuskure yake shirin yi ba... Amma hakan shine kawai masa mafita,  rabuwa da Salma...  Lokaci guda ya runtse idanun sa yana mai tuno yanayin da ya bar Affan ciki... 


A b'angaren Salma kuwa idan ta runtse idanu saidai ta hangota cikin jikin Soja...  Zuciyarta ya dinga bugawa da sauri,  abun ya kasa barin jikinta gaba d'aya jinta take tamkar ba ita d'inba...  Cikin sauri ta mik'e ta nufi bathroom don yin wanka ko zata daina jin jikinsa da hannayen sa cikin nata.. 



*******


*Bayan kwana uku*


Zaune ya sami Naseer d'in a Office,  fuskar sa d'auke da murmushi ya shigo...  Saida Naseer ya mik'e tsaye ganin bak'on abu tattare da Affan d'in.. 

Bai daina murmushi ba saida ya k'araso yayi hugging Naseer


Da mamaki Naseer ke duban sa...  Affan ya kuma sakin murmushi yana d'an bud'e idanunsa yake fad'in "Hey don't ask me yaya nake... As you can see, quite steady ...."

D'an murmushi Naseer yayi had'i da girgiza kai kana yace "Banyi tsammanin haka daga gareka ba..." 


Affan ya kuma murmusawa kafin yace " Naseer regarding what we've been through lately..... I.... I'm sorry,  kayi hak'uri na yarda da shawarwarin ka.. And insha Allah bazan kuma komawa d'abi'an da na tassama ba...  Insha Allah na canza....  Naseer don Allah kayi hak'uri gaskiyar ka ne,  mu ajiye maganar auren ka da Salma muyi focusing akan jinyar Daddy...."

Murmushi Naseer yayi kafin ya dafi kafad'an Affan yace "Brother harga Allah naji dad'i cikin raina sannan insha Allah idan Daddy Ya sami lafiya zan baka chance to be with her.. "

Affan ne yayi saurin d'aura hannunsa a bakin Naseer kana yace "Pls Naseer mu ajiye wannan maganar a gefe...  Kar ka damu dani,  muyi fatan alkhairi ma junan mu..."

Murmushin dake saman fuskar Naseer ta kasa gushewa baisan sanda yayi hugging Affan ba zuciyar sa na masa sanyi.. 

Affan kuwa kafiran murmushi kurum yake had'i da k'ura ma waje guda idanu... 

*******

Mamy ta tura crutches d'inta bayan mota ta cangwala ta shige gaban motar yayinda Shareefah ke tuk'a motar... Suna ficewa Azeema ta tari babur tabi bayansu 


 Azeema tana ganin sun karyi kwanan gidan su Naseer ta saki murmushi kafin ta zaro wayarta cikin jaka ta shiga dialing layin Naseer... 

Jin bai d'aga ba don dama ba kasafai yake d'aga layin da bai sani ba musamman idan yana tsaka da aiki... Lokaci guda Azeema ta tura masa sak'o

Murmushi take kan faman cikin zuciyarta tana mai furta _Bazan tab'a barinku kuyi nasara ba.._



A tare suka fito bayan sun gama tattaunawar su Innah na make cikin motar tana binsu da kallon raini,  yayinda Mamy ta cangwala ta fito daga motar tana saka wa mai adaidaita hannu...  Shareefah ta lek'o ta window tana fad'in "Mamy kin tabbata babu matsala zaki iya zuwa asibitin ke kad'ai?"


Mamy na washe baki take fad'in "Kar ki damu Shareefah... Zan iya zuwa,  nidai damuwata ki kai Innah gidan tsinanniyar matar a raba auren Naseer da Salma don wllhi mayu ne kaman yanda suka so shan jinina da shike kurwata nada k'arfi shiyasa na gagare su haka zasu tand'e da d'anki tass..."

Ta k'arshe tana duban Innah dake make bayan motar tana taunar chewing gum, Mamy yanda kasan masu baran bakin titi, gaba d'aya babu nutsuwa a tattare da ita.. 


Cikin zuciyar Innah kuwa fad'i take _Ai dama zasu lashe sa da naji dad'i....  Kawai farin ciki ne bazan bar Naseer ya kasance ciki ba A DUNIYAR MU shiyasa ma zanje ayita ta k'are...._   Ta k'arashe tunanin nata tana mai kwanciya cikin kujera.. 


Shareefah kuwa d'agawa Mamy hannu tayi tana fad'in "Mamy ki gaida Daddy pls,..  Allah sa yau su barki ki shiga wajen sa..."

Mamy na washe baki take d'aga masu hannaye bibbiyu crutches d'inta mak'ale a hammata, tana jinjina kai lokaci guda Shareefah ta kwashi motar yayinda adaidaita ya tsaya gaban Mamy tuni ta shige tana fad'in "Malam TH zaka kaini..."

Azeema ta murmusa kafin tace da mai babur d'in "Malam mubi bayan keken can..."

Motar Naseer na tsayuwa suka jiyo muryar Shareefah sai zage zage take tana bak'anta su Salma....  Jamila kuwa bakinta bai mutu ba sai mayar mata take yanda take shiga itama ba ta nan take fita ba.... 


A birkice suka shigo parlorn daga Naseer har Affan.... 


Salma dai rakub'e take a gefe tana hawaye yayinda Momy keta faman tausan Innah wacce itama ta yanda take shiga ba ta nan take fita ba.. Tana fad'i ma Momy ta lashe mata d'a... 

Idanun Naseer akan Salma ganin irin kukan da take ya kuma sa hankalin sa ya tashi... Saurin k'arasawa yayi yana k'ok'arin janye Innah....  Innah ta kuma fincika tana watsa masa mugun kallo kana tace "Ai bansan rashin mutuncin naka har ya kawo nan ba Naseer... Ka zab'i wata uwar sama dani... A zatona Shareefah ta fad'a ne kawai don ta bak'anta ka sabida abinda ka mata,  ashe sam ba haka bane... Gaskiya ta fad'i... Wato kai sarkin kirki koh... Ka kasa kawo min matar naka sai ma uwarka na bariki......"  muryar Innah ya soma rawa tana shirin soma kukan munafunci.... 


Wani mugun kallo kurum Naseer ke watsa wa Shareefah....  Idanun Affan akan Salma... Lokaci guda kuma ya sauk'r idanun sa kan Ilham....  Cikin sauri ya k'arasa ya kamo hannun Shareefah yana fad'in "What has gotten into you Shareefah....  Look don't complicate things the most....  Oya let's get out of here.... Naseer please kuyi hak'uri....."

Shaye da mamaki Shareefah ke duban Affan....  K'ok'arin fincikan hannunta take tana fad'in " Iyakacin gaskiya nake fad'i kuma a babin gaskiya ba'ayiwa Innah adalci ba.. Ka sake ni nace Affan...."   Bai saketan ba sai janyeta waje da yake yi da iyaka k'arfin sa..... 


Naseer girgiza kai kurum yayi kafin ya kamo hannun Innah yana k'ok'arin ficewa da ita.....  Innah na fincika take fad'in "Naseer na fad'a maka ka saki yarinyar nan wato shine ka ajiye ta a nan koh....  Wllhi ka shiga hankalinka idan ba baki kake so na maka ba...."

Zuciyar sa na masa wani irin zafi yaja burki ya tsaya....  Wani irin duba yake ma Innah... Idanunsa sun kad'a sunyi jazir sabida tsananin k'unci... Har ga Allah Ya gaji da kalamun Innah a gareshi....  A hankali ya soma furta "I'll never get tired of putting up with you....  But please don't curse me, I beg of you......"  d'an fasali yaja har lokacin bai daina huci ba kafin yaci gaba da fad'in "Kince baki yarda na tare da ita a matsayin mata ba... Fine nayi yanda kike so na ajiyeta a wani wajen daban.. What else, me kuma kike so nayi...  Mutuwa kike so nayi,  kwanciyar hankali ne baki so ki ganni ciki....  What kind of parent are you..?  Haba haba Innah don Allah ki dinga sauk'ak'a min I'm only human....."   

Tausayin Naseer ya cika zukatan su babu kaman Salma yayinda Innah taji jikinta ya mata wani irin sanyi tamkar an tsundumata cikin k'ank'ara... Gaba d'aya kasa d'agowa tayi ta dubi Naseer,  itakam abin yana damunta yanda yanzu lokaci guda take mugun shakkan Naseer d'in.... 

Hannayenta Naseer ya kamo kafin yace "Banso nayi maganar a wajen nan ba....  But you keep on pushing me,   kiyi hak'uri Innah zamu k'arasa maganar a gida..."  Bai jira cewan kowa ba ya shiga janyo hannun Innah wacce take jin hannun Naseer d'in tamkar garwashin wuta a cikin nata hannun dukda laushi da hannun kedashi..... 

Cikin sauri Jamila ta k'araso ta rungume Salma yayinda Momy ta k'arasa ta kamo Ilham itama,  babu mai iya furta komai cikin su.....  


Jamila ta d'an runtse idanunta tunowa da tayi wannan matar zata iya zama kakar Fawaz tunda gashi ga dukkan alamu itace mahaifiyar Naseer..... 


********

A tare suka shiga suka ga Daddy Azeema sai murmushi take yayinda Mamy ta cika tayi fam,  itakam da da hali da ta tunkud'a Azeema kan kwalta mota tabi kanta....  A tare suka fito har gate d'in asibitin, Azeema ce kawai keyiwa Mamy hira yayinda Mamy bata ko iya amsawa da zaka sanya hannunka saman k'irjinta da ka jiyo bugu da k'irjin keyi tamkar ana sauk'e mata guduma... 

"Mamy taxi zamu shige ko adaidaita...?"   Azeema ta tambaya fuska d'auke da murmushi.... 

Tsaki Mamy tayi had'i da kauda kai gefe... 


Azeema ta kuma murmusawa kana ta sassauta murya tace " Mamy are you still mad... Sabida na hanaki k'arasa Daddy....?"

Nan ma shiru Mamy bata amsa ta ba.... 

Azeema ta kuma murmusawa kafin tace "Mamy idan na barki kika k'arasa Daddy ni burina na mallakan d'anki Affan bazai cika ba.... Kar ki damu idan kin tsaya min na auri Affan ni kuma zan baki daman k'arasa sa ta hanya mafi sauk'i....."  Ta k'arashe tana gyarawa Mamy mayafinta... 

Mamy dai kasa tanka Azeema tayi ta shiga tare mai adaidaita...  

Adaidaitan tana tsayuwa Mamy ta soma yunk'urin shiga Azeema na taimaka mata tamkar ta shak'e Azeema haka take ji..... 

********

"Addah yaushe ne abubuwa zasu canza A DUNIYAR MU?..."   Cewar Salma wacce kanta ke langab'e jikin 'yar uwar tata.... 

Shafa kanta Jamila ta kuma yi kafin tace "Duk tsanani na tare da sauk'i Salma,  mu kuma kalan tamu jarabawar kenan A DUNIYAR MU... kullum cikin zullumi da tsoron fad'awa tashin hankali... Amma Allah bai mance damu ba da sannu sauk'i zai zo mana nan bada jimawa ba...."  Ta k'arashe murmushi kwance saman fuskar ta... 


Murmushi Salma ma tayi kafin ta rungume 'yar uwar tata tana fad'in "Ina sonku gaba d'aya Addah..."

Jamila ta share hawayen da suka d'an zubo mata kafin tace "Muma muna sonki Salma...."

Momy dake tsaye gefe a hankali ta juya tausayin su ya cika zuciyar ta... 

*****

"Shareefah da alama bakiji gargad'in da na maki ba...."   Affan ya fad'i yana dubanta.. 

Mugun kallo ta watsa masa had'i da zama cikin sofa kana tace "You know Affan.. You such an idiot...  Kai da ya kamata mu had'a kai mu destroying wad'anda suka ci amanar mu amma da alama kai har ka mance....  Shiyasa na fad'a maka sam baka da wayo... Kowa amfanuwa kurum yake da kai..."

"Be careful with your language..."   Ya fad'i fuska a dake.... Dai-dai lokacin Mamy da Azeema suka turo k'ofa suka shigo...  Affan yayi saurin k'arasawa ga Mamy ganin kaman hawaye ne kwance cikin idanunta...  Aiko Mamy kaman jira take yana k'arasowa ta rungume sa sosai ta shiga rusa kuka ko zataji sanyi cikin ranta...

Affan ya rungumeta sosai yanai ma Azeema kallon tuhuma,  Shareefah ma kallon mamaki tabi Azeema dashi don a iya saninta basu fice tareda Azeema ba a gida suka barta... 


"Me Ya faru..?  Me ya sameta....?"  A jere yayi ma Azeema tambayar.. 

Azeema ta d'an sauk'e ajiyan zuciya kana tace "Daga wajen Daddy muke....  Zuciyar Mamy ya kariya da yawa ganin yanda Daddy ke jin jiki....  Shiyasa taketa kuka don tun a cikin adaidaita nake lallashinta..."

Jikin Affan ya d'anyi sanyi.. Mamy kam kaidin Azeema ya soma daina bata tsoro saidai ma gani take kaman kamuwan Allah ne yake gab da kamata shiyasa  Azeema tayi bak'e-bak'e a rayuwarta.. 


Lallashin Mamy ya soma yi yana sanar da ita Daddy zai sami lafiya da izinin Allah.. Sannan shima daga nan zai wuce ya dubasa...  Shareefah kam bata ce komai ba sai tafarfasa da zuciyar ta ke faman yi... Sam bataso su Naseer su taddasu gidan Momy Lami ba sai Innah ta fatattake su a rayuwar d'anta Naseer... Ita abin ma mamaki yake bata yaya akayi su Naseer suka san sunje gidan.. Lokaci guda idanunta suka sauk'a kan Azeema dake faman murmushi.... 

*********


Bayan shud'ewar sati abubuwa sun soma lafawa musamman tsakanin Naseer da Affan...  Sannan babu laifi yanzu kam Salma takan yarda su gaisa da Soja dukda bata wani saki dashi kaman a baya ba....  A b'angaren Jamila da Fawaz ba'a cewa komai soyayyar su kullum k'aruwa take duk da matsa mata da sakk'onni da Alh Kabeer keyi,  bata amsawa saidai tayi deleting.... 


Tsaf Salma ta k'arashe shirinta cikin doguwar riga irinta larabawa wanda yake bak'i sid'ik sannan ta yane kanta da mayafin kayan....  Jamila ta sakar mata murmushi kana tace "Kinyi kyau matar Soja... Nidai don Allah idan kunje ki gayar min da Daddy...  Ba don ba'a bari a shiga ba ai da na biku na duba jikin nasa,  Daddy mutumin kirki ne.."

Salma ta d'an murmusa had'i da jinjina kai kana tace "Shiyasa nake son naje naga jikin nasa,  insha Allah zan sanar dashi sak'on ku koda bazai amsa ni ba sannan da sannu zai sami lafiya da izinin Allah..."

Jamila ta jinjina kai tana mai gyara wa Salma mayafinta....  Salma dai kallon 'yar uwar tata kawai take tana murmushi tana tuna yanda Allah ya karkato masu da hankalin 'yar uwar su ta dawo garesu daga mummunar rayuwar da ta zab'ar ma kanta a baya..... 

D'an Far da idanu Jamila ta mata kana tace "Wannan irin kallo saikace na zama Soja...?"

Salma ta d'an kuma murmusawa had'i da dungurin Jamila cikeda wasa kana tace "Kai Addah ai dai kece mai soyayya keda Dr Fawaz... Amma nida Soja ba soyayya muke ba,  kuma da zaran Daddy Ya sami lafiya......."  Shiru tayi ta kasa ci gaba da maganar nata.. 

Jamila ta murmusa don izuwa yanzu kowa ya fahimci kalan soyayyar da suke itada Fawaz.... 

A hankali ta dafa Salma kana ta d'anyi jim.... 

"Salma ina son Fawaz soyayya da ban tab'a yima wani d'a namiji ba... Dama ashe haka so take... Lallai kuwa idan haka ne tuntuni ban tab'a soyayya ba sai akan Fawaz...."

Ta k'arashe tana murmushi had'i da k'urama waje guda idanu.... 


Salma da jikinta ya d'anyi sanyi sabida duk abubuwan da Jamila ta fad'i tanaji ga Fawaz,  toh kuwa shakka babu tana jin irinsu ma Soja.... Saurin mik'ewa tayi tana k'ok'arin yakishe tunanin. Dai-dai nan Momy ta shigo ta iske su ta sanar dasu zuwan Sojan.... 

A tare Salma da Jamila suka fito,  hannunsu rik'e cikin na juna idanun Salma a k'asa... 

Naseer na hangosu ya mik'e tsaye... A kullum idan ya ganta soyayyar ta na kuma shigar sa cikin tsanaki...  Jamila ce ta soma gaidashi ya amsa cikin sakin fuska...  Salma ma ta gaidashi cikin tsanaki a d'an tak'aice...  Fuska d'auke da murmushi ya amsa lokaci guda yake binta da mayen kallo... 

Momy ce ta k'araso tana fad'in "Captain da Allah a dai kula min da d'iyata da kyau..."

Naseer ya murmusa kana yace "Insha Allah Momy zan kula da ita fiye da yanda zan kula da kaina...."  ya k'arashe idanun sa akan Salma... Daga Jamila har Momy murmushi suke soyayyar da Soja ke nunawa Salma cikin salo na burgesu...  Har waje Momy ta masu rakiya yayinda Jamila ta koma ciki tana amsa wayar Fawaz.. 

Saida Momy taga tashin motar su kafin ta komo parlor ta zauna had'i da rapka tagumi, don tun bayan zuwan Innah gidan Momy ta rasa dalilin da yasa take ji a jikinta tamkar ba Innah ce ta haifi Naseer ba... 


Akan idanunsa suka shige mota,  abinda yafi k'ona masa rai shine Naseer harda wani bud'e wa Salma mota,  wato irin ga sarauniyar birnin zuciyar sa...  Kasa motsawa Affan yayi daga wajen zuciyar sa na masa wani irin zogi da rad'ad'i yau ya kamata ya ida bufin sa na tarwatsa farin cikin Salma da Naseer... 



Momy ta gama shirinta tsaf kafin ta masu Jamila sallama ta wuce...  Jamilar ma shirin fita take don Fawaz ya sanar da ita yana tafe zai zosa ya d'auketa suje ta gaida Mum d'insa, gashi Momy da Salma duk sun fice bata samu ta sanar dasu ba kuma bata so tayita kawo excuse ma Fawaz kar yaga tamkar bata damu da jinyar mahaifiyar sa bane....  

Ta gama shirinta tsaf kafin ta matso kusan Ilham wacce keta faman wasa da Falaq,  d'an dafata tayi kana tace "Ilham bazan jima ba yanzu zan dawo,  ki kula da kanku keda Falaq kinji koh,  idan kuma bazaku iya zama ku kad'ai ba sai na fasa tafiyar..."

Murmushi Ilham tayi kana tace "Haba dai Addah,  Wllhi zamu iya zama,  ai na saba zama daga ni sai Falaq kar ki damu kinji kije ki gaida Momin Doctor yanada kirki..."

Jamila ta murmusa cikeda jin dad'i ta shafi kan k'anwar tata kana ta rungumo su gaba d'aya harda Ilham d'in kafin tace "I love you...."  

Ilham ta d'an kuma murmusawa kana tace "Muma muna sonki Addah.."

Rurin da wayarta ya soma alamun Fawaz ya iso yasata mik'ewa ta kuma masu sallama kafin ta fice.... 

*******

Daga yanda yake lab'e duk yaga ficewar su daga gidan,  tun daga ficewar su Salma da Naseer da kuma ficewar Momy har izuwa ficewan Jamila da Fawaz....  Mik'ewa yayi yana wata kafirn murmushi.. A hankali ya furta "It's now or never...."   cikin sauri Affan ya ciro k'ullin garin da yake yawo da ita kullum cikin aljihun sa kafin ya nufi gidan Momy.... 

*******


Gaba d'aya jinta take ba'a sake ba,  ba wani amsa masa tad'in nasa take ba har suka iso Santana Corporation....  D'an dubanta yayi kana yace "Barin d'an karb'i aika sai mu wuce koh..."  jinjina masa kai tayi had'i da k'ak'aro murmushin k'arfin hali kafin Naseer ya fice,  sabida akwai wani bincike da yake yi gameda Yayan sa Kabeer... 


*******


Ta gajeren garun bayan gidan Affan ya samu ya dirk'a cikin gidan... Ilham dake faman zura riga gabanta ya yanke ya fad'i,  tasan dai babu yanda za'ayi b'aro ya shigo wannan bariki tunda akwai tsaro sosai tun daga gate...  Saurin k'arasawa saman katifa tayi ta shafa Falaq dake kan faman barcinta,  a hankali ta soma lalumen hanya tana tambayan wenene...?


Bai amsata ba sai zuba mata idanu da yayi....  Lokaci guda ya shiga tuno kalan cin amanar dasu Naseer suka masa,  yanda ya rasa farin ciki haka suma bazasu zauna cikin farin ciki ba...  Salma tana son 'yan uwanta fiye da komai,  da ba don idan ya tafi dasu gaba d'aya harda jaririyar ba zata zame masa liability da ya tattare su gaba d'aya ya saka su cikin k'unci da tashin hankali.... 

Izuwa lokacin Ilham ta razana sosai ,  ganin tana k'ok'arin k'arasawa ta rufe k'ofa tana mai fad'in "Toh kodai kunnuwana ne... K'ila babu wanda ya dawo cikin su.... Bata kai aya ba saiji tayi ta bangaji mutum....  Tsoro ya kuma cikata lokaci guda....  K'ok'arin jada baya ta soma ba tareda ta iya furta koda kalma ba, sai tunanin Falaq da take... Saidai kafin tayi katab'us ya capkota lokaci guda ya danna mata 'yar tsummma mai d'auke da garin maganin a hanci... Sai k'ok'arin ihu take tana son k'watan kanta ta kasa....  Lokaci guda jikinta ya sake idanunta  suka rufe ruf...  Cikin sauri Affan ya sure ta ya fice da ita.... 

******



Kallon mutumin take kan faman yi don idan bata b'ata gani ba tabbas shine ta gani wanda suka cinna wuta ma gidan gonar Daddy daga bisani ya biyota zai kasheta.... Magana da wani mutumi ya soma ai kuwa ta fahimci muryar sa...  Cikin sauri ta bud'e marfin motar ta fito tana dubansa sosai take fad'in "Wllhi shine... Wllhi ba kamanni bane... Shine..."   

Mutanen dake kai komo cikin Kampanin suka soma dubanta tamkar mahaukaciya... Shi kuwa Maina tamkar ya saki zawo a wandonsa... A tamanin ya samu ya silale cikin mutane ganin da gaske Salma k'ok'arin nufosa take... Kan kace me mutane sun taru a wajen Salma bata daina kuka ba tana fad'in wllhi shine....  A birkice Naseer ya k'araso wajen had'i da rik'ota yana tambayarta "Salma,  meke faruwa,  wayene kika gani...?"

Share hawayen ta take da hannu bibbiyu tana girgiza kai take fad'in "Soja wllhi shine.. Wllhi na gansa yanzu a nan.. Shine ya biyo ni zai kasheni bayan Sun k'one gidan gonar..."

Gaban Naseer ya yanke ya fad'i saurin rungumeta yayi cikin k'irjin sa yana kwantar mata da hankali...  Abun na neman juya masa tunani...  Kenan Salma taga wanda ya k'ona gidan gonar Alh Ali a companyn mahaifin sa,  wannan lamari akwai abun dubawa sosai ciki, toh ko kuma wata hidima ta kawo mutumin Kampanin...?  Kwanyarsa ta cirke lokaci guda.. Ga kuka da Salma keyi tana fad'i. "Shine sanadiyan rabuwata da mahaifiyata har ta bar duniya.."  tafiyan da basuyi ba kenan suka zauna k'asar wata rumfa tana nan rungume cikin jikinsa sai aikin lallashin ta yake... 

*******

Tunda suka shigo gidan gabanta ke fad'uwa.. Bata sha mamakin ganin mahaifiyar Fawaz balarabiya ba sabida shid'inma haka yake sak Arabs..  Saidai ta tausaya mata sosai,  ga Mace har Mace amma babu hankali...  Tuni Falmata ta cika gaban Jamila da kayan motsa baki...  Sosai Fawaz ya birgeta ganin yanda yake kula da mahaifiyar sa, sam bai damu ya nuna mahaifiyar sa ba dukda tana cikin jinyar tab'in hankali, lokaci guda ta kuma jinjinama hankali irin na Fawaz..  


Fawaz ya d'an dubeta yanda take ta wani san-san da kai.. Murmushi yayi kana yace "Ki saki jikin ki Dad kam ma baya nan da kun gaisa..."

Jamila ta murmusa kana tace "Ai ni naji dad'i ma da baya nan don wllhi kunya nakeji.."

Fawaz ya murmusa kafin yace "Kar ki damu nida Dad d'ina tamkar abokai ne,  I'm sure kema zai d'auke ki tamkar d'iya.."  Ta d'an murmusa ba tareda tace komai ba... 


"Whattt!!  You're crazy Maina garin yaya ta ganka...?"

Ya kuma tambaya yana zura riga don fitowar sa kenan daga wanka... 

Daga d'aya b'angaren Maina yace "Mai gida wllhi itada Naseer suka zo Kampanin.. Ni kaina bansan me ya kawo Naseer a daidai wannan lokaci ba,  I'm afraid he might be spying on you..."

Alh Kabeer ya fuzar da iska yana furta "Damn it...!!! Maina you better get lost...  Gani nan zuwa yanzun nan....Daga haka sauri-sauri ya k'arasa shirin sa ya nufo downstairs.. 

Jamila na bawa Aunty Saudat abinci a baki Fawaz na rik'e da plate d'in gwanin sha'awa idan ka gansu....  Dai-dai lokacin Alh Kabeer ke sauk'owa daga bene... 

Cak ya tsaya yana hangesnu fuskokin su cikeda annuri...  Bakinsa bai furta ba amma zuciyar sa ta furta masa "KITTY"  kasa ci gaba da tafiya yayi sai bugu da k'irjinsa keyi.. Lokaci guda Fawaz ya d'ago yana duban mahiafin nasa.. Murmushi ya saki had'i da mik'ewa kafin ya nufesa yana fad'in "Dad I thought ka fice don banga motar ka ba...."

Jin ya ambaci Dad yasa Jamila d'agowa cikin sauri tana dubansu...  Lokaci guda spoon d'in dake hannunta ya fad'i k'asa




🌖🌖 *A DUNIYAR MU* 🌖🌖



                      *41*



*©Sameena Aleeyou...✍🏽*



 
Kasa gasgata abinda ke shirin faruwa tayi.... A'a kodai kamanni ne... Kai badai Alhaji Kabeer bane baban Fawaz.... Innalillahi wa inna'ilaihirraji'un...  Shin dama Alh Kabeer shine mahaifin Fawaz...?  Sai yanzu take tuna a asibiti tabbas taji ana kiran Fawaz Dr Santana,  sai yanzu abubuwa da dama suka shiga dawowa kwanyar ta...  Sam bata kawo haka ba sabida ko kad'an Fawaz baya kamada Alh Kabeer, kenan mahaifiyar sa ziryan ya d'auko.... Jiri na neman kada ita daga zaunen da take... 

A b'angaren Alh Kabeer ma bai iya amsa Fawaz ba sai zufa dake faman keto masa ta ko ina....  Meke shirin faruwa... Mai ya kawo Kitty gidan shi.....?  Yana cikin wannan tunani ya jiyo muryar Fawaz yana fad'in "Dad finally na kawo maka ita.... Ka k'araso ku gaisa..."  murmushi kwance saman fuskar Fawaz ya shiga janyo hannun mahaifin nasa cikin parlorn.... 


Bibbiyu Alh Kabeer ya soma gani yayinda Jamila ke zaune a wajen tamkar wacce aka dasa,  idan da za'a yanki naman jikinta bata tsammanin jini zai fito sabida tsaban yanda komai na jikinta ke neman d'aukewa,  da za'a ce mata mafarki ne ba gaskiya ba da sai tafi son hakan.. Alh Kabeer abokin lalatan ta shine mahaifin saurayin da take so taci burin Aura.... Ya Allah kasa ba gaskiya bane. Allah kasa a farkar da ita daga wannan mummunar mafarki da take....  Kaman daga sama ta jiyo muryar Fawaz yana fad'in "Jamila ga Dad ya sauk'o ashe dai bai fice ba da rabon zaku gaisa...."

K'ak'aro murmushi tayi wanda yafi kama da yak'e ta shiga sunne kai tana k'ok'arin had'o kalaman da zatayi amfani dasu wajen gaisar da Daddyn Fawaz...  Alh Kabeer kuwa zuciyar sa sai tururi take da k'yar yake iya amsa Jamila.... 

Fawaz ya d'an dubi mahaifin nasa yaga gaba d'aya tamkar baya hayyacin sa.... A hankali ya furta "Dad are you okay...?"  

Alh Kabeer ya kuma murmusawa wanda hausawa ke kira da yak'e kai tsaye kafin yace "La.... Lafiya... Lafiya Son,  eh.. Eh... Ba shakka ka zab'o Mace mai kunya gashi ta kasa d'ago kanta mu gaisa sosai..."  Ya k'arashe yana mai ci gaba da murmushin... 

Fawaz ya d'an murmusa kana yace "Ai Dad bamuma yi zaton zamu sameka gida ba don sosai take kunyar ka..."

_Yo dole taji kunyata ta bini ta kuma bi d'ana,  abun sai ya mana yawa..._  cewar Alh Kabeer cikin zuciyar sa... 

Aunty Saudat ce ta soma matsawa baya tunda taga Alh Kabeer ya sauk'o parlorn... Ta shiga murd'a 'yan yatsunta a hankali.. Lokaci guda ta rarumo throw pillows dake gefenta ta shiga wurgin Alh Kabeer dashi....  

Kafin Fawaz ya cimmata Alh Kabeer ya cimmata ya rik'eta gam yana mai fad'i ma Fawaz... "Maza jeka ka kira Innah, kar ka damu kaji da bak'uwar ka mu zamu kula da ita.."  

Cikin sauri Fawaz ya mik'e yana fad'in "Toh Daddy.."  Saida ya d'an dubi Jamila kana yace "I'll be right back Jay...."

Bata sami zarafin amsa sa ba sai jinjina kai kurum da tayi.... 

Aiko tamkar wanda yake jira Fawaz na ficewa ya saki Aunty Saudat ya k'araso gaban Jamila dake k'ok'arin jada baya... Saidai kafin tayi wani katab'us tuni ya capkota.... 

Jamila da tuni jikinta ya soma rawa tamkar mazari, a hankali take furta "Dan Allah ka min rai ka sake ni kada Fawaz ya shigo ya same mu a haka..."

Murmushi ya sakar mata kafin yace "Kitty kin wahalar dani da yawa....  Na fad'a maki bazaki iya tseren mun ba... You are mine...."  Bai jira cewanta ba ya matse fuskar ta Ya shiga kissing d'inta.. 

Lokaci guda ta hankad'ashi hawaye na kwararowa daga idanunta....  Cikin sauri ta mik'e ta suri jakkanta ta nufi k'ofa....  

Ganin Aunty Saudat na k'ok'arin rarumo abu zata runtuma masa ya sa baibi bayan Jamila ba wacce tuni ta fice cikin tsananin tashin hankali..... 


A tare Fawaz da Innah suka shigo,  sosai Fawaz yayi mamakin rashin ganin Jamila da baiyi ba... 


Kan mahaifiyar sa ya k'arasa yana k'ok'arin taimaka wa mahaifin nasa yake tambayar sa Jamila... 

Babu ko kunya ya shiga tsara wa Fawaz k'arya... 

"Wllhi Son taji tsoron mahaifiyar ka sosai ta tafi... Fawaz a ganina ka ajiye maganar aure a gefe har sai mahaifiyar ka ta sami lafiya.... Kaga a garin irin haka duk budurwar da ka samu zata gujeka,  ka bari mahaifiyar ka ta sami lafiya first..."

Innah dai sai binsu da idanu take, a zuciyarta kuwa haushin Kabeer k'unshe ciki.. Ta yaya zai soma addu'an waraka ma Saudat.. Ai idan Saudat zata warke toh saidai a lahira... 

Fawaz mik'ewa yayi da sauri yana fad'in "Daddy barin bi bayan ta,  ni na kawota ni ya kamata na maidata...."   Bai kai aya ba Aunty Saudat ta zube... Fawaz yayi saurin durk'usawa yana jijjiga mahaifiyar nasa,  lokaci guda yake duban mahaifin nasa yana fad'in "Dad pls ka kira layin Likitan ta..."

"Yeah Son... Right a way..."  Cikin sauri Alh Kabeer ya fice.. 



A d'ari ya fice daga gate d'in gidan sauri-sauri gudu-gudu yana neman hanyar da Jamila tabi... 


Abinka da unguwa maras hayaniya sosai can ya hangeta sai sauri take tana neman abun hawa ga hawaye sharkaf idanunta... Kuka take tamkar ranta zai fice.... 



Cikin sauri ya cimma ta Ya shiga janyo hannunta... 

Sosai take kuka tana k'ok'arin k'watan kanta take fad'in "Ka sake ni... Na tsane ka.. Na tsani sanin ka da nayi... Allah Ya isa shigowa rayuwata da kayi...."   Bata kai aya ba ya d'auketa da wani wawan mari.... Fincikota yayi suka mak'ale cikin d'an wani lungu.... Yana wani irin huci yake dubanta kafin yace "How dare you... Just how dare you... Ta yaya zaki soma soyayya da d'ana my very own flesh and blood .... Kinyi hauka ne Jamila,  ta yaya zaki soma soyayya da Fawaz..." ya k'arashe yana mai shak'e mata wuya jikin matsin garun... 


Sosai take kuka tana girgiza masa kai....  Da k'yar ya sassauta rik'on da yayi mata jin numfashinta na neman d'aukewa... 

Cikin karaji yaci gaba da fad'in "Kin san ina sonki,  soyayyan da ban tab'a yima wata d'iya mace ba... Kitty meyasa kika barni...  Ina tunani Kin barni ne sabida wani namiji daban,  ashe sabida d'ana ne...  You are in love with my son...  Why? Why Kitty....  You know how much I love you....  You can't do this to me.... No you just can't....  Wllhi KE DA FAWAZ nafi k'aunar ku fiye da komai A DUNIYAR MU....  Kitty bazan iya rabuwa da d'ayanku ba.....  Wllhi da inada hali da na kashe Fawaz har lahira sabida soyayyar da nake maki.. Alk'awari nayi duk mutumin da kika barni sabida shi Wllhi sai na kashe shi.....  Meyas Fawaz Kitty... Why Him...."   Ya k'arashe hawayen taurin rai na gangarowa daga idanun sa....  Lokacin guda ya soma k'ok'arin kai mata sumba...  Cikin sauri ta kuma hankad'a sa gefe... 

Hawaye suna ci gaba da kwaranya mata take fad'in "Na canza a lokacin da canji baimin amfani ba.... Na canza rayuwata sabida soyayyar da nake ma Fawaz... Wllhi Wllhi bansan Fawaz d'anka bane. Sabida ku d'in bakuda abu guda da ya had'aku ta hanyar hallaya ko kamanni....  Wllhi na tsaneka na tsani kaina...  The last thing I want in this life shine nayi hurting Fawaz...  Fawaz bai cancanci haka ba....  Fawaz yanada zuciya mai kyau... Wllhi ka cuce ni...."

"Shut up..! Shut the hell up..!! Ki daina fad'in kina son wani a gabana musamman Fawaz....  Kar ki sake kiran sunan d'ana... D'ana tsarkakakke ne bai cancanci mace irinki ba..... Wllhi Jamila kinji na rantse idan baki fita hanyar Fawaz ba.....  I'll tell him everything....  Every single thing da mukayi between us... So ina shawartan ki.. Mu ci gaba daga yanda muka tsaya, idan ba haka ba zaki shiga k'unci mafi muni A DUNIYAR MU..."   Ya k'arashe yana mai murmushi da gefen bakin sa lokaci guda yana wasa da 'yan yatsun hannun sa saman wuyar ta..."

Cikin sauri ta ture shi ta matsa gefe, tana wani irin huci take watsa masa kallon k'yama kafin tace "Ko babu Fawaz alk'awari nayi bazan koma rayuwar daduro ba...  Na canza ma kaina har abada insha Allah...  Da sannu zaka girbe abinda ka shuka..."  Daga haka tayi saurin sa kai zata shige... 

Saurin fincikota yayi ta kuma fad'owa jikin sa yana wani irin huci yake fad'in "Kitty idan kika ga na rabu dake toh wllhi mutuwa kikayi ko kuma ni ne na mutu... But as far as ina numfashi A DUNIYAR MU zan rayu dake.... Kuma kinji na rantse idan bakiyi hankali ba zan gayawa Fawaz who you really are...."  Yana kaiwa aya ya zaro wayarsa cikin aljihu ya ciro wata sim ya saka ciki had'i da mik'a mata wayar lokaci guda kana yace "Oya take this... We keep on touch.."

K'in karb'a tayi sai kallon tsana da take watsa masa har lokacin hawaye na gangaro mata...

Murmushi yayi had'i da shafar hab'arsa wanda d'abi'ar sa ce kana ya finciko jakanta ya jefa wayar ciki yace "Wannan wayan just the two of us.. Mu biyu kawai nake so mu dinga magana da ita.... Jamila babban kuskuren da zakiyi shine kiyi tunanin guje min, don nasan idan kinada sauran kunya Fawaz kam ko idanu bazaki sake k'auna ku had'a ba...."   Daga haka murmushin ya kuma yi da gefen bakin sa kafin ya huro mata kiss saman tafin hannun sa yace "I love you Kitty...."  Daga haka juyawa yayi cikin sauri ya fice daga lungun....

Jamila da gaba d'aya duniyar ta shiga juye mata batasan sanda ta durk'usa saman gwiwoyinta a wajen ba ta shiga rusa wani irin kuka da bata san tanayi ba hannayen ta duka biyu aka.... 

*******

Kai tsaye gidan sa ya kaita don yasan idan ya fice da ita daga barikin a yau za'a sami error... Saman gadon d'akinsa ya kaita ya kwantar...  Lokaci guda ya zauna saman bedside yana k'are mata kallo don har lokacin bata farfad'o ba, ya jima yana kallonta kafin ya mik'e ya shiga rufe duk wani window na d'akin...  Saida ya rufe ko ina sannan ya kunna AC had'i da hura garin hodar cikin d'akin sabida ta kuma shak'a ta jima tana baccin...  Daga haka ficewa yayi ya nufi ofishin su.... 

*****

Tambayoyi da dama gameda mutumin Naseer yayi mata kafin daga bisani ya umarci securities su saka idanu sosai idan sunga mutumi mai zubin bayanan da Salma tayi,  daga bisani ne suka nufi asibiti wajen Daddy...  Sosai Salma ta tausaya wa Daddy... Saida aka basu wani kaya irinta likitoci masu shiga theater room suka saka harta takalma saida aka basu wasu suka saka kafin suka shiga d'akin da Daddy ke kwance.. Nan ma batace komai ba sai murza 'yan yatsun hannunta da take yi... 

Zaman sa ya kuma gyarwa cikin zuciyar sa yana fad'in _yanzu zan saka ki maganar dole yarinya.._  A fili yace 

"Zo naji rigar naki koda sauran jik'a kika kuma sakawa"  

A d'ari ta d'ago idanu tana dubansa lokaci guda tace "Na'am"

"Ok ashe dai maganar naki bai d'auke ba... Maza zo naji damshin rigar naki..."  ya k'arashe fuskar sa babu alamun wasa..


Twisting yatsunta take kan faman yi lokaci guda ta soma murmushi wanda yafi kama da yak'e kana tace "Aima ya bushe Soja, ka gani fah...."  ta k'arashe tana kuma bubbuge rigar... 

Naseer dai murmusawa yayi ganin duk ta rud'e lokaci guda ya mik'e ya tako yanda take tsaye.. 

Shafa rigar ya shiga yi lokaci guda Salma ta runtse idanunta k'irjinta sai faman bugu yake tamkar ta runtuma ihu...

K'unshe dariyar sa ya d'inga yi ganin yanda ta runtse idanunta... A hankali ya matso da bakinsa saitin kunnun ta tamkar mai rad'a yake fad'in "Eh ya bushe amma da sauran danshi.....  Rigar nan zata sanya ki mura,  ina d'aya rigar da na kawo nace maki ki saka...?"

Murya can k'asan mak'oshi tace "Soja wllhi nidai bazai sakani mura ba,  kuma ma ai na saka wancan rigar ma.... Nidai don Allah mu tafi gida kaga an ida ruwan...."

"Ban gane Kin saka ba... Sai kuma kika sake d'aura jik'akk'en rigar akai....?"  ya tambaya yana dubanta.. 

"Soja don Allah mu tafi gida..."   amsar da ta basa kenan idanunta na k'ok'arin rau-rau... 

Hannunta ya kamo suka zauna saman chaise lounge kana yace "Amma don baki fita kinga sabon hadarin dake had'uwa bane koh...  Kuma kinga na rasa masu gyaran mota,  ruwan nan yayi gyara sosai ko nace yayi b'arna....  In fact ko masu motar haya baki gani a waje...."

Baki a ture idanunta na k'ok'arin kawo ruwa take fad'in "Does that mean bazamu tafi gida ba kenan....?"

D'an matsowa dab da ita yayi lokaci guda ya sanya hannun sa ya kewaye kafad'arsa dashi ta d'an shigo cikin jikinsa kana ya soma fad'in "Kiyi hak'uri kinji na saka wayata a caji da zaran tayi caji zanyi waya azo a d'auke mu... Kar kiyi kuka kinji....  _REINA_...."

Dukda bata fahimci mai ya fad'i a kalaman sa na k'arshe ba amma kam ta fahimci kaman wani suna ne ya kirata dashi.. 

"Reina.."  ta maimaita a fili kana tace "Me hakan yake nufi?"

D'an murmusawa yayi kafin yace "Ki bini bashi next time zan fad'a maki..."


A hankali ta samu kanta da gyad'a masa kai tana mai k'ok'arin maida hawayen ta....  Mik'ewa Naseer yayi ya d'auko ledar da ya shigo dashi,  take away na abinci ne nan ya baza masu saman carpet d'in ya d'ago kai yana dubanta kana yace "Oya  let's eat., ko kuma kinfi so nazo wajen na baki a baki....."  ya k'arashe cikin sigan wasa.. 

Murmushi kawai tayi tana mai dubansa yanda barkwanci ke bala'in masa kyau....  Lokaci guda take jin abubuwa da dama gameda shi...  A hankali ta mik'e ta sauk'o saman carpet d'in.... 

"Ehen ina jinki bani labarin garinku...."  ya k'arashe yana gyara mata zaman spoon d'in cikin pack d'in.. 


Saida ta murmusa kana tace "Labarin garin mu..?"

Naseer ya jinjina kai kana yace "I want to know more about you....  Nima idan kin gama bani sai na baki wasu daga cikin labaruna da baki sani ba....  Amma nafi so ki fara min da labarin samarukan ki don nasan kafin Affan kinyi wasu...."   Ya k'arashe idanunsa naga wani gefen daban... 

D'an sanyi jikin Salma yayi kana ta d'an turo baki tace "Chabb ai niko a garin mu banida saurayi duk tsoro na suke sabida fad'ata...  Harta Addah Jamila nike karb'a mata fad'a....."

Dariya Naseer keyi maras sauti har saida jijiyoyin goshinsa suka d'an firfito yana k'ok'arin saita kansa yake fad'in "Kice ke boss ce babu mai maki wargi... Allah sa dai baki dambatuwa dasu...."


D'an kunyar sa taji lokaci guda ta murmusa kana tace "Ai a baki ne kawai, idan Baffah ko Inno sukaji nayi fad'a zan fuskanci fushinsu,  don Inno ta sanar damu duk Mace mai wasa da maza kariya ce... Amma fah 'yan mata tsararraki na dukan yarinya nake idan ta min ba daidai ba,  wacce ta fini kuma na saka mata tarko ta apka ciki...."

Naseer bud'e idanunsa yayi sosai yana dubanta murmushin bata gushe saman fuskar sa ba yake fad'in "Wato shiyasa kika sanyawa Shareefah b'awon ayaba a hanya koh....?"

Salma ta kuma murmusawa kana ta sadda kanta k'asa... Ambato Shareefah da yayi yasa ta jin wani iri sannan lokaci guda ta tuna bak'in sab'on da Shareefah ke aikatawa wanda da ace zata iya sanar da Soja da tuni ta sanar dashi,  gani take har kwanan gobe Soja Shareefah yake so,  tasan bazai tab'a sonta ba... 

Ganin tayi shiru yasa Naseer d'an k'ura mata idanu lokaci guda yana karantar ta... 

Gyara zamansa ya kumayi kafin yace "Kici abinci kada ya huce..."

Mak'e masa kafad'u tayi 

"Why..?"  ya tambaya yana dubanta 

"Nima sai ka bani labari..."  ta fad'i tana duban wani gefen daban 

Naseer ya d'an murmusa kana yace "OK Reina kar kiyi fushi, don dai bada labari ai bazai had'a fad'a ba...

"OK,  ni ban zauna a gidanmu sosai ba yawanci rayuwata a makaranta nayi shi...  That's why ban shak'u da mutane sosai ba.. Hasalima ada tsoron mutanen nake ji bana shiga hidiman kowa, Lubna da Fawaz su biyu ne mutanen da nasan ina zama dasu suka dariyata...  Sud'inma ya samo asali ne tun suna yara sabida Allah yayini mutum mai k'aunar yara.... Idan na dawo hutu daga sch toh kullum ina tareda su..."  Shiru yayi kaman bazai ci gaba da magana ba sai kuma ya d'an murmusa kana yaci gaba da fad'in "Ina son Abbah na sosai.... Sannan nayi kukan rashin shi sabida shine mutum na uku da zan iya cewa na shak'u dashi sosai a wancan lokacin...  Sam ni ban shak'u da mahaifiyata ba hasalima tafi shak'uwa da Yaya na Kabeer..."  fasali ya d'an ja lokaci guda idanunsa suka kad'a sukayi jazir...  Jikin Salma yayi sanyi.. 

Naseer ya d'an murmusa kafin yaci gaba da fad'in "Back then sanda nake k'arami,  nakan d'auki lamarin sabida banbancin launin fata da nake dashi da mahaifiyata shiyasa take nunawa a fili tafi son d'an uwana mai launin fatar ta.. Musamman da na lura mahaifin mu yafi jana a jikin sa sai tunanina ya kuma bani k'ila duk wanda kuka zo kala d'aya zaifi sonka ne  da kuma nuna maka k'auna....  Bazan mance ba akwai lokutan da nake daka gawayi na shafe jikina dashi ko mahaifiyar mu zata soni.. Amma ina babu abinda yake canzawa...  Da na lura tana k'aunar Lubna sai na amince ma kaina tawa k'addarar kenan A DUNIYAR MU bazan sami wannan soyayyar uwa da ake fad'i ba... But you know I still love her, and I'll keep on praying for her. Sabida nasan ko bata nuna min tana sona ba deep inside tanayi sabida bazaka haifi d'a ka k'isa ba ko yaya yake..."

Tausayin Soja ya cika zuciyar ta lokaci guda taji labarin sa na neman sakata k'walla,  ta shiga tuno kalan soyayyar da iyayen su suka nuna masu sanda suke raye... Allah sarki ashe wai har mutum taken haifi d'a yak'isa...  Tana cikin tunanin ta jiyo muryar sa naci gaba da fad'in

"Naso sanda na gama karatun secondary school na zauna da mahaifa na... But tunda Abbah ya riga ya rasu, ni kuma banason zama nayita b'atawa Inna rai don nasan fushinta ka iya tasiri a rayuwata shiyasa ma na dad'a yin nesa da gida, na gwammaci nayi jami'ata a wani garin daban....  Don a lokacin Jami'ar Abubakar Tafawa Balewa da kuma Ahmadu Bello duk sun bani admission, so sai na tafi can ABU yanda na karanci pure mathematics later on nayi applying mathematics d'ina a Nigerian Air Force...  Sabida ina avoiding duk wani dalili da zai sakani nayi zaman gidanmu... So a lokacin da nake base d'inmu na Kaduna a nan na had'u da Familyn Affan har nema ya shiga tsakani na da Shareefah..."  Shiru ya gifta tsakanin su ko wanne da tunanin da yake yi cikin su... 

Mik'ewa yayi hannayen sa sakale cikin aljihun wandon sa kana ya d'an dubeta yace "Barin duba wayar idan tayi caji sai na kira azo a d'auke mu koh..."

Bata iya dubansa ba sai jinjina masa kai da tayi har ya fice idanunta na k'asa...  Dukda ta rasa iyayen ta amma ji take tamkar labarin rayuwar Soja yafi nasu abin tausayi A DUNIYAR SU,  tabbas ba k'aramin jarabawa bane ace mahaifiyar ka data haifeka bata sonka.. Allah sarki Soja harga Allah ta kuma ganin girmansa a idanunta... 

******

Turo k'ofar Affan yayi yana dubanta daga yanda yanda yake tsaye..  Saida ya jima yana k'are mata kallo kafin ya k'arasa shigowa cikin d'akin hannunsa rik'e da ledar snacks... 

Ilham tana jin an turo k'ofa ta shiga jada baya har lokacin bakinta a d'aure yake...  

Affan ya jawo stool ya zauna bisa kafin ya daka mata wata uwar tsawa cikin wani irin murya yaci gaba da fad'in "Kina jina zan bud'e maki baki amma don kici abinci ne kawai ba don kimin kuka ba.. Kika min kuka kinji na rantse sai na kashe ki a wajen nan kuma nabi na kashe sauran 'yan uwan naki,  kina so su mutu...?"  ya k'arashe yana zare mata idanu tamkar tana ganin shi.. 

Cikeda tsoro Ilham ta shiga girgiza kai sababbin hawaye suna kwararo mata.. 

Affan ya murmusa kana yace "Good.."  lokaci guda yasa hannu ya shiga warware tsummar dake d'aure da bakin nata... 

Allah sarki bakin har ya tara jini yayi jajazir sabida azaba..  Dab da ita yake zaune ya shiga tura mata meat pie a baki yana fad'in  "Oya open your mouth and eat...  Kika zubo min dashi sai na b'alle maki wuya  makauniya kawai..."

Had'iya kawai take ba don tanajin dad'in ci ba saidon tsan-tsan tsoro da ya cika zuciyarta... A duniyar ta bata tab'a cin karo da azzalumin mutum irin mutumin da ya sato ta ba... Bata tunanin mutumin nan mai sallah ne don da ace yana sallah tabbas da ya sami gutsirin imani cikin zuciyar sa....  Hawaye suka ci gaba da kwaranya a idanun Ilham... Ga fitsari da ya tak'ura ta tamkar ta saki a jikinta, uwa uba bata yi sallolin da suke kanta ba.... 

Baki na rawa tace dashi "Dan Allah inaso nayi sallah...."

Kallo ya bita dashi yanda tayi maganar kafin ya murmusa yace "Kodai kina so ki gudu... Banda abinki nan da kike gani a wata Duniya kike yanda babu mai iya taimaka maki kuma wllhi kuskure d'aya kikayi zan kashe ki nabi na kashe sauran 'yan uwan naki...."

Lokaci guda tunanin iftila'in da ya auka masu a can Jama'are ya fad'o mata...  Jikinta da zuciyarta suka shiga raya mata tabbas wad'ancan azzaluman mutanen ne suka biyo su.... 

Girgiza kai ta shiga yi lokaci guda tana fad'in "Dan Allah me muka maku kuka tak'urawa rayuwar mu, kun koramu daga mahaifar mu kun k'one komai, mun rasa mahaifiyar mu a sanadiyar haka.... Shin me muka maku da tsanani kuke neman rayuwar mu.. Su waye ku.. Shin babu tausayi da imani ne A DUNIYAR KU.... Dan Allah bawan Allah kaji k'aina ka maidani wajen 'yan uwanan ko don lalurar da nake....."

Batakai aya ba taji ya had'e labb'anta waje guda ya matse da k'arfin gaske... Cikin karaji yake fad'in "Kowa kansa ya sani A DUNIYAR MU.... Kin karya dokar da na kafa maki ko kin mance nace maki babu magana idan na bud'e maki baki abinci kawai zakici... Wayace kiyi magana..."

Ilham bata amsa sa ba sai hawaye dake gangaro mata sabida yanda ya matse mata fatun bakinta bazata iya magana ba.... 

Huci yake yana dubanta tamkar wanda ya tuna wani abin sai kwance mata hannayen ta da yayi ya kwance d'aurin k'afar ma kana yace "Kina jina minti biyar na baki kiyi duk wata ibada da zakiyi..."

Nan ma bata amsa sa ba sai k'ok'arin d'ago hannuwan ta da suka tara jini tayi ta share fuskar ta da ya jik'e da hawaye...  Affan ne yayi directing d'inta har bathroom,

"Kina jina ina jiranki a nan cikin d'aki naji kinyi fit sai na fasa kanki...."  daga haka bai jira cewar ta ba ya fice daga bathroom d'in ya janyo k'ofar da k'arfin gaske.... 


 nan tayi tsaye har saida taji ficewar sa kafin ta silale a wajen tana kuka maras sauti... 

Yana fitowa parlor yaga kiran Naseer na shigo masa.. Saida ya saita kansa kafin ya d'aga wayar..  Nan Naseer ya sanar dashi buk'atar sa cewa ya taho Awala ya d'auke su shida Salma...

"Awala..?"  Affan ya nanata yana mai duban agogon bango dake manne a parlorn nasa lokaci guda k'irjinsa yayi wani irin bugu... 

Jin yayi shiru yasa Naseer d'an shafe naman goshinsa kana yace "Ba abinda kake tunani bane Affan... Na fad'a maka alk'awari nayi Salma taka ce...."

Cikin zuciyar Affan tafarfasa kawai take lallai ma Naseer ya raina masa hankali...  Yace suna hotel waima shine zaije ya d'auko su sannan harda wani cewa ba abinda yake tunani bane.... Naseer da Salma sunci amanar sa, he won't let them get away with this...  This innocent makauniya will pay the debt..... 

A fili kuwa gyaran murya yayi kana yace "Naseer ka kalli time kuwa,  bayan wannan ma baku san halin da muke ciki a nan ba, kuna can hotel kuna holewar ku or whatever mu muna nan muna neman Ilham ta b'ace ba'a ganta ba...."

Zunbur Naseer ya mik'e yana fad'in "Me kace Affan..."

Lokaci guda Affan ya sanar dashi halin da ake ciki..  Hankalin Naseer idan yayi dubu ya tashi,  baima san ta yanda zai soma sanar da Salma ba....  Affan ne ya katse masa shirun nasa da fad'in "Naseer bazan iya fitowa ba coz har yanzu nemanta muke kanyi... Daga haka bai jira cewar Naseer d'in ba ya katse wayar zuciyar sa na ci gaba da tafarfasa...  Suna can suna soyewar su shida Salma.. A fusace ya kuma komawa d'akin da Ilham take don dama shi ya rufe bathroom d'in, k'ura ma handle d'in k'ofar idanu yayi yana kallon yanda take ta k'ok'arin bud'ewa...  Zuciyar sa sai faman tafarfasa take masa tana kuma ingiza sa akan abinda yayi niyya... 

******

Cikin sauri Naseer ya kira wayan yaron sa guda ya fad'a masa location d'in da yake jiransa... Gaba d'aya kasa komawa d'akin yayi don baisan me zai soma fad'awa Salma ba.. Gaba d'aya hankalin sa yayi mugun tashi... 

Bayan kaman minti ashirin Samir ya iso hotel d'in...  Salma da har barci ya soma d'aukanta sai jin shigowar Naseer tayi,  haka kurum ta tsinci kanta da fad'uwan gaba...  

Naseer ya d'an dubeta kana yace "Taso mu tafi..."

Ita dai mik'ewa kurum tayi amma kam ta razana da yanyin da ta gansa ciki...  Bata ko iya tambayar sa ba sai suran jakarta da tayi ta shiga bin bayan sa.... 


******

Kuka Ilham keyi tana kuma tak'urewa jikin garu bata daina rok'onsa kada ya lalata mata rayuwa ba yaji tausayin ta.... Lokaci guda Affan ya d'auketa da wani wawan mari wanda saida ta kifa k'asa, lokaci guda bakinta ya fashe jini ya hau zuba.... 

Da k'arfin gaske ya kuma fincikota ya shiga d'aure mata baki da hannaye.. Sai faman fincika Ilham take numfashin ta na neman shid'ewa sanda Affan ke kokawan rabata da suturanta.... Lokaci guda idanunta suka kafe tamkar ta mace... 


Affan dake rik'e da ita yana wani irin huci lokaci guda hawaye suka shiga kwaranya masa,  kallon gefen bakinta yayi yanda jini ke zuba,  ya kuma duban makafin idanunta yanda suka kakkafe....  A hankali ya saketa ya koma gefe can k'arshen d'akin yana kuka sosai kukan da ya jima baiyi irin sa ba.. Tun daga farkon had'uwarsu da Salma ya shiga tunowa har zuwa aurenta da Naseer... Ya tuna kalan k'aunar juna da yake hangowa cikin idanun junan su.. Ya tuna yanda suke k'aunar juna shida Naseer tamkar brothers.... Yana son Naseer tamkar jinin sa....  Meyasa burin d'aukan fansa ya cika zuciyar sa.. Meyasa ya kasa yak'i da zuciyar sa... 
Tamkar wanda aka zabura a tamanin ya nufi parlor ya d'auko goran ruwa ya shiga shek'awa Ilham... Lokaci guda idanuwanta suka shiga motsawa....  Cikin sauri Affan ya sureta bai sunce d'aurin bakin nata ba ya fice da ita daga gidan..... 


Bayan wasu gini ya shimfid'ata lokaci guda ya k'ura mata idanu tausayin ta da haushin kansa suka cika zuciyar sa.... Cikin sauri ya mik'e ya bar wajen ba don yaso ba sai don kada wani ya gansa... Har lokacin ba'a daina k'anan yayyafi ba...  Haka yana ji yana gani ya tafi ya bar Ilham a wajen... 

A parlorn gidansa ya zauna ya tak'ure waje guda tunanin Duniya ta cika zuciyar sa.....  A hankali ya soma furta  "Ina sonki Salma soyayyar da ta tassama jefa rayuwata ga halak'a... Amma .. Nasan Naseer  na sonki fiye da yanda nakeyi,.... I just have to let you go even if it will break me....."   lokaci guda siriryar hawaye ta zubo ma Affan...  Runtse idanunsa yayi yana mai tuno halin da ya bar Ilham ciki ga bakinta a d'aure... Cikin sauri ya mik'e ya zura jacket d'insa ya fito waje... Dai-dai lokacin dasu Naseer suka iso 

Daga yanda yake hangosu saman kwalta ya kasa ci gaba da tafiyar....  Kaman ya juya cikin gidan nashi sai kuma nufosu da yayi...  Cikin sauri Naseer ya umarci Samir ya tsaya... 


Yanayin da yaga Affan ciki yasa jikinsa yin sanyi.... 

"An sameta....?"  Naseer ya tambaya yana dubansa... 

Kasa furta komai Affan yayi sai d'an girgiza kai da yayi kana yace "Naseer we couldn't....." Kasa ci gaba da maganar yayi sabida halin da ya tabbatar babu shakka ya bar Ilham ciki... Dai-dai lokacin Salma ta k'araso waken yayinda Naseer ke ci gaba da fad'in "No Affan bazai yuwu Ilham ta b'ace ba...  Dole tana cikin barikin nan batayi nisa ba, su waye a gate sanda abun ya faru... Kai no way.. Barikin nan bata lalace har haka ba... Affan idan da gaske b'ata tayi gaba d'ayanmu zai shafe m....."

Bai kai aya ba Salma ta k'araso tana kuka sosai hannayen ta k'unshe da bakinta take fad'in "A'a badai Ilham d'ita ba... Dan Allah ina 'yar uwata ku sanar dani tana lafiya....."

Naseer yayi saurin rik'ota ya matse cikin jikinsa yana kwantar mata da hankali ganin tana neman fita daga control... 

Affan kuwa juyawa yayi yana k'ok'arin maida hawayen dake neman zubo masa,  a yau d'in jinsa yake tamkar lusari ba Soja ba.. Dole ma yaji hakan,  sabida abinda yayi cin amanar kakin jikinsa ne.. Ya wulak'anta aikinsa,  lokaci guda ya kuma tuna halin da ya barta ciki... 


K'ok'arin saita kansa yayi lokaci guda ya take masu baya domin tuni sun nufi gidan Momy.... 


Shiru kawai Naseer yayi yana sauraren lamarin daga bakin Momy,  yayinda Salma da Jamila suka rungume juna suka tak'ure waje guda suna aikin kuka...

Momy taci gaba da fad'in "Tare da Affan aketa binciken kaman yanda ka fad'a shima hakan yace,  dole dai kawai a tsaurara bincike cikin barikin nan... Kar ta lalace ta zamto tamkar wasu barikin da tsaro yayi k'aranci, kodashike bamu sani ba ko ta fice ta fad'a wani wajen don ruwan da akayi yau ya tsorata kowa.."

Naseer ya juya yana duban Affan dake tsaye daga gefe d'an dafa kafad'ansa yayi kana yace "Kaje gida ka huta zamu ci gaba da gudanar da binciken..."

Saurin girgiza kai Affan yayi kana yace "Naseer bazan iya komawa gida ba har sai an samo Ilham...."

Naseer ya d'an tasare sa da idanu kafin ya jinjina kai ba tareda yace komai ba yasa kai zai fice... Har ya kai k'ofa sai kuma ya juyo yana duban yanda Salma ke kuka da duka zuciyar ta.. 

K'arasawa yayi ya durk'usa gabanta a hankali ya kamo hannayen ta... Cikin muryan kwantar da hankali yake fad'in "Insha Allah zan samota,  zan taho maki da ita kinji... Ki daina kuka...."

Bata iya ce masa komai ba sai kwanciya da tayi cikin jikin Jamila,  lokaci guda Jamila ta kuma rungumar 'yar uwar tata... 

A tare Naseer da Affan suka fice 

*******

 Gabaki d'aya barikin ta birkice lokaci guda,  hankula sun tashi,  ko ina bincike ake dukda dare da ya soma ja....  Affan da tawagar sa hakama Naseer da nasa tawagar


Shi yasan yanda ya ajiyeta don haka bai sha wahalan jan zugansa suka nufi wajen ba....  Gabansa ya yanke ya fad'i sanda ya hangi tamkar bata wajen...  Cikin sauri ya kuma kutsawa nan ya hangeta jikin reshen bishiya sai k'ok'arin yanka d'aurin hannunta take tana neman tsira a d'ari sauran Sojojin suka k'araso lokaci guda Affan ya d'agota yana fad'i ma sauran Sojin the should call an ambulance.......

Tuni labari ya riske su Naseer...  A asibiti suka tadda su Affan likitoci sun shiga duba Ilham don tuni ta kuma sumewa... 

Take Naseer yayi waya ya sanar da Momy,  ai basuyi wata-wata ba suka nufo asibitin suma...   

Daga Jamila har Salma godiya suka dinga yima Affan,  shi kuwa fir yak'i barin asibitin,  fatan sa bai wuce Dr ya sanar dashi Ilham na numfashi....

Naseer Salma kai take so sannan kaima kana sonta... Dan Allah ka rik'e matar ka hannu bibbiyu ka daina danganta ta da wani alhali da aurenka akanta..... Fatana Allah Ya baku zaman lafiya mai d'aurewa had'i da zuri'a d'ayyiba....."   ya k'arashe murmushi kwance saman fuskar sa.. 

Kasa furta komai Naseer yayi sai kallon da yake bin Affan dashi,  lokaci guda murmushi ya cika fuskar sa,  bai san sanda yayi hugging Affan ba don harga Allah baisan me zaice masa ba.... 


Da k'yar Affan ya bar asibitin ba don yaso ba... Tunanin halin da take ciki da zullumi duk ya taru ya cunkushe masa zuciya... 

Koda ya koma gida ma a parlor ya tak'ure yana tunanin abubuwa da dama da suke kan faruwa A DUNIYAR SU,  tunanin mahaifin sa ya fad'o zuciyar sa...  Tabbas idan da zaisan abinda yayi zaiyi fushi dashi na har abada... A wannan dare barci baiga idanun Affan ba,  ko ya runtse idanu Ilham yake hangowa yanda ya wahalar da ita ya azabtar da ita bisa laifin da sam babu nata ciki,  Allah sarki lallai makanta babban jarabawa ce a rayuwa,  tabbas da ace tana gani bazai sami damar gallaza mata da yayi ba.....  A hankali ya shafi sumar sa tunanin yak'i barin kwanyar sa....  Tamkar wanda aka zabura ya nufi drawers d'insa da yake jera whiskeys d'insa.... 

Zama yayi ya dinga kwankwad'a ko hankalin sa zai kwanta....

Har gari ta waye tangarau Salma na kwance gefenta hannuayen su cikin na juna...  Jikin Ilham d'in duk tabo yanda ta kukkurje kanta don neman hanyar tsira...  Kukanta ne ya farkar da Salma ta mik'e zunbur ta zauna tana mai lallashin Ilham d'in

Daga yanda yake tsaye bakin k'ofa yake jiyo sautin maganar ta da kukanta cikin k'aramar muryarta,  gabansa ya yanke ya fad'in jin yanda take fad'in ta tsane sa....  Bai iya k'wank'wasa k'ofar ba sai juyawa da yayi cikin sauri ya fice daga asibitin.....

Ki daina kuka insha Allah bazamu k'ara ficewa mu barki ke kad'ai a gida ba kinji koh...."

"No Jamila sai kin fad'a min me na maki,  Kin tafi daga gidanmu babu sallama sannan nayita kiran ki baki d'aga ba...  Jamila what's going on...?"

Saurin shan gabanta yayi fuskar sa tayi jazir yake fad'in "No...  Wasa kike yi koh,  kice min wasa kikeyi don Allah...."

Murmushin takaici tayi kana tace "Kasan meye ka bani hanya na wuce...."

Lokaci guda ya kuma girgiza kai yana mai fad'in "Idan matan duka duniya za'a kawo min... I'll still choose you.... I love you , pls let's fix this,  dan Allah kada kice zaki rabu dani...  Wllhi ban tab'a soyayya da Wata d'iya mace ba sai akanki...  Dan Allah kar ki bari labarin farkon soyayyata ya zamto kariyan zuciya....."

Yanda yake maganar ya kuma karyar mata da zuciya,  hawaye suka shiga wanke mata fuska... Inama zata iya sanar dashi gaskiyar lamarin inama ba Fawaz bane.....  Cikin sauri ta d'ago a fusace take fad'in


"Dr I beg of you,  please,  please just stay away from me,  dan Allah Fawaz....."   Daga haka tasa kai ta soma tafiya cikin sauri ta nufi asibitin.... Lokaci guda shima ya take mata baya

"Kana jina....."

Maina ya gyad'a kai daga d'aya b'angaren tamkar wacce take kallonsa kana yace "Ina jinki Hajiyata,  kud'i kike buk'ata a ciro maki akai maki gidan holewa, ko kuma sabbin 'yan mata kike buk'ata..." (Guest house d'inta)


Innah ta murmusa tana hura sigarinta kana tace "K'aramin shed'ani...  Kaima kasan a halin yanzu nafi buk'atar ka fiye da 'yanmatan..."

Innah ta jinjina kai kana tace "Yayi kyau....  Kasan yaro drivern Lubna...?"

Daga haka bata jira cewar Maina ba ta gutsire wayar...  Lokaci guda ta zuk'i sigarinta tana mai fashewa da wani irin dariya....

Da k'yar ya iya ciro k'afarsa da suka masa nauyi daga cikin mota, kallo yake kan faman bin gidan nasu dashi.... Ya dubi yanda Dad d'insa ke ajiye motar sa bai ga motar ba,  a hankali yaci gaba da takawa har ya isa sashen mahaifiyar sa... 

Daga bakin k'ofa yayi tsaye yana dubanta tana zaune cikin kujera tana kallon shirin animation a tashan yara....  Kallonta kawai yake sai sannan hawaye suka shiga gangaro masa.... Tausayinsu su duka biyu daga shi har ita ya cika masa zuciya....  A hankali yake takawa har ya isa gareta....  Flower d'in dake hannun sa ya mik'a mata still hawaye na gangaro masa...  Itama d'in lokaci guda hawaye suka shiga zubo mata, ta shiga sa hannayen ta gaba d'aya tana share ma Fawaz nasa hawayen....  Lokaci guda ya kuma bursting cikin tsananin kuka had'i da rungumeta yana mai fad'in "I love you Mum,  I love you so much....  I know you went through alot...  you've been suffering for all your life.... This life is so unfair why mum,  why did you choose that Man... why? Why please...  Mum meyasa kika zab'a min shi a matsayin uba, meyasa kika zab'i ya zama mahaifina....  Ki amsa min,  meyasa,  meyasa please.....!!!"  Kasa ci gaba da magana yayi sai k'ank'ame mahaifiyar sa da yayi yana wani irin kukan da bai tab'a irinsa ba a rayuwar sa..... 

********

Maina tuni ya silale ya bar wajen,  hankula sun kuma tashi,  duk k'ok'arin securities d'in ganin sun hanasu abinda sukeda niyya sun kasa,  tuni mutanen nan sun sumar da Engr Bala,  Naseer kuwa jini sai bin hancinsa yake,  sai faman d'auresa da igigiyoyi suke jikin wata k'arfe....  Abun da yake gani na shirin faruwa dashi yayi mugun girgiza sa,  bai zaci A DUNIYAR MU akwai mutane da zuciyar su ya bushe har haka ba... Da gaske suke watsa masa petur suna k'ok'arin banka masa wuta.....

Ganin tak'i bud'e idanu tak'i kallon sa yasa yin d'an gyaran murya kana yace "Ko mutum ya bud'e idonshi ko kuma na cire rigana gaba d'aya...."

Bai kai aya ba tayi saurin ware idanunta tana girgiza masa kai cikeda shagwab'a take fad'in "Nidai a'a Soja..."

Taso basa dariya, murmusawa yayi kana yace " Toh wai yaya za'ayi kiyi jinyar tawa da irin wannan kunyar.... Ko Momy bata sanar dake jinyar mijinki zaki zo ba...?"  

D'an muskutawa tayi kana ta kuma sunkuyar da kanta k'asa.... Murya can k'asan mak'oshi tace "Soja ai ni ban iya jinya ba..."

Ya murmusa yana mai jinjina yarintar ta kana yace "Kar ki damu zan koya maki yanda zakiyi...."  Ya k'arashe yana kwantar da ita cikin jikinsa.... 

D'aura tafin hannunta yayi saman nasa tamkar masu wasan tafa-tafa, Salma sai kallon hannun nasa take wanda yake tamkar jini zai fito itakam tana mamaki idan ta tuna mahaifiyarsa bak'ar fata ce,  sam babu alamun surki ajikinsa,  ko damn shike haka nan Allah yake ikon sa tunda, ta kuma tuna cewa shid'in mahaifin sa ya biyo....  Tana cikin tunanin ta tsinkayo muryarsa yana fad'in "Waini shekarunki nawa ne....?"

Kai tsaye ta basa amsa da "I'm clocking 20, December 29th zan cika..."

Naseer ya d'an murmusa kana yace "Noted gwara da kika sanar dani date d'in sabida ya zama saved a kwanyata...  Ilham ma ta gama sec school ne...?"

Girgiza masa kai tayi kana tace "Batadai yi jarabawar fita ba amma aji shida take..."

Naseer ya jinjina kai kana yace "Yayi kyau,  yanzu sai maganar schools d'inku idan abubuwa sun lafa da yardar Allah...."

Salma da tuni dad'i ya mamaye mata zuciya zasu koma school batasan sanda ta mak'ale sa tanai masa godiya ba....

Murmushi kawai yake yana dubanta yanda ta cika da murna zuciyarsa tai masa dad'i...  D'an kunya taji ta sake sa a hankali kana tace "Soja mun gode...."  Bata rufe baki ba ya d'ora d'an yatsan sa saman leb'enta kana yace "Godiyar nan ta isa haka Salma,  we are one okay...."

A hankali ta jinjina masa kai tana murmushi...  Shima d'in murmushin yake yana dubanta kana yace "Nifa har yau ba'ace min ana sona ba....  Ko har yanzu ban sami karb'uwa bane...?"

Saurin rufe fuskarta tayi tana murmushi... 

Hannayenta data rufe fuskar dasu Naseer ya kamo ya sauk'esu k'asa fuskarta ya bayyan....  Idanunsa k'uri a fuskarta labb'ansa d'auke da murmushi...  Cikin wata irin sassayan murya yace "Kar ki damu my love for you is enough for the both of us...."

A hankali ta ware idanuwarta tana dubansa murmushin saman fuskar sa bai gushe ba....  Lallai Soja masoyinta ne na hak'ik'a... A hankali ta maida nata idanun k'asa... 

Naseer yana son janta da wasa sabida ta saki jiki dashi,  d'an kamo hannunta yayi kana yace "Zo muje...."

Mik'ewa tayi tana tambayarsa ina zasuje...  Bai amsata ba har saida suka isa wata 'yar madaidaiciyan parlor wanda kayan motsa jiki ne kurum a ciki saiko wasu couches guda biyu na hutawa....

Kallon mamaki take binsa dashi, tadai ga lafiya bai ishesa ba yaushe kuma za'a motsa jiki,  itakam tsoron irin wad'an nan machines d'inma take... A hankali tace "Soja me zamuyi..."
 

Bai amsata ba sai zaunar da ita saman couch da yayi ya isa gaban TV yana jona wayoyi...  Saida ya ida had'a komai kana ya dawo yanda take hannunsa rik'e da headphones da kuma control d'in game... 

D'an d'agota yayi ya zauna cikin couch d'in daga baya yayinda Salma ta zamto a d'an gabansa ya mata matashi da jikinsa, Yana k'ok'arin saka mata headphones yake fad'in "Xbox zamu buga,  fad'i wani mission kike so....?"

Murmushi kurum tayi kana tace "nidai ban iya ba...."

Murmusawa yayi had'i da d'an jawo hancinta kana yace "Zaki koya ne...."  Daga haka mak'ala mata headphones d'in yayi shima ya saka ya bata control d'aya shima ya rik'e guda.....  

Salma sai faman dariya take ganin ba iya abin tayi ba sai gwara motocin take,  idan kuwa taji k'aran drift ta cikin headphones d'in ko ta gwara motocin sai ta k'ank'ame sa cikeda tsoro tana mai yin dariya... Shid'inma biye mata yake yana dariyan....  Idan ka gansu gwanin sha'awa kaman DUNIYAR SU ta tabbata a haka cikin jin dad'i da annashuwa.... 

*******

Abun duniya ya dami Shareefah, rashin dawowar su Mamy ya d'aga mata hankali...  Ta kira wayoyin su sau babu adadi baya shiga...  Yanzu kam sosai hankalinta ya tashi,  mik'ewa tayi ta nufi BQ ta tadda Deluwa, tana tambayarta ko su Mamy sun sanar da ita yanda zasuje... 

Deluwa tace bata sani ba,  gate ta nufa ta iske Baba mai gadi shima yace bai sani ba saidai yaga Hajiya a mota akazo aka d'auketa ita kuwa Shareefah acab'a ta d'ale... 

Shareefah tayi jigum tana tunanin lamarin,  tasan za'a rina Mamy da Azeema tamkar Tom and Jerry ne,  idan Mamy ta k'ulla wani abin Azeema taje warwarewa, toh kodai asibiti wajen Daddy sukaje...?  Amma da asibiti ne da Mamy ta sanar da ita... Mik'ewa tayi ta gabatar da sallan isha abinda ta jima batayi ba kana zuciyarta ta raya mata taje dai asibitin ta duba.... Ko cire hijab d'in batayi ba ta suri car keys d'inta ta fice....


********


Dr Basheer nata neman layin Dr Fawaz ya sanar dashi farfad'owar Alh Ali Safwan bai sami layin Fawaz d'in ba... Layin Naseer ya shiga nema nan ma bai samu ba, lokaci guda ya tuna ya karb'i layin d'ansa da suka jima tare jiya....  Nan yayi dialing laying Affan....  


Affan sanye da kayan training yana judging yaga kiran likitan Daddy na shigo masa,  tsayawa yayi yana d'an goge gumin fuskar sa kana ya shiga amsa kiran....

Cikin wani irin murya mai cikeda farin ciki yake fad'in "Dr are you serious....  Alhamdulillah... Alhamdulillah.... Gani nan zuwa Dr...."  Daga haka katse wayar yayi ya k'arasa gidansa a d'ari,  ko tunawa da Naseer baiyi ba ya suri motar sa ya nufi ganin mahaifin sa....  A hanya ya hangi Ilham da Momy zasu tsallake kwalta.... 


Lokaci guda ya paka motar nasa a gefe kafin ya nufosu,  fuskar sa cikeda annuri... 

Momy tana hangosa ta Saki murmushi.... 

"Kai kuma ina ka nufa da daren nan...."  Momy ta tambaya sanda yake k'arasowa... 

"Momy badai salesman ku akayi ba...."  Affan ya tambaya.... 

Jinjina masa kai Momy tayi kana tace "Gashi kuwa gida muka nufa,  sauran kayan da safe a d'auko...."

Idanunsa naga Ilham wacce murmushin ta ya k'aru tun sanda ya k'araso wajen kana yace " Amma Momy ai da nazo na maidaku gida, gashi patient ta wahala...."

Momy ta murmusa kana tace "Ai likitan ne yace ta d'an ware jini tunda babu wani nisan d'aga hankali...."

Affan yace "Still dai Momy muje na k'arasa daku...."

Sai sannan ya jiyo muryar Ilham tana fad'in "A'a Ya Affan nafin son tafiyar k'afan ne sabida jikina ya warware,  mun gode da kulawa...."

D'an murmushi yayi kana yace "Are you  sure...."

Jinjina masa kai kurum tayi fuskar ta cikeda murmushi....

"Ina ka nufa ne wai da daren nan,  ko gari zaka shiga..."  Momy ta kuma tambayar sa.... 

Affan na murmushi yake fad'in "Momy Daddy ne.....  Daddy is out of comma, yanzu likita ya kirani yake sanar dani...."

Hamdala suka dinga yi,  Ilham kuwa murmushi mai sauti take kana tace "Ya Affan da gaske kake,  Dan Allah ka gaisar min da Daddy kaji....  Naji dad'i wllhi...."

Murmushi Affan yake cikeda jin dad'i kana yace "Insha Allah Ilham zan sanar dashi kina gaishe shi"  Ya juyo ya dubi Momy kana yace "Momy ni na wuce...."

Momy ta masa fatan sauk'a lafiya had'i da addu'an k'arin sauk'i wa Daddy kafin ya wuce.... 

*******

 Ganin motar Fawaz a parking lot ba k'aramin d'aga masa hankali yayi ba,  wata zuciya tace what if Jamila ta sanar da Fawaz komai....? K'irjinsa ya kuma bugawa da k'arfin gaske.... Shi kad'ai ya shiga girgiza kai b'angare na zuciyar sa tana raya masa kai haba bazata iya ba duk rashin kunyar ta.... He already threatened her....Lokaci guda ya saki murmushi musamman da ya tuna an kawar masa da Naseer for good...  Duniya sabuwa, baibi takan Fawaz ba kai tsaye sashen mahaifiyar sa ya nufa... 


Zaune ya sameta a parlor sai aikin hura sigari take,  don sigari shine zikirinta na dare.... 'yar plate d'in dake bisa center table d'in guntu-guntun karan sigari wanda aka zuk'e sunfi biyar cikin ta....  Ga kuma wata kwali a gefe....  Yanda k'amshin turaren wuta ke kama gidajen mata masu yawan huld'a dashi haka warin sigari ya kama parlorn Innah.... 

Yana k'arasowa kwalin ya d'aga ya zari guda lokaci guda Innah ta dondala masa wutan sigarin daga jikin wanda take faman zuk'a.... 


Suna had'a idanu suka fashe da dariya..... 


Alh Kabeer yace "Ya zama tarihi,  yau na cika maki burin ki ..."

Innah ta feso hayak'in sigari ta hancinta kana tace " Ban tab'a jin dad'i irin na yau ba A DUNIYAR MU, Mafarki na ya zamto gaskiya,  dama irin mutuwar wulak'anci da nake so yayi kenan a k'one shege.... Kabeer a yau ka nuna min cewa kai d'an halak ne,  ban tab'a saka maka albarka ba amma yau zan saka maka....."

Bata kai aya ba wayan Alh Kabeer ya soma ruri ganin Maina ne mai kiran ya sanyasa saurin d'agawa... 


"Ya ka koma wajen ka tadda mushen nasa....?"  Ya tambaya cikeda isgilanci.... 


Maina ya shafi kansa kana yace "Mai gida banga mushen sa ba,  hasalima ban tadda kowa wajen ba, ina zaton dai sun wani wajen suka jefa sa amma kam akan idanuna suka watsa masa petur ni na tabbata sun k'onesa...."

D'an Jim Alh Kabeer yayi kafin yace "Shikenan kayi sauri ka bar wajen zamu had'u gobe da safe...."  Daga haka d'if ya katse kiran... 


Innah ta dubesa tace "Yaya mai ake ciki...."

Murmusawa yayi kana yace "kar ki damu ya zama mushe k'ila ma karnuka sunyi daldalan sa...."   A tare suka tuntsire da wani shegen dariyar bosawa....

Mamy ce ta soma farfad'owa sanda taji ana shureta da k'afafu....  Da k'yar ta bud'e idanunta,  tana farkawa taga Laure akanta...  D'an zabura tayi had'i da matsawa baya... 

Laure ta murmusa tace "Haba aminiya me yayi zafi ina zaki gudu, badai tsorota kika soma ba,  sai kace wata dodanniya,  haba Ma'u nice dai Laure taki mai warware matsaloli....."

Mamy ya jikinta ke faman rawa tak'urewa waje guda ta kuma yi kana tace "Laure kiyi wa Allah ki k'yalemu mu tafi... Ki tausaya mana Laure..."

Dariya Laure ta kwashe dashi kana tace "Ma'u bari na gwada maki tabbacin cewa bazaki bar wajen nan ba...."  

Lokaci guda Laure ta bud'e murya ta kirawo Steven dake bakin k'ofa kana tace "Bani madubin nan...."  

Take yabi umarninta ya mik'a mata.... 


Dai-dai fuskar Mamy ta nuna madubin lokaci guda Mamy ta hangi kanta cikin madubin....  Malu d'in da ta hango an taltale mata gashi tass harda shafe hoda ya sanya Mamy sakin k'ara tana k'ok'arin kai hannaye kanta... 

"Yanzu Laure da gaske aski kika min,  da gaske yankamu zakiyi....?"  Cewar Mamy murya na rawa... 


"Ga zahiri kuwa kin gani ko bakiga malu akanki bane....?"

Mamy ta soma girgiza kai tana kuma ahafa taltal d'in kanta take fad'in "Wayyo ni Asma'u wayyo Allah na.... Laure ban tab'a tsammanin A DUNIYAR MU akwai 'yan adam irinki ba...."

Mamy bata kai aya ba Laure tace "Aka samu irinki ma ballanta irina...."


Dai-dai lokacin aka shigo da Azeema itama an mata aski tal-tal, an shafe da hoda sai shining kan take.... 


Wurgi da akayi da ita ya sanya ta bud'e idanu a zabure....  Hango Mamy da tayi kayi bad'e da hoda ya sanya Azeema sakin k'ara tayi saurin shafan nata kan,  nan taji itama babu alamun suma.... 

K'ara Azeema ta saki tana kuka take fad'in "Ina suma ta,  wllhi Laure kin cika 'yar wuta... Mamy aski fah aka mana da gaske..... "

Laure ta shek'e da dariya kana tace "Au wai dama baku yarda gidan yanka kuka zo ba,  tunda an kwashe sumar ku zaku yarda yanzu....  Steve kawo masu abincin idan sunga dama suci idan kuma basuci ba yunwa taci uwasu don ba k'anwar uban kowa bane...."  Daga haka Laure tayi ficewar ta tana amsa wayar oganta... 

********

Shareefah hawaye Affan hawaye sanda Daddy ya kamo hannayen su,  dukda ba sosai ake jin maganar nasa ba yaran nasa sun basa tausayi sanda ya tuna mahaifiyar su ce ke yunk'urin kashe sa..... 


A hankali Daddy yake ambaton Asma'u...

Shareefah  ta kuma rik'o hannun Daddy cikin nata kana tace "Daddy zata zo.. Zata zo insha Allah.. Yanzu za'a kawota kaji...."  Ta k'arashe maganar tana duban Affan dake binta da kallon tuhuma domin shima cike yake da mamakin rashin ganin mahaifiyar tasu a wajen.... 


****** 

Mamaki ya cika Momy ganin Falaq kwance saman kujera ita kad'ai a parlor tana barci sauro sai cizon yarinyar suke...  D'an girgiza kai kurum tayi kafin ta d'auki yarinyar don kwana biyun nan sam basu gane kan Jamila ba..... 

Mamaki bai gama cika Momy ba saida ta k'araso corridor taga Ilham tsaye bakin k'ofa tana rok'on Jamila da ta bud'e mata k'ofar...  Ga kukan Jamilar kana jiyowa daga cikin d'akin.... 

*****


Mik'ewa yayi ya lek'a window ya hangi motar mahaifin sa....  Yana wani irin huci yake furta  "I'm gonna kill you...  I swear I'm gonna kill you..."  

Tamkar mahaukaci ya tokari k'ofar d'akinsa ya fice... 


Kai tsaye sashen mahaifiyar sa ya nufa bai same sa a nan ba.... Fitowa yayi yana tafiya tamkar zai kifa da k'asa ga wani irin huci da yake yi Ya nufi sashen Innah 



Babu kowa a parlorn k'asa haka yasa ya nufi sama kai tsaye... 



Alh Kabeer yana balcony yana amsa waya yayinda Innah ke zaune a parlorn tana shak'an hayak'inta...  Kaman daga sama sai ganin Fawaz tayi ya banko k'ofar parlorn ya shigo,  fuskar sa tayi wani irin jazir haka nan idanunsa,  bata tab'a ganinsa cikin makamanciyar wannan kamanni ba,  a d'ari ta mik'e tsaye tana murmushe ragowar sigarinta da hannunta.... 

Tun kafin ta sami zarafin masa magana ya nufo ta....  Innah gaba d'aya cikinta ya d'uri ruwa,  a tunaninta Fawaz yaji tattaunawarsu da Kabeer ne... Tuni ta soma jada baya tana muzurai take fad'in "Fa...Fawaz la......"

Bata ida magana ba ya tokari kujeran gefensa da ta tare masa hanya kana ya isa gaban Innah , cikin wani irin murya yake fad'in "Where is he....!!! Where the hell is he....!!!!

A d'ari Alh Kabeer ya katse wayan da yake ya isa k'ofar balcony d'in ya danna mata lock,  banda gumi babu abinda ke keto masa dukda sanyi-sanyi dake kad'awa a garin....

Kaman zai kifa ya nufi k'ofar, saidai yana murd'a ta yajita a kulle,  da k'arfin da Allah yayi masa ya shiga bugun k'ofar yana fad'in "Kabeer Santana ka bud'e k'ofar nan....!!!"

Innah har tsakar kanta take jin bugun, Lubna dake faman seat up a d'akinta lokaci guda take waya da abin k'aunarta Deeni,  d'abi'arta ne duk dare takan motsa jiki a d'akinta....  Tuni suka saka aya wa hiran tasu daga ita har Deenin don sun jiyo hayaniyar Fawaz da bugun k'ofar....  

A d'ari Lubna ta mik'e kafin ta d'au wayarta tace da Deeni "My Stalker  I'll call you back..."  bata jira cewar Deeni ba ta katse wayar ta fice a guje  ta nufi parlorn Innah yanda take tsammanin daga nan hayaniyar ke fitowa.... 


Bugun k'ofar yake da iya k'arfinsa jijiyoyin jikinsa sunyi rud'u-rud'u bai daina fad'in "Dad you better open this door...  Dad ka bud'e k'ofar nan....!!"

Innah ta k'araso tana k'ok'arin janye Fawaz, baisan sanda yayi wurgi da ita ba sai hannun Lubna dake k'ok'arin shigowa...
