Hawaye fita daga idanun Fawaz suke amma murmushi yake wanda kake iya hango fararen hak'waransa masu k'ara masa kyau idan ya bud'esu bai daina fad'in "Mum Mum.... I just can't believe you are back to your senses....  Mum since when.. Tun yaushe kika dawo hankalin ki...?"  Ya k'arashe yana kuma rik'o hannayen mahaifiyar  tasa... 

Itama d'in hawayen ne ke zubo mata kana tace "Fawaz tun ranar da ka kawo budurwarka gidan nan tun wannan rana hankali na ya dawo jikina,  na b'oye maku hakan ne sabida gudun kada mu fad'awa sharrin mahaifinka da Innah....  Fawaz wad'annan bayi biyu sun azabtar dani sun wahalar dani sun....."  Kasa ci gaba da magana tayi sabida kukan da yaci k'arfinta.... 

Fawaz ma hawayen kurum yake yayinda zuciyarsa ke ci gaba da tafarfasa...  Naseer kuwa har wannan lokaci ganin lamarin yake tamkar almara,  tamkar a wasannin kwaikwayo, Lubna tana nan rungume cikin jikinsa kuka sosai take itama.... 

Wayoyin Innah da Kabeer gaba d'aya babu wanda yake shiga, babu wanda yasan yanda suka tafi, lokaci guda an nemesu an rasa wanda hakan ya tabbatar wa Naseer sud'in masu laifi ne.... Abbahn sa ya shiga tunowa,  ya tuna sanda ya dawo daga makarantar kwana ya tambayi Innah mahaifinsa sai sallesa tayi tsaf tace dashi ya mutu gangaratsau babu koh tausasawa....  Zuciyar Naseer ta shiga masa zogi da wani irin rad'ad'i wanda bai tab'a jin irinsa ba his whole life... Yanason ganin Innah yana son yimata tambayoyi da dama,  a halin yanzu babu wanda yake buk'atan gani irin Innah dole ya ganta kuma dole ta amsa masa d'inbin tambayoyin da yake dasu wanda zai mata....  

Shigowan su Affan dasu Momy had'i da su Salma gaba d'aya ya sanya Naseer mik'ewa yana k'ok'arin kwantar da Lubna saman sofa... Saidai tuni Lubnar ta nufi Salma ta rungumeta sosai tana kuka... Yanayin da suka tarar dasu ya bala'in d'aga masu hankali... 

Salma rik'e Lubna tayi ba tareda sanin meke wakana ba... Lokaci guda ta sauk'e idanunta kan Sojanta wanda kana ganinsa kasan cikin tsananin tashin hankali yake,  bai iya furta masu komai ba sai kamo hannun Affan da yayi suka fice..... 

*******

Tafe suke a mota Affan yana kuma jinjina lamarin recently Mamyn sa ta tasamma kashe mahaifinsa yanzu kuma ace Alh Sa'oud ma matarsa da d'ansa ne suka kashe sa... Kai wannan wacce irin rayuwa ce,  wace irin duniya ce... 

"Affan na kasa yarda na kasa aminta,  Affan shin haka yana faruwa A DUNIYAR MU... Toh me Abbah ya masu,  meyasa zasu kashe shi... Affan don Allah kace min mafarki nake ba gaskiya bane,  dan Allah kace min zan farka daga wannan mummunar mafarki da nake,..."

D'an slow Affan yayi kafin ya paka motar gefen kwalta,  juyowa yayi sosai yana duban Naseer da tuni jikinsa tayi jajazir musamman fuskar sa da idanun sa kana yace "Naseer mu kuma kalan tamu k'addaran kenan A DUNIYAR MU,  wasu irin iyaye muka samu masu neman Duniya da k'arfin gaske ta hanyar kashe mazajansu hak'ik'a Manzon Allah SWA yayi gaskiya da yace _Al Duniya mata'un, wa khaira mata'ul Duniya Al mar'atul Saliha_ Duniya jin dad'i ne,  kuma mafi alkhairin jin dad'in duniya shine mace ta gari.. Hak'ik'a duk wanda baiyi dacen mata ba toh babu komai A DUNIYAR SA face bak'in duhu....  Nasan kana cikin wani yanayi Naseer amma kayi hak'uri ka karb'i k'addaran ka a yanda tazo maka ko nace mu karb'i k'addaran mu a yanda tazo mana,  wata rana duk wannan tashin hankula da tarzoma da muke arangama dasu A DUNIYAR MU zasu wuce zasu zamto tarihi da yardar Allah...."

Jinjina masa kai kurum Naseer yayi ba tareda ya iya furta koda kalma ba kafin Affan yaci gaba da driving don yasan gidansu Deeni,  lokacin da ya saka tsallen kwad'o a barikinsu akan Lubna da kansa ya dawo dashi gida 

Suna isowa suka tarar za'ayi sallah,  kai tsaye alwala suka wuce sukayi don suma su samu su sallaci mamacin,  Deeni yana hangosu ya d'an kauda kansa gefe, don har cikin ransa haushin duk wani d'an Santana family yake ji... Sun kula da hakan basu tak'ura sun masa gaisuwar ba sabida yanayin da suka gansa ciki..... 


Naseer da Affan tareda su akayi komai na mahaifin Deeni,  bayan sun komo daga biso ne suka shiga har cikin gida sukayiwa Mama Tani gaisuwa,  abin har wannan lokaci damun Naseer yake,  wai Innah da Yayan sa Kabeer ne sukayi wannan aika-aika, kenan su kashe rai a wajen su ba komai bane, innalillahi wa Inna'ilaihirraji'un....  Allah ka mana tsari da sharrin zuciya...  Tambayar da yake yi ma kansa shine _Me mahaifin Deeni ya masu suka kashe shi..._ Bai kai ga samo amsar tambayar ba Affan ya d'an dafasa yace suje waje su sami Deeni....

Idanun Deeni sun kad'a sunyi jazir, duk wanda ya gaishesa da k'yar yake iya amsawa,  aiko yana hango su Naseer ya mik'e daga wajen yasa kai zai nufi cikin gida... 

Affan ne yayi saurin cimmasa had'i da d'an rik'o hannunsa, murya can k'asa yake fad'in "Dan Allah ka bari mu maka gaisuwa..."

D'agowa Deeni yayi yana duban Affan kaman zaiyi magana sai kuma yasa kai yayi shigewar sa cikin gida...  Mama Tani tana gani ya wucesu ita da 'yan unguwa masu karb'an gaisuwa Deeni yayi shigewarsa d'aki...  Kallo ta bisa dashi kaman zatayi magana sai kuma ta hangi Affan na d'an lek'o kai cikin gidan daga zaure.... 

A hankali ta mik'e ta isa bakin zauren nan ta iske harda Naseer tsaye a wajen su duka biyun sunyi jigum-jigum

"A'a Soja yaya kuke tsaye  a nan lafia dai koh....?"  Ta tambaya tana duban su Naseer d'in

Affan ne ya sami zarafin amsata da "Eh lafia Mama dama muna so mu gaisa da Deeni ne sannan muji yanda Al'amarin ya kasance....?"

D'an jim Mama Tani tayi kana tace "Anya kuwa ya kamata ku masa maganar yanzu,  da dai ku gaishe san amma d'ago masa maganar yanzu akwai tashin hankali cikinta kunga yanzu aka komo daga biso...."  Ta k'arashe cikin k'arfin hali,  don daga jin muryar nata k'arfin hali kurum take.... 

Affan ya d'an jinjina kai kana yace "Haka ne Mama,  ayi mana iso mu gaishesa..."

Jinjina kai tayi kana tace "Ku biyo ni...."

Affan ne ya sami zarafin amsata had'i da take mata baya,  bai kula da Naseer da gaba d'aya hankalin sa baya wajen ba yayi nisa duniyar tunani sai jin hannun Affan yayi yana janyosa suka nufi cikin gidan... 

Daga bakin k'ofa suka tsaya saida Mama Tani ta shiga tayi masa magana wanda basu jiyo ba kafin ta fito tanai masu iso.... 

Koda suka gaishesa tamkar bazai amsa su ba tamkar bazaice dasu komai ba sai kuma hawaye suka soma zarya a idanunsa sanda ya soma fad'in "Gaisuwa kuka zo mana ko kuwa zuwa kukayi ku dawo min da mahaifina....?  Bana buk'atar gaisuwan ku,  da lokacin da zaku b'ata a nan da sunan gaishe ni da zuwa kukayi kuka capke wad'ancan azzaluman wanda suka mayar da kisa da sab'on mahallicin su ba komai ba....  Nasan bazaku masu komai ba sabida mahaifiyar ka ce da kuma Yayan ka....  Sun kashe mahaifina sunji dad'i sunacan suna ci gaba da rayuwarsu sabida Allah ya basu arziki A DUNIYAR MU... Toh ku sani idan sun tsere ma hukuncin da ta kamacesu A DUNIYAR MU bazasu tsere ma hukuncin mahaliccin mu ba ranar da gabb'ai zasu bada shaida....."


Duk maganan da yake Naseer ya kasa koda d'ago kansa sabida wani irin tashin hankali da yake ji na kuma taso masa....  K'irjinsa tanai masa zafi sosai.... Affan ne ya d'an d'ago da niyyan yima Deeni magana amma sai gani sukayi Deeni ya mik'e yana nuna masu k'ofa yake fad'in "Ku fita,  ku fita kafin na fitar daku da k'arfi....  Ku dukanku aikin tsaron k'asa da kare lafiyar Al'umman cikinta kuke,  na tabbata kunsan hukuncin da ya kamace su... Idan baku hukunta su ba k'aryar kakin da kuke sakawa kuke... K'aryar ikirarin Soji kuke.... Ku fice mana a gida... Ku rik'e gaisuwar ku don batada amfani a wajen mu....."  Yana ida fad'in haka ya d'aga masu labule sosai alamun su fice sai faman tururi da huci yake ga idanunsa da suka kad'a sukayi jazir.... 

Gaba d'aya jikin Naseer yayi wani irin sanyi,  jinsa yake tamkar wani lusari yau d'in,  ganin Duniyar yake tamkar ba tasu ba...  Kwanyarsa ta gaza d'aukan abubuwan...  Bai tab'a tunani zai gamu da iftila'i makamancin wannan ba A DUNIYAR SA....  Affan ne ya kamo Naseer suka fice daga gidan suka fito har bakin lungun... 

Naseer yaja ya tsaya ya kasa ci gaba da tafiya sai tunanin kalaman Deeni yake,  sai yawo cikin kwanyar sa maganganun suke.... 

Affan bai ce masa komai ba sai d'an jingina da garun da shima yayi,  lokaci guda tunanin mahaifiyarsa da Azeema ya shiga yawo cikin kwanyarsa,  yasan mahaifiyar tasa mai laifi ce amma yana son sanin yanda take da kuma halin da suke ciki daga ita har Azeema... 

Wasu matasa ne guda biyu suka zo wucewa suna labarin azabar dasu Aljan suke ganawa wani mutumi cikin uncompleted building dake k'asa kad'an da lungun.... 

"Baaba wllhi Aljan jan d'an iska ne ko kasan da na tambayesa sai ce min yayi shine mutumin da ya kashe Baban Zahraddeni...  Tsohon mutumin nan da ya jima yana kwance yana jinya,  shine kurum wani azzalumi ya k'arasa sa....waima da nace ma 'yan iska su mik'asa wa hukuma sai ce min sukayi ai sune hukuman su zasu mar hukunci...."   

Abokin yayi dariya yana girgiza... Naseer da ya bisu da kallo yana nazarin kalaman saurayin saurin k'arasawa garesu yayi kana ya masu sallama...  Suka amsa da sakin fuska kafin ya soma tambayar su gameda labarin da suke, 

Samarin suka masu kwatance har yanda kongon ginin yake.... Naseer ya masu godiya kafin ya k'araso ya janyo Affan suka shige mota suka nufi hanyar da samarin suka kwatanta masu.... 



Su Naseer suna isa wajen su Aljan suka ahiga haye katanga da window suna guduwa... 

Maina na zube a wajen numfashi ma da k'yar yake,  hannayen sa da bakinsa a d'aure ga jikinsa duk jini ta ko ina.... Daga Affan har Naseer kallon ikon Allah suke ko Soja iyaka yayi irin wannan azaba wa d'an Adam shiyasa sam ba'ason fad'a da jahili don ko me ya samu rarumaka zaiyi... 

Cikin sauri Affan ya k'arasa ya d'agosa had'i da kwance masa d'aurin bakin.... 

Naseer sabida tsaban takaicin Maina da yake ji gaba d'aya ji yayi tamkar ya shak'e sa ya k'arasa....

Maina sai nishi yake yana bud'e idanu da k'yar had'i da haki tamkar wanda yayi gudun kilometer d'ari...  Ko iya masu magana baiyi ba.. 

Affan dake rik'e da Maina ya dubi Naseer dake faman huci da d'an madaidaicin hancinsa wanda bai faye tsawo da fad'i kana yace "Captain ina muka nufa..."

"Station of course...."  Naseer ya fad'i yana k'arasawa jikin mota... 

Ruwa-ruwa Affan ya jefa Maina a bayan mota uwa tsumma

*****


Gaba d'aya Jamila ta kasa sakewa a parlorn musamman dataga Fawaz da mahaifiyarsa a wajen,  ga Lubna tak'i sakin Salma abin tausayi,  kuka take babu k'akk'autawa har muryarta ya daina fitowa... Idan ta runtse idanunta Innah take hangowa da 'yan matan nan,  haka idan ta toshe kunnuwanta sautin Innah da Maina ya kasa barin cikin kunnuwanta, da kunnenta take jiyo mahaifiyarta tana fad'in akar mutum,  akan idanunta ta kalli mahaifiyarta da 'yanmata,  kenan mad'igo mahaifiyarta takeyi... Innalillahi wa Inna'ilaihirraji'un.. Wacce irin rayuwa muka tsinci kawunanmu ciki A DUNIYAR MU...?  ALLAH Sarki tun sautin kukan nata na fitowa har ya koma sai zallan hawaye idanunta masu zuban ruwa kuwa sama suke kallo tamkar maras lafiya.... 

Yanda kasan gidan makoki haka suke zaune a parlorn,  babu mai furta koda kalma guda,  kowa yayi jigum-jigum,  harta Ilham da ba gani take ba tasan gidan cikin matsanancin tashin hankali suke maras fasaltuwa....  


Fawaz dake rik'e da mahaifiyarsa a hankali ya d'ago idanunsa yana duban Jamila wacce Ilham ke rik'e da ita gam....  Lokaci guda Falaq ta soma kuka sosai Momy na faman jijjiga ta... Aunty Saudat ta d'ago idanu tana duban yarinyar tausayinta ya cikata...  Ta k'arasa ga Momy tana k'ok'arin karb'an Falaq d'in yarinyar tak'i karb'anta sai kuka take... 

Ga mamakin su sai ganin Fawaz sukayi ya k'araso yana k'ok'arin amsar yarinyar.. Lokaci guda ta amshi Fawaz ta daina kuka... Gaban Jamila yaci gaba da bugu,  wani sabon soyayyar Fawaz yana taso mata ganinsa da tayi rungume da Falaq,  shid'inma ita yake duba saidai Aunty Saudat ta kula da yanayin Fawaz da Jamilar,  murmushi ta sakar ma d'an nata kafin ta kamo hannunsa tana fad'in yazo suje.... 

Babu musu ya shiga bin bayanta yana rungume da Falaq d'in tamkar rak'umi da akala.... 

Suna ficewa Jamila ta runtse idanunta hawaye masu d'umi suka gangaro mata.... Ta ina zata soma rayuwa gida guda da Fawaz,  dole ta rok'i Momy su koma base don Allah ya gani bazata iya zaman wannan gida ba... Yanzu haka zuciyarta tsananin zafi yake mata,  matsanancin ciwon k'irji take fama dashi saidai bata sanar da kowa cikinsu ba....

A tare Affan da Naseer suka shigo cikin cell d'in da aka gark'ame Maina bayan an kira wani jami'in lafiya ya duba tsananin raunin dasu Aljan suka masa don tuni har kunnensa guda sun yanke ga yankan wuk'a a jikinsa waje daban-daban, idan kaga Maina idanba ka masa farin sani bane da k'yar ka ganesa don tuni sun canza masa halitta lokaci guda....

Hannayen Naseer a kunkumi yake k'arewa Maina kallo kafin yace "Ina jinka zakayi magana ko sai na k'arasa ka gaba d'aya......"

Maina ya d'ago yana numfashi da k'yar kana yace "Rankashidad'e ai ni babu abinda zance maka sai godiya da ka kub'utoni hannun marassa imanin nan,  nasan da baku zo ba da tuni na jima a barzah....."

Bai kai aya ba Affan ya d'aukesa da wata jahilar mari kana yace "Kai waye sa'anka a nan,  tambayarka abu muke ba labarai muka ce ka bamu ba....  Ina bosses d'inka,  ina suka shiga.. ?"

Maina da tuni ya saki ihun azaba rik'e fuskar sa yayi yana muzurai kana yace "Rankashidad'e wllhi ban sani ba ban sani ba,  idan na fad'a maku kasheni zasuy....."

Bai kuma kai aya ba Affan ya kuma kifa masa wata jahilar Marin wanda saida ya sanyasa canza position d'in zama... 

Ya soma k'ok'arin warware belt d'in wandonsa yana k'ok'arin ciro bindiga gefen wandonsa yake fad'in "Ba'a mana wargi idan kun saba yima 'yansanda suda kuka raina......"

Ai Maina bai bari ya k'arashi zuge belt d'in ba ya soma fad'in "Allah taimake ka wllhi zan fad'i.... Suna can suna can gidan holewar Innah,  gidan da take kai 'yan matan ta da take hutawa dasu... Can wuntindada eh wllhi can suke... Dan Allah ku min rai kar ku kasheni wllhi duk wani bak'in aikin da nayi su suka sakani....."  Yanda yake maganar zaka fahimci a gigice yake... 


Daga Naseer har Affan cak suka tsaya suna sauraren ikon Allah.....  "Gidan holewarta da 'yan mata..."   Abinda Naseer ya nanata kenan a fili...  Zuciyarsa taci gaba da bugawa... Anya Innah ba burbud'in maguzawan fari bane... Anya Innah 'yar Adam ce, anya wannan mata itace mahaifiyarsa.....?  Sunbatun da zuciyarsa ta dinga jero masa kenan... Ji yake k'afafunsa suna neman gaza d'aukansa... Wai meke faruwa ne  a duniyar su....  Gaba d'aya ya kuma shigewa cikin wani tashin hankalin lokaci guda,  zafin da k'irjinsa ke masa ya k'aru... Affan ya lura da rawar da k'afafun Naseer keyi cikin sauri ya tallafesa ya zaunar sa saman benci.... 


Magana Affan yake masa na kwantar da hankali amma ko kalma guda bazai iya cewa ga abinda ya fahimta a sunbatun da Affan d'in ke masa, don yafi danganta maganganun nasa da sunbatu....  So yake koda kuka ne yayi amma ya kasa... Ya nemi yanda akeyin kuka ya rasa.. Innah Innarsa ce duk mai aikata irin wad'annan k'azaman manyan laifuka,  itace kisan kai itace mad'igo,  toh ma anya musulma ce....  Zuciyarsa yaci gaba da bugawa sai duru-duru da yake gani.. 

Affan ya dubi Maina yanaso ya basa exact location na gidan saidai ga dukkan alamu Maina baisan me yakeyi ba... Don gaba d'aya bashi a hayyacinsa banda fad'in _Sun karsu Sun karsu_ Baya komai....

Cikin sauri Affan ya fice yana kiran wasu 'yansanda,  DPO ya k'araso suna tattauna lamarin da Affan.....  DPO Ayuba ya had'a mota guda na 'yansanda suka nufi unguwar da gidan Innah yake...  Shi kuwa Affan dole ya d'auki Naseer da niyan maidasa gida don gaba d'aya bai gane kansa ba,  saidai suna d'aukan hanyar gida Naseer yace dashi su bi bayan motar 'yansandan... 

D'an kallonsa Affan yayi kana yace "Naseer ya kamata...."   Bai kai aya ba Naseer ya daka masa tsawa da fad'in "Nace kabi bayansu...!!"

Affan ya bisa da kallo yanda yaga Naseer d'in har wani rawa jikinsa keyi... Cikin sauri ya karya kan motar yabi bayan motar 'yansandan.....

Innah na haki take duban Kabeeru don d'an gudun da tayi gaba d'aya sai haki take abinka da mai busa sigari ji take huhunta tamkar zai fice daga k'irjinta.... 

"Mai kake shirya mana,  ina muka nufa?  Don na tabbata izuwa wannan lokaci an soma neman mu..."  Ta k'arashe tana k'ok'arin tsugunawa a wajen.... 


"Mai kuwa na shirya banda barin gari, saidai kafin na bar gari sai na d'auko Kitty na taho da ita don bazan iya rayuwa babu ita ba......"  Ya k'arashe yana haki shima sabida gudun da sukaci ba kad'an bane... 

"Kitty...?  Uwar waye kuma Kitty...?"   Ta tambaya tana watso masa mugun kallo... 


"Ba uwar kowa bace,  Mace guda da nake k'auna kenan A DUNIYAR MU,  kuma idan na d'aukota na tattaro duk wasu ajiyana guduwa zanyi daga ni sai ita.... Innah kema sai ki kama gabanki sabida na tabbata zunubanki sunfi nawa....."

A hankali Salma ke k'ok'arin bud'e idanunta da suka mata nauyi ga tari da ta soma yi sabida shak'an hayak'in sigarin Innah da tayi.... 

Hazo-hazo ta soma gani tamkar mutum ne zaune gabanta har ta k'arashi bud'e idanun nata sosai... Fuskar Innah ya bayyana cikin idanunta....  Ta yunk'ura zata tashi sabida tsananin figici da tsoro amma saijinta tayi a d'aure gam-gam.... Abunda ya faru ya shiga dawowa kwanyarta....  Jikinta ya shiga rawa sosai ba tareda ta iya koda ihu ba.... 

Murmushi Innah ta sakar mata tana kuma zuk'an sogarinta dake tsakankanin yatsunta kana tace "Barka da zuwa sirkata, matar d'ana abin alfahari na...."

Salma kasa furta komai tayi jikinta bai daina karkarwa ba... D'aga kan da zatayi ta hango Alh Kabeer da kaya irinta laboratorians sai had'a wasu abubuwa yake cikin sirinji wanda yafi kama da acid....  Ba tareda ya juyowa ba yake fad'in "I'm glad you're finally awake Mrs Naseer Sa'oud Santana...."   Ya k'arashe yana wata irin kafiran dariya dai-dai sanda ya saita sirinjin dake hannun sa.... 

Banda kallon kallo babu abinda Salma ke binsu dashi ga k'irjinta dake bugu kaman zai fito waje... 

"Ina ne nan,  a ina nake... Dan Allah ku maidani gida,  na rok'e ku dan Allah kada ku cutar dani...."  Ta k'arashe cikin tsananin rawar murya... 

Tsawa Innah ta daka mata kafin taci gaba da fad'in "Kabarinki ne nan... Idan kuma kinga kin fita da rai toh Naseer ya fanshi rayuwarki ne ta hanyar kashe kansa...."  Ta k'arashe tana kuma zuk'an sigari had'i dayin wata irin dariya mai tsananin sauti... 

Kuka Salma take tana girgiza kai kana ta soma fad'in "Dan Allah Innah ki tausaya mana kar ki cutar damu,  dan Allah kada kice Soja ya kashe kansa... Wllhi dai-dai da rana guda bai tab'a tunanin sab'a maki a matsayinki na mahaifiyar sa ba...."

Kabeer ne ya katseta da fad'in "K'anwarmu ki kwantar da hankalin ki zaki fita daga wajen nan a raye muddin Addarki ta amince dani ta yarda zata bini duk yanda na nufa A DUNIYAR MU.... kin fahimta...?"  Ya k'arashe maganar yana d'ago zungureriyar allurar wanda tafi kama da irin alluran da ake ma dabbobi dabbobin ma irin su doki da danginsu....  

Jikin Salma yaci gaba da k'yarma ganin wannan zungureriyar allura da tayi ga kuma wani shud'in ruwa cikinta wanda ba sai ance maka poison bane....  Shi kansa hannayensa rufe cikin gloves ya had'a ruwan.... 

"Dan Allah... Dan Allah kuyi hak'uri kar ku cutar da Addah da Soja... Na rok'i arzikin ku.."  Batakai aya ba Innah ta d'auketa da mari da bayan hannunta wanda saida yasa fuskar Salma kifawa,  ta saki k'ara a gigice... 

Cikin sauri Innah ta kuma kamo fuskar Salmar had'i da matse hab'arta da kakkausan hannunta wanda yake k'ashi da fata ne zalla, cikin hura hanci da zare idanu take fad'in "Idan d'iyata Lubna ta amince ta dawo gareni sannan tsinannen yaron nan Naseer ya kashe kansa da hannayensa toh na tabbata maki zan k'yaleki da ranki... Na kashe rayuka da dama don cimma burina na d'aukar fansa akan jinin Hidaya....  Wllhi wllhi kaman yanda mahaifiyarsa tayi sanadiyar mutuwan tawa mahaifiyar toh shima sai ya bak'unci lahira.....  Kabeer saita min computern nan ka kira layin Naseer ka hasko ma tsinanne matarsa a hannunmu na tabbata ganinta haka zaisa ya kar kansa,  sannan Lubna zata zo gareni... Abinda nake buk'ata kenan kurum A DUNIYAR MU..."

Izuwa lokacin kam ba wahalan da take ciki bane ke damunta,  a'a kalaman Innah ne wanda suka matuk'an girgiza mata zuciya ya shiga bugawa a kwanyarta,  tsoro da firgici ya kuma wanzuwa a tattere da ita.... Hasashenta na cewa Soja ba jinin Innah bane yana nema zama gaskiya....  Ta nemi kukan da take ta rasa... Sai wani mugun kallo kurum da ta shiga bin Innah dashi dukda azaban rik'on da Innar ta mata....

Gaba d'aya sunyi tsuru-tsuru a parlorn gidan,  kowa hankali tashe sun hallara waje guda....

Don sanda ya shiga d'akinsa yaga burbud'in hodar da suka shek'awa Salma a hanci,  da alama shi ya bugar da ita har suka samu suka sace ta,  ba kowa yake tunanin zaiyi wannan aiki ba sai Yayansa Kabeer...

Bazan tab'a yafe ma kaina ba sannan bazan kuma saka kaki na ba...  Get the hell out of my way...."  Ya k'areshi yana k'ok'arin hankad'e Fawaz lokaci guda wayarsa ta shiga ruri....

Naseer is your turn,  kai kuma fah zaka cikita condition d'in namu ko kuwa ka zab'i a kashe Salma farin cikin rayuwar ka....."  Ya k'arashe maganar yana d'ago sirinjin yana mai ci gaba da fad'in "Ta mutu har abada idan na mata wannan alluran.....  Kai naman jikinta gaba d'aya diddigewa zaiyi kaga kuwa ba mutuwar dad'i zatayi ba.... Zaka kashe kanka ko kuwa ka zab'i na hudata da alluran nan...."

Soja kar ka kashe kanka ka yak'i wad'annan azzalumai biyu wanda suka jima suna zalunci....  Ka yak'e su na tabbata kaine a samansu......"  Ta k'arashe tana kuka sosai....

Wannan shine abinda suka jima suna so.....  Babu mai tabbata idan na tafi suma zasu tafi...."   Naseer ya k'arashe yana kuma saita bindigar, fatar jikinsa gaba d'aya ta sauya launi zuwa jazir....

Kan kace me abinka da technology har sun gano location d'in su Innah...

Ka kuladasu a nan kaji...."  Ya k'arashe yana bubbuga kafad'un Fawaz... Bai jira cewar Fawaz d'in ba ya shige mota.... A d'ari suka fice Naseer da 'yansandan waya manne kunnuwar su...   

Suna ficewa motar Sojoji daga Base d'insu suka iso gidan domin tsaida doka,  tuni sun kewaye gidan suka shiga bata tsaro.....

K'erere Innah ke dubansa kafin tace "Kabeer ni zaka ma rashin mutunci ni zaka juyama baya.... ashe kanada wacce ta fini A DUNIYAR MU..?"

Affan da Naseer d'in ne suka shigo Affan ke driving yayinda Naseer ke mazaunin mai zaman banza,  Da alama Fawaz ma dawowar su yake jira,  don suna isowa ta hangi fitowar sa shima...

K'arasawa tayi ta zauna saman coffee chair dake daga can k'arshen parlon ta d'an yaye labulen sosai yanda zata iya hango fitowar Fawaz daga sashen Naseer d'in.... 

Har gyangyad'i ya d'an soma sand'anta can ta hangi Fawaz ya fito ya nufi nasa sashen....  A hankali ta mik'e tana kuma gyara zaman hijab d'inta kafin ta fito ta nufi sashen Naseer d'in... 

Tana isowa ta tarar k'ofan parlorn a bud'e take don tana d'an turawa ta bud'e gaba d'aya... 

Yana nan zaune a parlorn ya rik'e kansa da duka hannayen sa biyu.... Bata tab'a ganinsa cikin yanayin ba gaba d'aya sai taji idanunta suna k'ok'arin rau-rau...

K'amshin da ya doki hancinsa ne ya sanyasa d'ago fuskar sa....  K'uri ya mata yana kallonta yanda taja ta tsaya daga bakin k'ofa... K'ak'aro murmushi yayi ya sakar mata lokaci guda ta soma takowa ta nufosa....  Saidai tana isowa yanda yake ya mik'e ya rungumeta sosai cikin jikinsa.... 

Gaba d'aya tausayin Soja ya cikata jin kalan bugun da k'irjinsa keyi....  Duk sai jikinta yayi sanyi sosai... 

A hankali yake fad'in "I want to cry... Salma ina so nayi kuka ko pain d'in dake k'irjina zai ragu....  Please tell me this is not happening....  Dan Allah kice min mafarki nake ba Innah ta bace.... Salma na kasa yarda Innah tana duka wad'annan k'azaman laifuka.... Dan Allah kice min mafarki nake....."  Ya k'arashe siririyar hawaye tana gangaro masa daga idanunsa guda....

Kallonta yake yanda take maganar cikin rawar murya kafin ya kamo hannayenta ya matse su sosai cikin nasa idanunsa na duban fuskarta yake fad'in "Salma meyasa zasu gudu.... Inada tambayoyi da dama da zan masu.....  Salma ko finafinai ban tab'a karo da makamancin wannan lamari ba sai kuma ace gashi a gidanmu yana faruwa akaina... Idan nace maki kwanyata tana dab da tarwatsewa ban maki k'arya ba....."  Ya k'arashe murya na rawa tamkar ba Sojan data sani ba gaba d'aya sai ta nemi kalma guda a bakinta ta rasa,  don tasan muddin tace zatayi magana toh fah kuka kawai zatayi....   

Yana nan mak'ale cikin jikinta ya kasa barinta ta tashi balle ta nemo masa abin tab'awa don tasan babu komai a system d'insa...   K'arshe data damesa zata tashi saima kwanciya bisa laps d'inta da yayi had'i da lumshe idanunsa...

Washe gari tuni Fawaz yasa anyi manyan hotunan Innah da mahaifinsa an rubuta WANTED k'asar hotunan da manyan harrufa... 

Naseer kam kasa cewa komai yayi da ya gani,  banda abin Fawaz wannan ai bankad'an asiri ne da tonon silili wa Santana Family....  Saidai Fawaz d'in ko ajikinsa idan da wad'anda yafi tsana A DUNIYARSA toh wad'annan bayi biyu ne...  Bashida burin da ya wuce a rapke su su soma d'and'ana kud'ansu...

A hankali ta soma bud'e idanunta abubuwan da suka faru suka shiga dawowa kwanyarta....  Zabura tayi zata tashi saiji tayi an rik'e hannunta anai mata sannu da harshen fillanci....  Mamy ta ware idanunta sosai nan ta fahimci yanda take,  d'an bukka ne sai kuma gadon azara da take bisa... 

Takai dubanta ga macen data rik'e hannunta wacce ke faman mata sannu cikin harshen hausa wannan karan dukda hausar gwari-gwari ce bata fita sosai.... 

Mamy ta soma karanto salati tana tambayar a yanda take.... 

Matar kuwa tuni ta mik'e tana kwand'arwa mijinta kira tana fad'in matar ta tashi 


Dattijon ya shigo hannunsa d'auke da wata k'ok'o wanda ko ba'a ce maka ba ruwan addu'a ne cikinta nan ya shiga yayyafawa Mamy dake faman masu sunbatu sarara,  lokaci guda kuwa tayi shiru ta daina sunbatun bayan Dattijon ya yayyafa mata ruwan... 

Zama yayi daga can gefen matarsa su duka suna duban Mamy kafin Dattijon ya soma magana cikin harshen hausa wanda shima nashin ba fitowa sosai take ba... 

"Sannunka bawan Allah....  Kar ka damu ka tsira da izinin Allah... Fad'a mani me ya kawo ki gonata....?"

Ya k'arashe yana duban Mamy wanda banda kuka babu abinda take.... 

Kallonsu take su duka biyu kana tace "Bayin Allah don Allah ina ne nan,  a ina nake....?"

Dattijo da matarsa suka dubi juna kana sukace "K'auyen Durun kake baiwar Allah..."  Matar taci gaba da fad'in "Mai gidana ne ya tsince ka a gonar sa.. Kai kuwa waye ya satoka don ga dukkan alamu mugaye suka sace ka koh..."  Ta k'arashe tanayi wa Mamy k'uri tamkar zata shige cikinta...

Mamy ta shiga jinjina kai cikin sauri,  kafin ta dubi mutanen tace "Dan Allah ku taimaka min na k'arasa cikin Bauchi wllhi satoni akayi..."  Ta k'arashe muryarta na rawa sosai.... 

Matar ta d'an dubi Mamy kana tace "Jiya baka a hankalinka da maigidana ya kawoki nan,  sanda na baka abinci haka kayita turawa bama kasan kanayi ba... Da alama yanzu hankalinka ya dawo....  Toh garin yaya aka sace ka....?"  Bafulatanar ta kuma tambaya tana gyara zama,  basai ance maka masu son jin labarai bane.... 

Mamy bata amsata ba sai mik'ewa da tayi sosai sai kuma taji d'akin ya kasa ma tsawonta cikin sauri ta nufo waje tana fad'in "Gida nake son tafiya,  dan Allah ku maidani gida...."


Gaba d'aya mata da mijin suka mik'e suka biyo Mamy waje... 

Ganin sun tare gabanta su duka biyu ya sanya cikin Mamy bada wani sauti....  A razane take fad'in "Bayin Allah don Allah kada ku cutar dani... Wllhi ukuban da na shiga ciki ma kawai ya isheni ishara A DUNIYAR MU,  dan Allah ku k'yaleni haka nan kada  ku cutar dani...."

Dattijon ya murmusa kafin yace "Karfa ka damu ba cutar dakai zamuyi ba,  so muke ka bamu labarinka...."


Mamy kam tuno Azeema da tayi ya sanayata zubewa ta zauna dirshan a wajen hawaye bai daina fito mata ba sanda ta shiga kwararo masu bayani.... 

Dattijo ya dubeta cokeda tausayawa kana yace "Tabbas kinga iftila'i amma Allah na sonka da alkhairi sannan kuma kwanarka ne bai k'are ba shiyasa ka kub'uta... Maganar asirin mijin ki kuma kar ka damu zamuje har garin a warware sihirin da yardar Allah... Amma yanzu ni kiwo zanje,  ga mai d'akina zata shiga cikin Bauchi tallan kindirmo idan yaso sai ku tafi tare taga gidan naka koh. ..."   Ya k'arashe yana mik'ewa tsaye,  Mamy kam da anbi nata da tun yanzu an tafi an warware sammon Daddy,  amma tunda wannan Dattijo yace zai taimaka mata taji dad'i sosai...  Ko abinci bata iya ci ba,  ita dai kurum su isa cikin garin Bauchi damuwarta....  Bafillatanar tana ida had'a kayan tallanta suka fito suka nufo bakin titi,  Mamy sai faman raba idanu take... Wanda duk bai mata farin sani ba sam bazai ganeta ba....

Tana tsaye d'akin Naseer tana tattara masa d'akin taji kaman motsin mutum....  D'an barin abinda takeyi tayi had'i da lek'a parlor taga babu kowa....  Lokaci guda ta dawo cikin d'akin taci gaba da abinda take...

Ta shiga wutsil-wutsil tana k'ok'arin ihu....  Tana zare idanu nan sukayi ido hud'u dashi yana kafiran murmushin nan nasa....  Duk k'ok'arin k'watan kanta da take ta kasa... Kan kace me idanunta sun rufe ruf jikinta ya sake....

Shareefah tana k'unshe a d'aki tana kuka ga ciwo da ya addabeta sai jiyo k'aran bud'e gate tayi... Ta mik'e da k'yar tana lek'en window nan taga Daddy ne da Affan,  an sallami Daddy Affan ya dawo dashi gida.....

Mamy tamkar kazan da k'wai ya fashe mata a ciki haka take tafiya,  Baba Mai gadi kansa bai shaida Mamy ba... Don har ya taso daga bancin sa yana k'ok'arin hanasu shiga sai jiyo muryar Affan yayi yana fad'in "K'yalesu Baba Daddy yana son kindirmo..."

Muryar kukanta da Alh Ali Safwan yaji sai yaji wani irin abu ya tokari k'irjinsa tamkar an sauk'e mar guduma.... 

"Asma'u..!!"  Ya fad'i murya na rawa...

"Asma'u mai ya dawo dake gidana... Kinzo ki k'arasani da k'arfi ne bayan mahallici na ya tayar dani.... Me kike nema wajena Asma'u? Mai kike nema A DUNIYAR MU...."


Kuka Mamy take tana k'ok'arin matsowa kusan Daddy tana kai hannayenta kusan k'afafunsa amma tuni ya soma jada kekensa baya hawaye suna fitowa daga idanunsa shar-shar.... Bazai tab'a mance auren soyayya da sukayi da Asma'u ba.... Amma sai gashi itace ke yunk'urin kashesa wannan Al'amari da mai yayi kama....  Sautin Mamy suka soma jiyowa cikin tsananin kuka take fad'in

"Daddy ka yafe ni,  ka yafe ni dan Allah.. Wllhi na gane kuskurena A DUNIYAR MU,  wllhi na fahimci Duniya ba komai bace face wani waje da za'ayi rayuwa k'alilan sannan bayi gaba d'aya su koma ga mahallicin su....  Wllhi na amince duk mai son Duniya yana tareda wahala... Daddy na tuba zan shuka Alkhairi A DUNIYAR MU domin dacewa a lahirar mu wacce itace rayuwa dawammamiya.... Daddy ka yafe min Affan ku yafe min,  nasan na zalunce ku gaba d'aya, yafiyarku ne kawai zaisa na sami sassauci a rayuwata....  Na aikata munanan laifuka A DUNIYAR MU amma Ubangijina ya fahimtar dani haka tun kafin a isa lahira... Na tabbata azaba da uk'uban da nasha tun A DUNIYAR MU bai kai kwatankwacin wanda zan tarar a lahira ba da na tafi ina mai aikata sab'o da shirka....  Daddy ka yafe ni na rok'i arzikin ka,  wllhi da k'afafuna zan tafi na warware sammon da nayi maka ka kasa tafiya,  akaje k'asashe da dama aka gagara gane kan cutar....  Wllhi zanje in warware,  nidai kawai buk'atata kace ka yafeni don Allah ba don ni ba....."  Ta k'arashe tana mai kuma kifa kai a k'asa idanunta suna ci gaba da zuban ruwa... 

K'irajensu yaci gaba da bugu... Alh Ali baisan Asma'u bata k'aunarsa har haka ba... Yanzu dama ita ta nakasa shi shekara da shekaru yana zaune saman keken guragu... Anya Asma'u 'yar adam ce... Shin har mace zata cutar da mijin da suka jima tare suka hayayyafa tare,  suka gina gida guda tare,  suka riga suka zamto abu guda... Idan zata iya haka ma irin wannan mutumi toh inaga sauran Al'umma,  wani irin cutarwa zata masu... Innalillahi wa Inna'ilaihirraji'un, ashe ya jima yana zaune da mushirika azzaluma cikin gidansa bai sani ba....  Bai iya furta komai ba sai bugu da k'irjinsa keyi babu ko k'akk'autawa...

Affan kuwa jin abin yake tamkar wani a tarihi irin na zamanin jahiliya da babu addini ballantana sanin Allah...  Yanzu wannan matar mahaifiyarsa ce... Duk laifukan nan ita ta aikatasu...  Ya nemi kukan da yake ya rasa... 

Bafulatana dai tsuguno gefe tayi irin yanda suke idan zasu zuba kimdirmo wa masu siya tana kallon ikon Allah kana ta shiga tafe hannaye tana sallalami da surutai cikin harshen fillanci...  

A hankali Affan ya soma k'ok'arin janyo keken Daddy yana son shigar dashi gida ba tareda ya kuma duban Mamy ba... 

Da gwiwa take k'ok'arin matsowa kusan su tana fad'in "Aff....!!"

Wllhi wllhi kar ki kuskura kizo kusan mahaifina baya buk'atarki a rayuwarsa....."  Yanda yake maganar zaka fahimci tsan-tsan tashin hankali a tattare dashi,  hannayensa dake rik'e da wheelchair d'in Daddy har wani b'ari suke sabida tsananin b'acin rai da tashin hankali...  Cikin sauri ya shiga tura Mahaifinsa wanda ya gagara koda raba fatun bakinsa guda biyu ballantana ya sami zarafin magana... 



Mamy ta d'ora hannu aka tana kuka sosai,  tuni d'an mayafin dake kanta ya sub'ule k'wandilan kanta ya bayyana...  Gaban Shareefah ya kuma fad'uwa...  K'afafunta na rawa ta doso mahaifiyar tata... 

A hankali Shareefah ta durk'usa saman gwiwoyinta tana duban Mamy sosai,  sai ta nemi ciwon da take ji ta rasa,  tabbas halittar Mamy ya sauya daga Mamynta da ta sani a baya... K'afafun Mamy Shareefah ta soma k'ok'arin dubawa tana tunanin ta yanda zataga k'ofato a k'afafun Mamy...  Kafin ta sami zarafin Magana Mamy ta rungumota sosai cikin jikinta tana kuka da duka zuciyarta... Azeema kawai take tunowa cikin zuciyarta da irin halin data barota ciki...  Allah sarki Duniya abin tsoro tafi gabaruwa iya jima....

Innah na zaune gefen kujeran da aka d'aure Salma ta shiga busa mata hayak'in sigari tana son tada ita... Aiko tuni Salma ta soma tari tana k'ok'arin bud'e idanu....

Dukda shekaru da ya d'iba rabonsa da gidan ya gane gidan kuma ya yarda d'an tasi d'in gidan Sa'oud Santana ya kawo su, gidan yana nan da yanayinsa irinta masu kud'in wancan lokaci saidai wasu gyare-gyare na zamani da aka kuma k'awata sa dashi....  Hannun matar da suke tare ya rik'e suna masu ci gaba da tafiya



Tabbas dukda girma da ya nuna a fuskar mutumin zai iya tuna tamkar ya sansa a lokutan baya.....  Bai daina kallon wad'annan bayin Allah ba har saida suka nufo gidansu gadan-gadan... Sojojin dake tsare da gate ne suke yunk'urin hanasu shiga gidan.... Har lokacin Naseer bai sami zarafin motsawa ba sai k'irjinsa dake bugu cikin sauri....  Salma kam sam batama lura da halin da Naseer d'in ke ciki ba.... A hankali yaci gaba da tuk'a motar har ya iso gate d'in nan da nan kuwa attention d'in Sojojin ya dawo ga ogansu....  A dai-dai lokacin Dattijon balaraben nan ya juyo yana duban Naseer... Duk da tsawon shekaru da ya kwashe bai ganshi ba tabbas zai iya shaidawa d'an 'yar uwarshi ce.... Tabbas wannan Naseer ne....  Shima Naseer d'in k'uri yayi wa mutumin yana hango fuskar Aunty Saudat a tattaredashi...

"Naseer....!!!"   Mutumin ya fad'i ruwa na k'ok'arin cikowa idanunsa....  

Bugun k'irjin Naseer ya k'aru a hankali ya bud'e marfin mota ya fito waje...

A dai-dai stairs sukayi kusan cin karo da Fawaz da alama gate ya nufa don ya hango gate d'in a bud'e sannan ya hangi mutane tsattsaye.... 

Gabanta ya kuma yankewa ya fad'i... A hankali Fawaz ya kauce mata had'i da kauda kansa gefe kafin ya shige cikin sauri.... Kallo ta bisa dashi lokaci guda taji zafin k'irjinta ya k'aru...  Cikin sauri ta lumshe idanunta tana mai ci gaba da taka steps d'in da k'yar.... Saidai tana cikin k'ok'arin haurawa taji tari yana zuwa mata akai-akai.... Hannu tasa tana k'ok'arin k'unshe bakinta.....  Saida ta d'an tsuguna a wajen kafin tarin ya lafa....  Saidai tana cire hannunta a bakinta taga jini cikin hannun nata.... Wani sabon tashin hankali ya ziyarce ta... Shafa bakinta ta kuma yi taga dai tabbas jini ke fita daga bakinta...  Cikin sauri ta k'ara ga doguwar madubi da aka k'awata hanyar dashi tana kallon fuskarta cikin madubin....  Da gaske dai jini ne jini ke fitowa idan tayi tari...  Cikin sauri ta soma girgiza kai sabbin hawaye suna kwararo mata....  Sallaman mutane da ta jiyo daga parlorn ya sanyata daina kukan da take... Dukda tasan duk yanda akayi Naseer ne ya dawo da Salma bata iya k'arasawa wajensu ba sai hayewa sama da tayi cikin sauri....  K'ofar d'akin Lubna ta soma shigewa yanda ta hangi Lubnar kwance saman cinyar Aunty Saudat tana shafa kanta alamun kwantar da hankali...  Cikin sauri tasa kai ta shige....  A dai-dai k'ofar d'akin da Momy take ta hangesu gaba d'aya daga Momyn har Ilham da Falaq.... Momy na bisa darduman sallah yayinda Ilham ke kwance rigingine Falaq na bisa k'irjinta....  Wasu hawaye suka zubo wa Jamila.... Cikin sauri ta k'arasa nasu d'akin ta shige had'i da kullo k'ofar domin tasan bazata iya had'uwa da kowa a wannan yanayi da take ciki ba... Abubuwa sun taru sun mata yawa cikin zuciyarta,  ga rashin Fawaz ga uwa uba cutan da Alh Kabeer yace ya shafa mata....  Can k'uryar d'aki ta samu ta zauna had'i da tak'urewa waje guda ta kifa kanta tana kuka maras sauti,  shikenan k'ila farkon symptoms d'in HIV d'in kenan idan kayi tari jini ya fito.... Tunanin da zuciyarta ya dinga raya mata kenan wanda ya kuma tsundumata cikin wani sabon tashin hankali.... 

****

Gaba d'aya hallara sukayi a parlorn,  Salma ta tafi ta rungume 'yar uwarta Ilham suna kuka sosai.....  Fawaz kam idanunsa naga balaraben da suka shigo tareda Naseer wanda tunda ya d'aura idanu akansa ya kasa d'agawa ga k'irjinsa dake faman bugu..... 

Shima wannan Dattijo duban Fawaz ya dingayi yana jin wani babban Al'amari a tattare dashi....  Idanunsa naga Fawaz har baisan sanda Aunty Saudat da Lubna suka sauk'o parlorn ba.....   Momy ta k'arasa ta kamo hannun Lubna ta had'esu gaba d'aya dasu Salma ta rungume tana zaune tsakiyarsu don jikinta na bata wani abin ne zai kuma faruwa.... 

Hawaye ke gangaro mata tana takowa cikin parlorn,  juyawar da zaiyi ya hangeta tana takowa cikin tapkeken parlorn..... Lokaci guda ya mik'e k'afafunsa na rawa ya soma takawa ya nufeta shima kukan yake.....   Yana k'arasowa yanda take ya rungumeta ba tareda ya iya furta komai ba sai kuka da yakeyi tamkar k'aramin yaro....  Aunty Saudat kam cak ta tsaya ba tareda ta maida masa martanin rungumar ba....  Sai tunanin sanda ya barta a wannan same parlor yayi tafiyar sa shekaru ashirin da d'oriya da suka gabata, abubuwan suka yawo a kwanyarta,  ta tuna tana binshi tana rik'oshi amma haka ya b'anb'areta daga jikinsa yasa k'afafu ya tafi ya barta wa mutanen da suka tassama halak'ata da k'arfin gaske.....  Lokaci guda tamkar wacce aka zabura ta shiga k'ok'arin b'anb'are jikinta tana kuka sosai tana ture mutumin tana fad'in mai ya dawo dashi ya b'ace bata son ganin sa... Duk cikin harshen arab take maganganun...  A d'ari Fawaz ya k'arasa yana k'ok'arin janye mahaifiyarsa daga rik'on mutumin yake fad'in "Malam lafiya... Wai waye kai....."

Kuka Aunty Saudat take sosai sanda Fawaz ya rungumeta sosai yana huci yana duban mutumin.... Naseer ne ya k'araso yana k'ok'arin janye mutumin a hankali....  Baiko iya bawa Fawaz dake tambayar ko wanene mutumin amsa ba.... sai jiyo muryar wannan mutumi sukayi cikeda tsananin mamaki hausa yake 

"Saudat ki yafeni... Ki yafeni d'iyata wllhi tunda na tafi na barki a nan ban sami kwanciyar hankali ba, arzikin da na tafi dashi baimin amfani ba k'arshe na rasa komai na koma abin tausayi abin kwatance A DUNIYAR MU....  Ki yafe dan Allah.."

Sai sannan Fawaz da sauran jama'an wajen suka fahimce wanene wannan mutumi.... Idanuwan Fawaz suka shiga zubda hawaye, girgiza kai kurum yake yana duban mutumin da mahaifiyarsa.....  Kafin ya sami zarafin magana ya jiyo muryar mahaifiyarsa cikin kuka tana fad'in "Abbu meyasa?  Meyasa ka  tafi ka barni..... Why..?  Baka damu ba all the suffering I went through....  Sun baka kud'ad'e ka aurar dani ma d'ansu wanda suka tasamma kasheni shida mahaifiyarsa Abbu why. .... Wllhi bani buk'atar kuma ganin ka A DUNUYAR MU ka tafi ka tafi ka k'yaleni....."  Ta k'arashe tana kuka sosai da duka zuciyarta... 


Fawaz dake hawaye kallonsu yake su duka biyu kafin ya soma fad'in "What's going on... Make faruwa ku min bayani dan Allah meke faruwa,...?"


Dattijo Suhail ne yakai dubansa ga Fawaz,  a hankali ya taka ya isa har gaban Fawaz yana kallon sa lokaci guda ya rungumesa sosai yana fad'in "Na tabbata kai jika na ne kai jini na ne....?"

Fawaz yayi k'arfin halin b'anb'are Abbu daga jikinsa kaman yanda sukaji Aunty Saudat ta kirasa yana goge hawayen idanunsa yake fad'in "Dan Allah ku fahimtar dani,  wai meke faruwa ne... Mai ya faru shekarun baya.....?"

Dattijo Suhail na hawaye yake fad'in "Wannan shine abinda ya dawo dani,  wannan shine mak'asudin dawowata wajen nan....  Koda Sa'oud da Dije zasu kuma hanani fad'awa wa d'an 'yar uwata asalinsa zan sanar dashi sannan zan nemi gafaran d'iyata akan abunda na mata a baya... Sabida na tabbata hakkinta shi yabibiyeni a rayuwa....."  Ya k'arashe yana mai takowa gaban Naseer wanda bugun k'irjinsa ya k'aru.... 

Abbu Suhail yakai hannu ya kamo hannayen Naseer dake tsaye tamkar mutum mutumi kafin ya soma fad'in "Naseer ka yafe min,  ka yafeni d'ana, ka yafeni rashin sanar dakai da banyi ba tuntuni,  ka sani ba'a sona bane ban sanar da kai ba, iyakaci umarnin mahaifinka nabi...."  Hawaye suka ci gaba da kwararowa daga idanun Abbu Suhail yayinda Naseer ke binsa da kallo lokaci guda jikinsa yayi wani irin sanyi ba tareda sanin dalili ba....  

Abbu Suhail yaci gaba da fad'in "Hidaya 'yar uwata ce,  mahaifiyarka k'anwa take min.....  A lokacin data haifeka Allah ya karb'i rayuwarta... Mahaifinka Sa'oud Santana da mai d'akinsa Dije su suka zab'i a rufa al'amarin sabida tun tasowarka a hannun Dije matar Sa'oud ka taso tamkar ita ta haifeka... Sanda na rasa mai d'akina mahaifiyar Saudatu nazo k'asar nan da Saudatu a lokacin naso sanar dakai dukda k'arancin shekarun da kake dashi amma ban sanar dakai ba sabida mahaifinka ya hana...."  Muryar Dattijo Suhail ta carke sanda kuka yaci k'arfinsa.....  Parlorn tayi tsit sai sautin kuka kake jiyowa....  Zukata sun kuma girgiza shin wannan wane irin Al'amari ne..... 

Naseer har lokacin ya kasa motsawa daga yanda yake tsaye.... Sunan matar da yaji Abbu ya ambata a matsayin mahaifiyarsa yake kan nanatawa HIDAYA....  So wannan shine asalin dalilin da yasa Innah bata tab'a k'aunar sa ba... Ashe shid'in ba d'anta bane....  Ashe mahaifiyarsa ta gaskiya ta jima da rasuwa....  Gaba d'aya rayuwarsa yayisa ne akan Innah ce mahaifiyar sa,  gaba d'aya rayuwarsa yayisa ne wajen kyautata mata da neman aljannarsa ta k'ark'ashinta.....  Abubuwan da Innah ta dinga masa na musgunawa tun yana yaro ya shiga dawowa kwanyarsa, kalan tsanan da tsangwama da ta masa,  ashe ba ita ta haifesa ba,.... Duk rayuwar da yayi bai tab'a addu'a wa mahaifiyar sa ba.... Meyasa Abban sa zai masa haka mai yasa bai sanar dashi ba... Meyasa ya dank'a amanarsa a hannun azzaluman mace wacce tayi sanadiyar barinsa duniya.....  A hankali Naseer ya soma takawa ba tareda ya dubi kowa dake cikin parlorn ba dukda juyawa da duniyar ke masa, Salma ta bisa da kallo itama hawayen ne ke zarya a kumatun ta,  gaba d'aya sai ta nemi nata tashin hankalin da take ciki ta rasa, ji take tamkar ta mik'e a guje ta rungumesa.... 

 A haka ya dinga tafiya har saida ya isa sashen sa kafin ya maida k'ofar ya kulle.... Waje ya samu ya zauna abubuwan suna kuma yawo a kwanyar sa....  Yakai dubansa ga hitonsa da mahaifinsa dake ajiye saman stand dake a cikin d'akinsa... K'arasawa yayi ya d'auki hoton had'i da k'urawa hoton idanu....  Cikin wani irin murya mai tsanin rawa ya soma fad'in "Why...?   Abba Why...  Abba meyasa,  meyasa kayi haka......  Abba meyasa ka min haka......"   Kasa ci gaba da magana yayi sai wani irin kuka da ya kufce masa lokaci guda ya durk'ushe saman gwiwoyinsa a wajen yana rik'e da hoton yake kuka tamkar ransa zai fita......

Affan ne ya shigo sashen Mamy ya tarar har lokacin Mamy bata fice a gidan ba tana nan rakub'e can k'asan carpet tana kuka uwa mai yawon neman taimako,  Shareefah ta kawo mata abinci tana rok'onta taci.... 

Cikin sauri yana wani irin huci ya k'arasa ya wafce plate d'in abincin daga hannun Shareefah,  gaba d'aya daga Mamy har Shareefah d'ago idanu sukayi suna duban Affan d'in dake faman huci da turiri.... 

Cikin wani irin murya yake fad'in "Mamy why just can't understand that you have no place here....  We've nothing to do with you... Is it so hard to understand huh....?  Kin kasa fahimta ne...  Ki gode ma Allah ban mik'a ki ma 'yansanda ba.. Sannan hakan ba yana nufin bazaki fito da Azeema ba kenan.....  Da wannan zaman da kikeyi da tashi kikayi kika dawo da ita don na tabbata bokan ki ne ya tsafe ta..... Mamy I'm afraid idan baki dawo da Azeema ba zaki tafi jail....."  Ya k'arashe yana wani irin huci... 

Kuka sosai Mamy take tana girgiza kai take fad'in "Affan wllhi wllhi ka yarda dani,  wllhi ba laifina bane....  Wllhi duk abinda na fad'a maku iyakacin gaskiyata kenan....  Affan don Allah ku tausaya min wllhi nayi nadama nayi danasanin sanin hanyar gidan boka... Wllhi sharrin Laure ce...  Ku tausaya mini......"  Ta k'arashe tana k'ok'arin janyo k'afar Affan da tuni ya matsa daga kusanta.... 

Shareefah kam kuka sosai take tana rungume da Mamy take fad'in "Wllhi bazata je jail ba haba haba Affan... Baka da imani ne,  Mamy ta tuba ta gyara halayenta,  kuma wllhi na yarda da labarin data bamu...  Malami ya kamata a nema ayi addu'a  a rok'i Allah ya kub'utar da Azeema ya bayyana mana ita,  sannan mu tafi a warware sammon dake jikin Daddy...."


Batakai aya ba suka jiyo muryar Ali Safwan yana fad'in "Bana buk'atar a warware komai... Nafiso na koma ga mahallici na a haka sabida ranan gobe k'iyama na samu shaidan da zan tsaya gaban mahaliccina cewa ta cutar dani.....  Na tabbata wanda ya zalunceka A DUNIYAR MU kaine a saman sa idan anje lahira,  yanda alk'alin alk'alai zaiyi shari'a da gaskiya daidai da daidai baza'a tauye wa kowa ba.....  Babban damuwata ba k'afafuwana bane,  Azeema itace damuwata,  sai yanzu na fahimci ta jima tana wargaza duk wasu shirinki na cutar da Al'umma Asma'u.... A lokacin da na gansu itada Shareefah suna aikata mummunar sab'o naji sam ta sane min a rai daga ita har Shareefar...  Saidai kuma na yarda duk d'an Adam yanada nasa good side d'in,  na tabbata koda ace tana wani sab'o tsakaninta da mahaliccinta tanada nata good side d'in sannan na yarda idan kaga bawa aikata laifi ba aibanta shi zakayi ba ko ka muzanta shi,  addu'a da fatan shiriya shi ya kamata kayi masa sannan kayi addu'an Allah ya kareka daga fad'awa irin aikin sab'on da yake aikatawa...  Yau na tabbata da na muzanta ta na koreta a gidana da batayi yunk'urin ceton rayuwa na ba.....  Amma sai gashi a ranan da kika turoni saman bene Azeema ce ta soma zuwa ta kirawo d'auki,  kika bini asibiti don ki gama dani, nan ma bata barki ba ta bi bayanki ta hanaki aiwata k'udirinki,  bata tsaya a nan ba.. Ta biki har yanda kike tunanin zakije a kashe maki ni ta hanyar asiri sai kuma reshe ta juye da mujiya... Wllhi nayi imani da Allah ko wad'annan ayyukan alkahiri da Azeema tayi zai isa mahaliccinta ya gafarta mata wad'ancan laifukan da tayisu a baya tunda tsakaninta dashi ne,  Shi kuma AlGafur ne kuma mai Rahama...."  

Ya juyo ga dubansa ga Shareefah wacce ta tak'ure sosai tana hawaye kana yace "Wannan ya isa izna a gareki....  Ki tuba kibi Allah kisan wancan laifi da na kamaku kunayi shi yasa ban aura maki Naseer ba sabida bazan cutar dashi ba na aura masa Salma nitsetsiyar yarinya...  Ba wai nak'i ki bane saidai inaso ki gyara halinki....  Abubuwa da dama sun faru A DUNIYAR MU wanda na tabbata sun ishe masu hali irin naki ishara Asma'u.... Zaki iya zama a cikin gidan nan kodon Shareefah amma a halin yanzu bansan matsayin aurenki a gidan nan ba... Wllhi daraja guda kikaci darajan 'ya'yana sgiyasa na maki wannan alfarma, sannan ki sani ni ba azzalumi bane bazanso naga kin tagayyara ba.....  Ki zauna kiyita istigifari wa mahaliccin ki don laifin da kikayi yafi ko wani laifi girma da muni a sikeli...  Allah yayi mana muwafak'a ya datar damu,  ya tsare mu da imanin mu daga bijire masa....  Affan maza shige mu tafi sallan isha...."  Ya k'arashe yana tura tayun wheelchair d'insa... 

Affan da jikinsa yayi sanyi sosai a hankali yabi bayan mahafin nasa.... 

Mamy da Sahreefah suka kuma rungumar juna suna kuka mai cikieda da tarin nadama da ban tausayi....

Wannan dare ma iya cewa gidan Sa'oud Santana kwana zaune akayi koma kwana tsaye,  Momy ita ta sauk'i Suhail da matar da take tunanin matarsa ce a d'akin bak'i don banzai yuwu a gama wannan warware-warware ba a dare guda.... 


Ko kad'an Jamila bata sanar da 'yan uwanta halin da take ciki ba,  saidai kana ganinta zaka fahimci lafiya bai isheta ba,  gaba d'aya ta tashi hankalinta ta tsangwami rayuwarta,  duk yanda Momy taso jin abinda ke damunta tak'i sanar da ita.. A b'angaren Salma kuwa kwana tayi tunanin Soja da halin da yake ciki,  hasashenta na cewa ba Innah ce ta haifi Soja ba ya kuma tabbata,  itakam ko a finafinai bata tab'a gani ko jin labarin masu hali irin na Innah ba,  tamkar ba 'yar Adam ba....  Haka nan ta kwana tana zullumin halin da Soja ke ciki... 



Washe gari har wajajen azahar basuji d'uriyan Naseer ba... Abin duk ya dami Salma dukda mutanen gidan kowa ya k'ulene a uwar d'aki tamkar masu takaba,  ma'ikata ne kurum saiko Momy masu zirga-zirgan...  Dukda haka sosai abin ya dami Salma...  Momy na hankalce da ita yanda ta rafka tagumi ta k'urawa k'ofar sashen Naseer d'in idanu ko zataga fitowarsa...  A hankali Momy ta k'araso kusanta kafin ta d'an dafata...  

"Daughter...."  D'ago kai Salma tayi tana dubanta damuwa fal fuskarta... 

K'ak'aro murmushi Momy tayi ta sakar mata kana tace "Kije ki duba shi kiga yaya ya kwana kinji koh...." murya cikeda kulawa tayi maganar.. 

Salma ko tamkar wacce take jira,  cikin sauri ta mik'e tana fad'in "Toh Momy,  zanje... Barinje na dubashi....."  Gaba d'aya a birkice take yin maganar... 

Cikeda tausayawa Momy ke dubanta kafin ta mata rakiya har k'ofa.. 

Har sun kai k'ofar Momy ta k'arasa saman dining table ta d'au bawl na fruit salad wanda Falmata bata jima da ijiyewa ba ta mik'a mata kana tace "Nasan bashida appetite wannan zai taimaka maza kai masa..."

Salma ta murmusa ta amsa tana mai fad'in "Toh Momy..."  Kana ta nufi sashen Naseer... 

Saidai ga mamakinta a bud'e taga sashen nasa kuma bataji alamunsa ba...  Ta shiga tana mai sallama amma shiru ba'a amsata ba....  Ko ina saida ta duba a sashen nasa bataji alamunsa ba... Jiki a sanyaye ta fito ta nufi cikin gida...

Hannayen sa sakale a aljihu yake duban likitan kana yace "Dr kana nufin saidai a yanke k'afafun kenan....?"

Dr ya jinjina kai kana yace "This the only solution Captain,  already  veins d'in k'afafun nasa sun daddage dole a yanke kafin yaci gaba da rayuwa,  idan yakai wasu awanni ba'a yanke ba komai ka iya faruwa....."

Naseer ya d'an shafi goshinsa kafin ya jinjina kai yace "Shikenan Dr ayi yanda ya kamata....  Ni zan wuce akwai corps guda biyu da zasu tsaya a nan kafin ya sami lafiya..."

Dr ya jinjina kai kafin ya mik'a hannu wa Naseer sukayi masabaha Naseer d'in ya wuce....

Yana ida fad'in haka suka shiga bugun shirgin kwalayen dake cikin rumfar

Girgiza kai Lubna take tana duban Deeni cikin rashin yarda da kalaman dake fitowa daga bakinsa... Da gaske Deen sallama yake mata,  da gaske tafiya zaiyi ya barta.... Sun jefa mahaifina cikin tsananin jinya... K'arewa mahaifana sun rabu da juna shekara da shekaru duk a sabida su, basu basu dama sun rayu tare da juna A DUNIYAR MU ba....  Bazan kuma zama inaji ina gani su kuma d'aid'aita rayuwa ba....  I'm sorry Lubna,  ina k'aunarki amma bazai yuwu mu kasance tare ba....  Take this... Idan Naseer yazo ki bashi,  ajiyan da mahaifina ya jima yana masa kaman yanda mahaifiyata ta fad'i....."


Ya k'arashe yana mik'a mata envelope d'in....

Dole kayi komai domin kare family d'inka, sannan babu mai kuma k'aunar ya rab'e mu..  Ni kaina da inada halin tsame kaina daga cikin wannan zuri'a da nayi... Amma saidai babu hali tuni alk'alamin k'addara ya rubata hakan...  Thank you Deeni... Thank you for everything..."  Kasa ci gaba da magana tayi sabida tsananin rawa da muryarta keyi... 

K'ok'arin danne kukan daketa son kufce masa yake kafin yace "Goodbye Lubna... Idan da rabon mu sake had'uwa A DUNIYAR MU zamu had'u kinji....."   Cikin sauri ya juya ya nufi k'ofa yana jiyo sautin kukan Lubna na k'aruwa yake fad'in "Ummi Mama Tani mu jenku.. Muje kafin abubuwa su kuma kwab'ewa....

Mama Tani na hawaye ta isa gaban Aunty Saudat saidai kasa magana tayi sabida kuka da ya kufce mata.....  Macen da Deeni ya kira da Ummi k'arasawa tayi ta dafa kafad'an Lubna kana tace "Kiyi hak'uri mahaifinki mutumin kirki ne koda mahaifiyarki ta kasance akasin haka... So tari bamu samun komai d'ari bisa d'ari A DUNIYAR MU, so da yawa rayuwa takan zo mana baibai ba yanda muka tsara ba A DUNIYAR MU,  amma idan munyi hak'uri muka amshi jarabawar mu hannu bibbiyu sai muga alkhairi a k'arshe...  Naso na sami Naseer na damk'a masa wannan takardu hannu da hannu kaman yanda mijina yaso saidai hakan bai yuwu ba... Ina fata zaku bashi......"  Ta k'arashe tana kallon Lubna dake kuka sosai.... 

Babu wanda ya kuma iya cewa komai cikin parlorn har su Mama tani suka fice cikin kuka.. Deeni kam tuni ya fice yana goge hawayen dake zubo masa.... 

Juyowa Lubna tayi bayan sun b'ace ma ganinta lokaci guda ta rungume Aunty Saudat tana kuka sosai..... Jamila da Ilham ma rungume da juna suna faman jimamin 'yar uwarsu had'i da tausayin Deeni da Lubna kai da duk wanda wannan iftila'i ke kan shafa.....

Sauri-sauri Alh Kabeer ya cire simcard d'in daga cikin tablet d'in da suka gama amfani dashi wajen kiran Naseer...  Lokaci guda ya k'ona sim d'in kafin ya jefa tab d'in cikin 'yar jakansa yana k'ok'arin warware d'aurin da sukayima Salma yake fad'i ma Innah tayi sauri su bar wajen nan don jikinsa na basa Naseer ka iya tracking d'insu.... 

Tsegege Innah ke dubansa sai k'ok'arin kwance Salma daga jikin kujeran yake kana ta janyo sa baya cikin karaji tana fad'in "Toh da kake kwanceta nufinka tareda ita zamu tafi... Ai banka wa shegiya wuta cikin ginin nan ya kamata muyi sannan muyi tafiyarmu...."

Tsaki Kabeer yayi yana dubanta kana yace "Seems you don't have brain in that skull of yours....."  Bai ko kuma kulata ba ya koma yaci gaba da yunk'urin kwance Salma... 

"Yo ni uwar me naji kace...  Kai billahillazi k'onata zanyi tunda na lura Naseer na bala'in sonta,  nasan idan ta mutu inbai sami tab'in hankali ba zuciyarsa zata buga kaga na cimma burina na salwantar da rayuwarsa...."

A hasale ya d'ago yana watsa wa Innah mugun kallo kafin yace "Shiyasa nace maki sam bakida tunani balle lissafi,  toh idan mun kasheta da me zamu dinga threatening Naseer,  azabtar da ita da zamukeyi yanaji yana gani ba tareda ya iya yin komai ba shine kawai zai d'aid'aita Naseer sannan ta haka ne kurum Kitty da Lubna zasu yarda su biyo mu... Ko baki gane bane....."


Salma da hawaye ke zarya a idanunta binsu da kallo kurum take tana ganin tamkar wasu halittinu daga wani planet ba'a nasu duniyar ba, ta dubi wannan ta dubi wancan haka ta kallonsu suna masu ci gaba da argument d'in...


Lokaci guda ya kuma sunkuyawa yana k'ok'arin ci gaba da warware d'aurin...  

Innah dake faman huci lokaci guda ta rarumi wani kututturen katako dake gefe ta sauk'e ma Kabeer a gadon bayansa tana fad'in "Wllhi k'arya kenan... Babu wanda ya isa ya hanani kashe yarinyar nan....."


A d'ari ya mik'e yana sosa k'eyarsa yake fad'in "Kutuman uban chan...  Kasheni zakiyi.. Toh kafin ki kasheni bari ni na kashe ki....  Ya k'arashe yana k'ok'arin rarumo alluran da yaso cakkawa Salma....  Saidai tuni Innah ta hangame babban randar da ya dama acid d'in ciki tana fad'in "Ka matso kusana wllhi sai na maka wanka da wannan ruwa mai tururin.... 

Wannan bidiri da suke gaba d'aya ya d'auke hankulansu sam basuji isowarsu Naseer ba.... 

Kabeer ne yaji kaman motsin mutane k'irjinsa ya yanke ya fad'i.... Cak ya tsaya ya daina biye Innah had'i da kasa kunnuwarsa yana son  tabbatar da abinda yake jiyowa....   Da baya da baya ya soma matsawa yana fad'i wa Innah.... 

"Innah kunnuwana suna jiyo min wasu sauti... We should get ready... Dole mu tafi da yarinyar nan itace kawai garkuwan mu...."   Bakin Salma na d'aure babu halin ihu sai k'walalo idanuwa waje take tana iyaka nata k'ok'arin... 

K'aran tafiya da suka jiyo yana nufosu sosai ya sanyasu saurin nufa d'aya k'ofan suna k'ok'arin bud'eta saidai gaba d'aya sun kasa bud'e k'ofar... 

A tamanin suka dawo ga window bugu guda suka mata ta bud'e... Aiko suna Naseer suna shigowa d'akin Innah ta d'aga k'afafunta ta haye windown... Ko zafin fad'uwar da tayi bataji ba dashike dama ba jiki ne da ita ba.... A d'ari ta mik'e tana mai ci gaba da gudun famfalak'i fatarinta na d'agawa sama... 


Kabeer rik'e da randar ruwan acid d'insa yake fad'in idan d'ayansu ya motsa daga position d'insa zaiyi wanka wa Salma dake d'aure a wajen da ruwan acid d'in... 

Girgiza kai Naseer keyi yana k'ok'arin d'aga k'afarsa guda yake fad'in "Yaya ka ajiye abinda ke hannun ka.... Ka...."

Baikai aya ba Kabeer ya katse sa da fad'in "Don't you dare move an inch... Kaji na rantse maka wllhi kana motsawa zan watsa mata wannan ruwan ta diddige gaba d'aya......"

Kallon kallo kurum suka shiga aika ma juna,  ji yake tamkar yayi tsalle ya mak'ure Yayan nasa,  ko motsawa Kabeer ya hanasu yi balle suyi alamawa 'yan uwansu dake waje suyi k'ok'arin rafke Innah.... 

A hankali Kabeer ke k'ok'arin matsawa baya yanason tsira ma rayuwarsa idanunsa k'yam akansu da zaran sunyi motsi zai saita randar ruwan acid d'in zuwa fuskar Salma...  A haka ya dinga jada baya har ya iso tagar da Innah tabi ta arce....  Aiko yana isa Naseer yayi kukan kura ya nufesa don alwashi ya d'aukarwa kansa wannan karan dole yayi karon batta da Yayan nasa koda zai rasa ransa  ne.... 

Runtse idanunta kurum Salma tayi sanda taga Alh Kabeer ya d'ago langar ruwan acid d'in yana yunk'urin watsawa Naseer...  Tuni 'yan sanda sun janye kujeran da Salma ke kai... Saidai d'aga langar da Alh Kabeer zaiyi hannun langar ta b'alle gaba d'aya ruwan acid d'in ya kware masa a duka k'afafunsa biyu.... Wani irin azabebben k'ara ya saki sanda ya zube k'asa.... Yana k'aran yana duban k'afafunsa tun daga cinyoyinsa sai wani irin hayak'in tururi suke wanda ya kusa turnuk'e wajen gaba d'aya,  naman k'afafunsa suka shiga daddagewa tamkar  audugar da taji wuta..... 

Naseer ko kula da hakan baiyi ba sai sunkuyawa da yayi ya cakumo Yayan nasa ya shiga dukan fuskar sa da iyaka k'arfinsa... Irin dukan sa'a yake masa don ko kula da cewa Alh Kabeer ya sume Naseer beyiba... Wani irin dukan huce haushi kurum yake masa.. Yana dukansa hawaye suna fitowa daga idanunsa.....  Kuka sosai Naseer keyi don saida polisawan nan suka amshe Kabeer kafin Naseer ya sakesa ya nufi Salma a guje.....  Cikin sauri ya shiga kwanceta yana duban idanunta dake ambaliyan hawaye.... 


Yana gama kwanceta rungumeta yayi lokaci guda su duka tayi bursting cikin tsananin kuka had'i da k'ank'amesa sosai.... 

Siriryar hawaye ne ta gangaro daga idanunsa sanda ya lumshe su yana k'ank'ame da ita yake fad'in "I'm here.... I'm here,  babu abinda zai kuma faruwa kinji koh....."  Ya k'arashe yana kuma shafa bayanta a hankali alamun lallashi..  Salma ko sai shan zuciya take tsaban kuka ta kasa furta koda kalma....

Jacket d'insa ya cire ya rufa mata kafin ya rik'ota cikin jiknsa suka fice daga wajen suka nufi mota.... Suna jiyo ihun Alh Kabeer sanda 'yan sanda suka fito dashi a hannu suka watsa sa bayan hilox d'insu..... 


Driving kawai Naseer keyi amma bawai hankalin sa na jikinsa bane,  sam baiso Innah ta tsere ba,  yanada tambayoyi da dama da yake son yi mata,  tabbas zama bai gansa ba har sai ya nemo Innah yanda ta shiga ta fita.... 

D'an kallon Salma da har lokacin bata dawo dai-dai ba yake, murya can k'asa yace "are you alright,  kinajin wani ciwo...?"  

Ba tareda ta amsa sa ba ta soma girgiza kai alamun babu bata jin komai....  Yasan dole yakaita likita ya duba masa ita sabida ba k'aramin tashin hankali ta shiga ba.... 

Mota 'yan sandan ne da Naseer ke biye bayansu suka tsaya a station d'in nasu,  shima lokaci guda yayi parking don dole ya duba ko Maina ya dawo cikin hayyacin sa zai iya masa magana dan yasan shine kawai zai iya sanin ina Innah ta dosa tinda Kabeer kam babu halin magana yana kan shan azabar duniya da ya zuba ma kansa.... 

Cikin station d'in yayi parking motar sa lokaci guda ya d'an sauk'o da kansa saitin fuskar Salma da har lokaci jikinta bai daina rawa ba,  gaba d'aya dai bata dawo dai-dai ba...  Hannayen sa yasa ya kamo nata hannayen had'i da matsowa sosai kusanta kafin ya soma fad'in "It's okay my love,  babu abinda zai kuma faruwa da izinin Allah kinji koh...."

Bata iya cewa komai ba sai jinjina masa kai da tayi still tana hawaye.... 

Hannu yasa ya shiga share mata hawayen yana fad'in "Banson ganin hawayen nan haka nan kinji koh...  Everything would come to an end kinji koh.... Barin shiga nan yanzu zan fito kinji koh...."


Saurin d'ago idanu tayi tana dubansa fuskarta cikeda tsoro kafin ta soma girgiza kai wasu sabbin hawaye na fito mata....  "Soja nidai bazan zauna ni kad'ai ba tsoro nake ji....."  

Ganin yanda duk ta kuma birkicewa lokaci guda ya sanyasa kuma rik'ota cikin jikinsa yana lallashi,  yana jiyo yanda k'irjinta yake bugu da sauri da sauri....  K'ok'arin kwantar mata da hankali yake kafin suka nufi cikin station d'in a tare tana nan mak'ale cikin jikinsa tamkar masu tsoron a rabasu..... 

Saida ya shigo da ita yaji dama asibiti kawai ya wuce da ita don gaba d'aya sabon rikicewa tayi sai kuka musamman da tayi tozali da Maina wanda dukda canzawa da kamanninsa yayi bata mance fuskar nasa ba sanda suke cinnama gidansu wuta.... 

Cikin kuka take nuna Maina da yatsa tana fad'in "Wllhi shine shine ya biyoni zai kasheni,  shine sanadiyar k'onewar gidanmu... Shine sanadiyan rabuwata da Inno ta har ta koma ga mahaliccinta bamu kuma had'uwa ba... Wllhi shine Soja...."   Ta k'arashe tana kwantar da kai cikin k'irjin Naseer da wata sabuwar tashin hankali ta ziyarcesa.... Sai yanzu abubuwa da dama suka shiga yawo a kwanyar sa.. Innalillahi wa Inna'ilaihirraji'un... Me kuma ke shirin faruwa kardai Innah da Kabeeru sune silan k'onewar gidan gonar Alh Ali Safwan... Toh mai ya masu.. Shin wad'an nan wasu irin mutane ne....  Lokaci guda ya fice da Salma daga wajen don bazai yuwu ya tsaya da ita a wajen ba....  He needs to get to the bottom of all this, dole ya zama very strong dole ya shirya ma fuskantar duk wani tashin hankali da zai kuma b'ullo masa A DUNIYAR SU domin kuwa tabbas jikinsa na basa wani babban tashin hankali na shirin ziyartar sa..... 

***

Yana k'arasowa gate d'in gidansu Sojin suka shiga sara masa suna gaidashi...  Ana k'ok'arin hangame masa gate ya hangi wata mota wanda ko ba'ace maka ba taxi ce tayi parking can gefen gidan nasu... Wani balaraben mutumi ne da wata mata bak'ar fata suka fito daga cikin motar...  Gaban Naseer yayi wani irin yankewa ya fad'i....  Tuk'a motar da ya kasa ci gaba da yi...

Dukda shekaru da ya d'iba rabonsa da gidan ya gane gidan kuma ya yarda d'an tasi d'in gidan Sa'oud Santana ya kawo su, gidan yana nan da yanayinsa irinta masu kud'in wancan lokaci saidai wasu gyare-gyare na zamani da aka kuma k'awata sa dashi....  Hannun matar da suke tare ya rik'e suna masu ci gaba da tafiya



Tabbas dukda girma da ya nuna a fuskar mutumin zai iya tuna tamkar ya sansa a lokutan baya.....  Bai daina kallon wad'annan bayin Allah ba har saida suka nufo gidansu gadan-gadan... Sojojin dake tsare da gate ne suke yunk'urin hanasu shiga gidan.... Har lokacin Naseer bai sami zarafin motsawa ba sai k'irjinsa dake bugu cikin sauri....  Salma kam sam batama lura da halin da Naseer d'in ke ciki ba.... A hankali yaci gaba da tuk'a motar har ya iso gate d'in nan da nan kuwa attention d'in Sojojin ya dawo ga ogansu....  A dai-dai lokacin Dattijon balaraben nan ya juyo yana duban Naseer... Duk da tsawon shekaru da ya kwashe bai ganshi ba tabbas zai iya shaidawa d'an 'yar uwarshi ce.... Tabbas wannan Naseer ne....  Shima Naseer d'in k'uri yayi wa mutumin yana hango fuskar Aunty Saudat a tattaredashi...

"Naseer....!!!"   Mutumin ya fad'i ruwa na k'ok'arin cikowa idanunsa....  

Bugun k'irjin Naseer ya k'aru a hankali ya bud'e marfin mota ya fito waje...

A dai-dai stairs sukayi kusan cin karo da Fawaz da alama gate ya nufa don ya hango gate d'in a bud'e sannan ya hangi mutane tsattsaye.... 

Gabanta ya kuma yankewa ya fad'i... A hankali Fawaz ya kauce mata had'i da kauda kansa gefe kafin ya shige cikin sauri.... Kallo ta bisa dashi lokaci guda taji zafin k'irjinta ya k'aru...  Cikin sauri ta lumshe idanunta tana mai ci gaba da taka steps d'in da k'yar.... Saidai tana cikin k'ok'arin haurawa taji tari yana zuwa mata akai-akai.... Hannu tasa tana k'ok'arin k'unshe bakinta.....  Saida ta d'an tsuguna a wajen kafin tarin ya lafa....  Saidai tana cire hannunta a bakinta taga jini cikin hannun nata.... Wani sabon tashin hankali ya ziyarce ta... Shafa bakinta ta kuma yi taga dai tabbas jini ke fita daga bakinta...  Cikin sauri ta k'ara ga doguwar madubi da aka k'awata hanyar dashi tana kallon fuskarta cikin madubin....  Da gaske dai jini ne jini ke fitowa idan tayi tari...  Cikin sauri ta soma girgiza kai sabbin hawaye suna kwararo mata....  Sallaman mutane da ta jiyo daga parlorn ya sanyata daina kukan da take... Dukda tasan duk yanda akayi Naseer ne ya dawo da Salma bata iya k'arasawa wajensu ba sai hayewa sama da tayi cikin sauri....  K'ofar d'akin Lubna ta soma shigewa yanda ta hangi Lubnar kwance saman cinyar Aunty Saudat tana shafa kanta alamun kwantar da hankali...  Cikin sauri tasa kai ta shige....  A dai-dai k'ofar d'akin da Momy take ta hangesu gaba d'aya daga Momyn har Ilham da Falaq.... Momy na bisa darduman sallah yayinda Ilham ke kwance rigingine Falaq na bisa k'irjinta....  Wasu hawaye suka zubo wa Jamila.... Cikin sauri ta k'arasa nasu d'akin ta shige had'i da kullo k'ofar domin tasan bazata iya had'uwa da kowa a wannan yanayi da take ciki ba... Abubuwa sun taru sun mata yawa cikin zuciyarta,  ga rashin Fawaz ga uwa uba cutan da Alh Kabeer yace ya shafa mata....  Can k'uryar d'aki ta samu ta zauna had'i da tak'urewa waje guda ta kifa kanta tana kuka maras sauti,  shikenan k'ila farkon symptoms d'in HIV d'in kenan idan kayi tari jini ya fito.... Tunanin da zuciyarta ya dinga raya mata kenan wanda ya kuma tsundumata cikin wani sabon tashin hankali....

Gaba d'aya hallara sukayi a parlorn,  Salma ta tafi ta rungume 'yar uwarta Ilham suna kuka sosai.....  Fawaz kam idanunsa naga balaraben da suka shigo tareda Naseer wanda tunda ya d'aura idanu akansa ya kasa d'agawa ga k'irjinsa dake faman bugu..... 

Shima wannan Dattijo duban Fawaz ya dingayi yana jin wani babban Al'amari a tattare dashi....  Idanunsa naga Fawaz har baisan sanda Aunty Saudat da Lubna suka sauk'o parlorn ba.....   Momy ta k'arasa ta kamo hannun Lubna ta had'esu gaba d'aya dasu Salma ta rungume tana zaune tsakiyarsu don jikinta na bata wani abin ne zai kuma faruwa.... 

Hawaye ke gangaro mata tana takowa cikin parlorn,  juyawar da zaiyi ya hangeta tana takowa cikin tapkeken parlorn..... Lokaci guda ya mik'e k'afafunsa na rawa ya soma takawa ya nufeta shima kukan yake.....   Yana k'arasowa yanda take ya rungumeta ba tareda ya iya furta komai ba sai kuka da yakeyi tamkar k'aramin yaro....  Aunty Saudat kam cak ta tsaya ba tareda ta maida masa martanin rungumar ba....  Sai tunanin sanda ya barta a wannan same parlor yayi tafiyar sa shekaru ashirin da d'oriya da suka gabata, abubuwan suka yawo a kwanyarta,  ta tuna tana binshi tana rik'oshi amma haka ya b'anb'areta daga jikinsa yasa k'afafu ya tafi ya barta wa mutanen da suka tassama halak'ata da k'arfin gaske.....  Lokaci guda tamkar wacce aka zabura ta shiga k'ok'arin b'anb'are jikinta tana kuka sosai tana ture mutumin tana fad'in mai ya dawo dashi ya b'ace bata son ganin sa... Duk cikin harshen arab take maganganun...  A d'ari Fawaz ya k'arasa yana k'ok'arin janye mahaifiyarsa daga rik'on mutumin yake fad'in "Malam lafiya... Wai waye kai....."

Kuka Aunty Saudat take sosai sanda Fawaz ya rungumeta sosai yana huci yana duban mutumin.... Naseer ne ya k'araso yana k'ok'arin janye mutumin a hankali....  Baiko iya bawa Fawaz dake tambayar ko wanene mutumin amsa ba.... sai jiyo muryar wannan mutumi sukayi cikeda tsananin mamaki hausa yake 

"Saudat ki yafeni... Ki yafeni d'iyata wllhi tunda na tafi na barki a nan ban sami kwanciyar hankali ba, arzikin da na tafi dashi baimin amfani ba k'arshe na rasa komai na koma abin tausayi abin kwatance A DUNIYAR MU....  Ki yafe dan Allah.."

Sai sannan Fawaz da sauran jama'an wajen suka fahimce wanene wannan mutumi.... Idanuwan Fawaz suka shiga zubda hawaye, girgiza kai kurum yake yana duban mutumin da mahaifiyarsa.....  Kafin ya sami zarafin magana ya jiyo muryar mahaifiyarsa cikin kuka tana fad'in "Abbu meyasa?  Meyasa ka  tafi ka barni..... Why..?  Baka damu ba all the suffering I went through....  Sun baka kud'ad'e ka aurar dani ma d'ansu wanda suka tasamma kasheni shida mahaifiyarsa Abbu why. .... Wllhi bani buk'atar kuma ganin ka A DUNUYAR MU ka tafi ka tafi ka k'yaleni....."  Ta k'arashe tana kuka sosai da duka zuciyarta... 


Fawaz dake hawaye kallonsu yake su duka biyu kafin ya soma fad'in "What's going on... Make faruwa ku min bayani dan Allah meke faruwa,...?"


Dattijo Suhail ne yakai dubansa ga Fawaz,  a hankali ya taka ya isa har gaban Fawaz yana kallon sa lokaci guda ya rungumesa sosai yana fad'in "Na tabbata kai jika na ne kai jini na ne....?"

Fawaz yayi k'arfin halin b'anb'are Abbu daga jikinsa kaman yanda sukaji Aunty Saudat ta kirasa yana goge hawayen idanunsa yake fad'in "Dan Allah ku fahimtar dani,  wai meke faruwa ne... Mai ya faru shekarun baya.....?"

Dattijo Suhail na hawaye yake fad'in "Wannan shine abinda ya dawo dani,  wannan shine mak'asudin dawowata wajen nan....  Koda Sa'oud da Dije zasu kuma hanani fad'awa wa d'an 'yar uwata asalinsa zan sanar dashi sannan zan nemi gafaran d'iyata akan abunda na mata a baya... Sabida na tabbata hakkinta shi yabibiyeni a rayuwa....."  Ya k'arashe yana mai takowa gaban Naseer wanda bugun k'irjinsa ya k'aru.... 

Abbu Suhail yakai hannu ya kamo hannayen Naseer dake tsaye tamkar mutum mutumi kafin ya soma fad'in "Naseer ka yafe min,  ka yafeni d'ana, ka yafeni rashin sanar dakai da banyi ba tuntuni,  ka sani ba'a sona bane ban sanar da kai ba, iyakaci umarnin mahaifinka nabi...."  Hawaye suka ci gaba da kwararowa daga idanun Abbu Suhail yayinda Naseer ke binsa da kallo lokaci guda jikinsa yayi wani irin sanyi ba tareda sanin dalili ba....  

Abbu Suhail yaci gaba da fad'in "Hidaya 'yar uwata ce,  mahaifiyarka k'anwa take min.....  A lokacin data haifeka Allah ya karb'i rayuwarta... Mahaifinka Sa'oud Santana da mai d'akinsa Dije su suka zab'i a rufa al'amarin sabida tun tasowarka a hannun Dije matar Sa'oud ka taso tamkar ita ta haifeka... Sanda na rasa mai d'akina mahaifiyar Saudatu nazo k'asar nan da Saudatu a lokacin naso sanar dakai dukda k'arancin shekarun da kake dashi amma ban sanar dakai ba sabida mahaifinka ya hana...."  Muryar Dattijo Suhail ta carke sanda kuka yaci k'arfinsa.....  Parlorn tayi tsit sai sautin kuka kake jiyowa....  Zukata sun kuma girgiza shin wannan wane irin Al'amari ne..... 

Naseer har lokacin ya kasa motsawa daga yanda yake tsaye.... Sunan matar da yaji Abbu ya ambata a matsayin mahaifiyarsa yake kan nanatawa HIDAYA....  So wannan shine asalin dalilin da yasa Innah bata tab'a k'aunar sa ba... Ashe shid'in ba d'anta bane....  Ashe mahaifiyarsa ta gaskiya ta jima da rasuwa....  Gaba d'aya rayuwarsa yayisa ne akan Innah ce mahaifiyar sa,  gaba d'aya rayuwarsa yayisa ne wajen kyautata mata da neman aljannarsa ta k'ark'ashinta.....  Abubuwan da Innah ta dinga masa na musgunawa tun yana yaro ya shiga dawowa kwanyarsa, kalan tsanan da tsangwama da ta masa,  ashe ba ita ta haifesa ba,.... Duk rayuwar da yayi bai tab'a addu'a wa mahaifiyar sa ba.... Meyasa Abban sa zai masa haka mai yasa bai sanar dashi ba... Meyasa ya dank'a amanarsa a hannun azzaluman mace wacce tayi sanadiyar barinsa duniya.....  A hankali Naseer ya soma takawa ba tareda ya dubi kowa dake cikin parlorn ba dukda juyawa da duniyar ke masa, Salma ta bisa da kallo itama hawayen ne ke zarya a kumatun ta,  gaba d'aya sai ta nemi nata tashin hankalin da take ciki ta rasa, ji take tamkar ta mik'e a guje ta rungumesa.... 

 A haka ya dinga tafiya har saida ya isa sashen sa kafin ya maida k'ofar ya kulle.... Waje ya samu ya zauna abubuwan suna kuma yawo a kwanyar sa....  Yakai dubansa ga hitonsa da mahaifinsa dake ajiye saman stand dake a cikin d'akinsa... K'arasawa yayi ya d'auki hoton had'i da k'urawa hoton idanu....  Cikin wani irin murya mai tsanin rawa ya soma fad'in "Why...?   Abba Why...  Abba meyasa,  meyasa kayi haka......  Abba meyasa ka min haka......"   Kasa ci gaba da magana yayi sai wani irin kuka da ya kufce masa lokaci guda ya durk'ushe saman gwiwoyinsa a wajen yana rik'e da hoton yake kuka tamkar ransa zai fita......

Affan ne ya shigo sashen Mamy ya tarar har lokacin Mamy bata fice a gidan ba tana nan rakub'e can k'asan carpet tana kuka uwa mai yawon neman taimako,  Shareefah ta kawo mata abinci tana rok'onta taci.... 

Cikin sauri yana wani irin huci ya k'arasa ya wafce plate d'in abincin daga hannun Shareefah,  gaba d'aya daga Mamy har Shareefah d'ago idanu sukayi suna duban Affan d'in dake faman huci da turiri.... 

Cikin wani irin murya yake fad'in "Mamy why just can't understand that you have no place here....  We've nothing to do with you... Is it so hard to understand huh....?  Kin kasa fahimta ne...  Ki gode ma Allah ban mik'a ki ma 'yansanda ba.. Sannan hakan ba yana nufin bazaki fito da Azeema ba kenan.....  Da wannan zaman da kikeyi da tashi kikayi kika dawo da ita don na tabbata bokan ki ne ya tsafe ta..... Mamy I'm afraid idan baki dawo da Azeema ba zaki tafi jail....."  Ya k'arashe yana wani irin huci... 

Kuka sosai Mamy take tana girgiza kai take fad'in "Affan wllhi wllhi ka yarda dani,  wllhi ba laifina bane....  Wllhi duk abinda na fad'a maku iyakacin gaskiyata kenan....  Affan don Allah ku tausaya min wllhi nayi nadama nayi danasanin sanin hanyar gidan boka... Wllhi sharrin Laure ce...  Ku tausaya mini......"  Ta k'arashe tana k'ok'arin janyo k'afar Affan da tuni ya matsa daga kusanta.... 

Shareefah kam kuka sosai take tana rungume da Mamy take fad'in "Wllhi bazata je jail ba haba haba Affan... Baka da imani ne,  Mamy ta tuba ta gyara halayenta,  kuma wllhi na yarda da labarin data bamu...  Malami ya kamata a nema ayi addu'a  a rok'i Allah ya kub'utar da Azeema ya bayyana mana ita,  sannan mu tafi a warware sammon dake jikin Daddy...."


Batakai aya ba suka jiyo muryar Ali Safwan yana fad'in "Bana buk'atar a warware komai... Nafiso na koma ga mahallici na a haka sabida ranan gobe k'iyama na samu shaidan da zan tsaya gaban mahaliccina cewa ta cutar dani.....  Na tabbata wanda ya zalunceka A DUNIYAR MU kaine a saman sa idan anje lahira,  yanda alk'alin alk'alai zaiyi shari'a da gaskiya daidai da daidai baza'a tauye wa kowa ba.....  Babban damuwata ba k'afafuwana bane,  Azeema itace damuwata,  sai yanzu na fahimci ta jima tana wargaza duk wasu shirinki na cutar da Al'umma Asma'u.... A lokacin da na gansu itada Shareefah suna aikata mummunar sab'o naji sam ta sane min a rai daga ita har Shareefar...  Saidai kuma na yarda duk d'an Adam yanada nasa good side d'in,  na tabbata koda ace tana wani sab'o tsakaninta da mahaliccinta tanada nata good side d'in sannan na yarda idan kaga bawa aikata laifi ba aibanta shi zakayi ba ko ka muzanta shi,  addu'a da fatan shiriya shi ya kamata kayi masa sannan kayi addu'an Allah ya kareka daga fad'awa irin aikin sab'on da yake aikatawa...  Yau na tabbata da na muzanta ta na koreta a gidana da batayi yunk'urin ceton rayuwa na ba.....  Amma sai gashi a ranan da kika turoni saman bene Azeema ce ta soma zuwa ta kirawo d'auki,  kika bini asibiti don ki gama dani, nan ma bata barki ba ta bi bayanki ta hanaki aiwata k'udirinki,  bata tsaya a nan ba.. Ta biki har yanda kike tunanin zakije a kashe maki ni ta hanyar asiri sai kuma reshe ta juye da mujiya... Wllhi nayi imani da Allah ko wad'annan ayyukan alkahiri da Azeema tayi zai isa mahaliccinta ya gafarta mata wad'ancan laifukan da tayisu a baya tunda tsakaninta dashi ne,  Shi kuma AlGafur ne kuma mai Rahama...."  

Ya juyo ga dubansa ga Shareefah wacce ta tak'ure sosai tana hawaye kana yace "Wannan ya isa izna a gareki....  Ki tuba kibi Allah kisan wancan laifi da na kamaku kunayi shi yasa ban aura maki Naseer ba sabida bazan cutar dashi ba na aura masa Salma nitsetsiyar yarinya...  Ba wai nak'i ki bane saidai inaso ki gyara halinki....  Abubuwa da dama sun faru A DUNIYAR MU wanda na tabbata sun ishe masu hali irin naki ishara Asma'u.... Zaki iya zama a cikin gidan nan kodon Shareefah amma a halin yanzu bansan matsayin aurenki a gidan nan ba... Wllhi daraja guda kikaci darajan 'ya'yana sgiyasa na maki wannan alfarma, sannan ki sani ni ba azzalumi bane bazanso naga kin tagayyara ba.....  Ki zauna kiyita istigifari wa mahaliccin ki don laifin da kikayi yafi ko wani laifi girma da muni a sikeli...  Allah yayi mana muwafak'a ya datar damu,  ya tsare mu da imanin mu daga bijire masa....  Affan maza shige mu tafi sallan isha...."  Ya k'arashe yana tura tayun wheelchair d'insa... 

Affan da jikinsa yayi sanyi sosai a hankali yabi bayan mahafin nasa.... 

Mamy da Sahreefah suka kuma rungumar juna suna kuka mai cikieda da tarin nadama da ban tausayi....

Wannan dare ma iya cewa gidan Sa'oud Santana kwana zaune akayi koma kwana tsaye,  Momy ita ta sauk'i Suhail da matar da take tunanin matarsa ce a d'akin bak'i don banzai yuwu a gama wannan warware-warware ba a dare guda.... 


Ko kad'an Jamila bata sanar da 'yan uwanta halin da take ciki ba,  saidai kana ganinta zaka fahimci lafiya bai isheta ba,  gaba d'aya ta tashi hankalinta ta tsangwami rayuwarta,  duk yanda Momy taso jin abinda ke damunta tak'i sanar da ita.. A b'angaren Salma kuwa kwana tayi tunanin Soja da halin da yake ciki,  hasashenta na cewa ba Innah ce ta haifi Soja ba ya kuma tabbata,  itakam ko a finafinai bata tab'a gani ko jin labarin masu hali irin na Innah ba,  tamkar ba 'yar Adam ba....  Haka nan ta kwana tana zullumin halin da Soja ke ciki... 



Washe gari har wajajen azahar basuji d'uriyan Naseer ba... Abin duk ya dami Salma dukda mutanen gidan kowa ya k'ulene a uwar d'aki tamkar masu takaba,  ma'ikata ne kurum saiko Momy masu zirga-zirgan...  Dukda haka sosai abin ya dami Salma...  Momy na hankalce da ita yanda ta rafka tagumi ta k'urawa k'ofar sashen Naseer d'in idanu ko zataga fitowarsa...  A hankali Momy ta k'araso kusanta kafin ta d'an dafata...  

"Daughter...."  D'ago kai Salma tayi tana dubanta damuwa fal fuskarta... 

K'ak'aro murmushi Momy tayi ta sakar mata kana tace "Kije ki duba shi kiga yaya ya kwana kinji koh...." murya cikeda kulawa tayi maganar.. 

Salma ko tamkar wacce take jira,  cikin sauri ta mik'e tana fad'in "Toh Momy,  zanje... Barinje na dubashi....."  Gaba d'aya a birkice take yin maganar... 

Cikeda tausayawa Momy ke dubanta kafin ta mata rakiya har k'ofa.. 

Har sun kai k'ofar Momy ta k'arasa saman dining table ta d'au bawl na fruit salad wanda Falmata bata jima da ijiyewa ba ta mik'a mata kana tace "Nasan bashida appetite wannan zai taimaka maza kai masa..."

Salma ta murmusa ta amsa tana mai fad'in "Toh Momy..."  Kana ta nufi sashen Naseer... 

Saidai ga mamakinta a bud'e taga sashen nasa kuma bataji alamunsa ba...  Ta shiga tana mai sallama amma shiru ba'a amsata ba....  Ko ina saida ta duba a sashen nasa bataji alamunsa ba... Jiki a sanyaye ta fito ta nufi cikin gida...
