Hannayen sa sakale a aljihu yake duban likitan kana yace "Dr kana nufin saidai a yanke k'afafun kenan....?"

Dr ya jinjina kai kana yace "This the only solution Captain,  already  veins d'in k'afafun nasa sun daddage dole a yanke kafin yaci gaba da rayuwa,  idan yakai wasu awanni ba'a yanke ba komai ka iya faruwa....."

Naseer ya d'an shafi goshinsa kafin ya jinjina kai yace "Shikenan Dr ayi yanda ya kamata....  Ni zan wuce akwai corps guda biyu da zasu tsaya a nan kafin ya sami lafiya..."

Dr ya jinjina kai kafin ya mik'a hannu wa Naseer sukayi masabaha Naseer d'in ya wuce....

"Madu ka duba runfar nan da kyau don jiya wllhi nidai naji kaman motsi cikinta,  yanzu haka macijin kwanakin nan ne  ya dawo....."  D'aya saurayin ya fad'i yana nad'e hannun riga.. 

Sandar gora dake gefensa ya rarumo kafin ya mik'a wa abokin wata daushiyar itace yace "Kai alk'ur'an yau macijin nan zai bak'unci lahira don uwarsa ni na tabbata turensa aka mana angama runfar mu tafi ci gaba,  mukar tsinanne yaje yace ma wanda ya turosa mun karsa..."

Yana ida fad'in haka suka shiga bugun shirgin kwalayen dake cikin rumfar

Ihun mutum da suka jiyo daga cikin shirgin ya sanyasu dakatawa da bugun cikeda mamaki....  Aiko basu ida mamaki ba saida sukaga dartijuwan mace ta fito cikin shirgin maimakon ta tsaya ta basu bayani sai artawa da tayi a guje dukda ciwo da jikinta ke mata domin kam ta bugu dukda ba jikinta direct aka samu ba..... 

Matasan nan maimakon abin ya basu tsoro saima dariya da ta basu.... Mamakin yanda akayi ta shige shirgin nan suka dingayi....  Madu yace "Kai Mati k'ila dai macijiyar ce ta rikid'a ta zama mutum...."

"Toh waya sani mudai mun jibgeta ta kuma dawowa bazamu fasa ba..."  Ya k'arashe yana jifa da sandar hannun sa.... 


Saida tayi gudu sosai kafin ta samu wani k'asan bishiya ta d'an d'aga bujenta had'i da ciro 'yan kud'ad'en data sata a kantin su Madu wanda ta tabbata zai isheta kud'in mota.... Amma da kafin ta bar gari tana buk'atan ganin 'ya'yanta Lubna da Kabeer, tasan duk yanda akayi watsestten yaron nan Naseer ya kame mata d'a... Zuciyarta ya shiga bugawa da sauri da sauri sanda ta tuna komai ka iya faruwa da Kabeer,  bata k'aunar wani abin ya samesa... Lokaci guda taji tana son ganinsa duk hanyar da zatabi ta gansa zata bi, tunaninta guda da ya addabeta shine samun mafaka kafin ta gama abinda zatayi a garin ta cika ma rigar ta iska,  wata zuciya tace toh ki koma rumfar samarin nan....  Toh kuma idan ta koma suka fahimce ta masu sata fah....??  Rafka uban tagumi Innah tayi tana tunanin lamarin ga bak'ar yunwa dake azalzalanta.....  Ta shiga tunanin rayuwar daula da tayi a baya,  mulki babu kalan wanda batayi ba yau gata nan a tagayyare wajen barci ya gagareta balle abinda zata sanya a bakinta....  A hankali ta kuma gyara kwanciyarta jikin bushiyar ga k'ashushuwanta dake faman mata ciwo....

Bai komo gidan ba sai wajajen bayan la'asar yanda ya tarar Abbu da mai d'akinsa Kaltume suna kwararo bayani wa Aunty Saudat da Momy yanda akayi suka had'u har sukayi aure.... 

Abbu yaci gaba da fad'in "Sanda na baro Nigeria da dukiyata wanda na amsa daga wajen Sa'oud Santana da sunan kud'in auren d'iyata Saudat ban koma k'asarmu Morocco ba sai na yada zango a k'asar Mali birnin Bamaco.... Ban damu na koma Casablanca ba sabida na riga na masu sallama na fita da fita na ne....  Toh a k'asar Mali naci gaba da juya dukiyata hankali na kwance ba tareda tunanin wani hali na baro d'iyata ba.... A nan k'asar Mali na koyi yaren Hausa  domin yanda nake zaune ma yankin hausawa ne 'yan asalin k'asar Nigeria...  Mutanen da nake zaune dasu na yarda dasu su suka cutar dani suka kassarani,  suka yashe duk wani dukiya nawa sukayi tafiyar su, wanda har rana mai kaman ta yau bansan yanda suka nufa ba... Mahaifin Kaltume shine kawai mutumin da bai gujeni ba don duk wanda nake taredasu suke cin arziki k'ark'ashina daekariyar arziki ta sameni gujemin sukayi.....  Shi kad'aine bai guje ni ba kuma yaso jin gaskiyar labarina... Ban b'oye masa komai ba yanda ya nuna min nayi kuskure na tapka babban kuskure A DUNIYAR MU,  ya umarceni na zo k'asar Nigeria na duba d'iyata...  Ban iya zuwa ba sabida bansan da wani ido zan soma duban Saudat ba.... Duk yanda yaso nazo Nigeria nak'i zuwa,  ina nan zaune a birnin Bamaco har ya aura min d'iyarsa Kaltum sabida yanda yaga na koma tamkar wanda baiso yaci gaba da rayuwa....  Toh bayan aurenmu da Kaltum Allah yayi masa rasuwa, nasan nayi rashi sannan Duniya ta kuma bani tsoro,  na d'auki alwashin zuwa k'asar Nigeria na fuskanci d'iyata koda bazata yafeni ba sannan na sanar da Naseer koshi wanene koda Sa'oud bazai bari ba.  Saidai kuma da nazo na tarar Sa'oud ya rigayemu gidan gaskiya sannan bai sanar da d'an 'yaruwata wacece mahaifiyar sa ba....."  Sosai yake duban Aunty Saudat dake zuban hawaye kana yaci gaba da fad'in "Saudat ki yafe ni,  ki yafeni dan Allah wllhi naga iftila'i na rayuwa da dama A DUNIYAR MU, kuma na yarda duk wanda ka zalunta koda bawanka ne ba d'anka ba Allah zai saka masa, zukatan mutane sun cika don son duniya da abinda ke cikinta A DUNIYAR MU,  bamu hangen lahirarmu burinmu kawai yaya zamu sami duniya tako wani irin hanya.... Iyaye sukan saida 'ya'yansu ta hanyar auren dole duk don su sami duniya basu tunanin had'arin da hakan ka iya haifarwa,  su saida farin cikin d'iyoyinsu duk akan duniya,  ina fata iyaye masu irin wannan d'abi'a zasu hankalta su gyara... Kuma na yarda tarin dukiya bashine jin dad'i A DUNIYAR MU ba,  kwanciyar hankali yafi komai dad'i,  Saudat ki yafe min dan Allah kinji d'iyata....." 

Baikai aya ba sai gani yayi ta taso ta rungumesa tana matsan hawaye... Cikin muryar kuka take fad'in "Abby na yafe ka,  na yafeka duniya da lahira.... Allah ya yafemu gaba d'aya...."

Naseer dake tsaye daga k'ofa baisan sanda murmushi ya kufce masa ba,  Allah sarki ashe Aunty Saudat jinin sa ce,  ashe 'yar uwarsa ce....  Lokaci guda ya saka d'an yatsar sa had'i da goge idanunsa... Hannun mutum ne yaji ya dafa sa ya d'an juyo yana duban ko wanene,  Fawaz ne shima murmushi kwance saman fuskar sa... A hankali Naseer ya furta "Alhamdulillah... Fawaz zumuntar mu ta k'aru....."   Fawaz bai iya cewa komai ba sai rungume Naseer da yayi.. A tare suka k'arasa cikin parlorn..... Abbu na dubansu da murmushi saman fuskar sa ya bud'e masu hannu yana fad'in "Kuzo 'ya'ya na....."   Babu musu suka k'arasa suka rungume juna 

Momy da Kaltum suka d'an share hawayen da ya zubo masu....  Lubna da Salma dake tsaye jikin staircase a hankali suka k'araso cikin parlorn suma murmushi kwance saman fuskar su.... 

Naseer ne ya d'an juyo yana duban su,  Salma kam saurin sunkuyar da kanta k'asa tayi,  k'arasawa yayi tsakiyarsu ya kamo hannayensu suka k'araso har gaban Abbu kafin Naseer yayi introducing d'insu matar shi da kuma k'anwar shi,  Abbu ya kuma jin dad'i ya sanya masu albarka..   Hankula suka d'an soma dai-daita a wannan family.... 

Lubna ce ta tuna sak'on da Deeni ya bar mata cikin sauri ta mik'e ta nufi d'aki ta d'auko sak'on.... Kai tsaye ta bawa Naseer tana masa bayani... 

K'irjinsa ya yanke yayi wani irin fad'uwa,  donshi yanzu har tunanin b'ullowar wani sabon Al'amari yake....  Gaba d'aya parlorn akayi tsit ana duban Naseer dake k'ok'arin bud'e envelope.... 

Wasu takardu ne suka soma fad'owa daga cikin envelope d'in tamkar wasik'a.... A hankali ya soma warwarewa, baisan yaya akayi ba saiji yayi bakinsa na karanta wasik'ar taryan-taryan...

_Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullah....  Zuwaga d'ana Naseer... Wasiyace da ya kamata na sanar dakai tuntuni saidai Allah bai k'addara zan sanar dakai da bakina ba....._   Kasa ci gaba da karatun Naseer yayi sai k'ura wa takardan idanu da yayi.... 

Abbu ne ya k'arasa ya amshi takardan kana yaci gaba da karantawa kaman haka

_Naseer d'ana nasan duk daren d'ad'ewa gaskiya zata bayyana maka A DUNIYAR MU,  amma ka sani duk randa wannan Al'amari ta bayyana maka kada kayi fushi dani domin kuwa na aiwatar da hakan ne sabida tunanin shine maka dai-dai..Naseer na b'oye maka asalin mahaifiyar ka ce sabida tsananin soyayyar da nake maka bana son ka tashi cikin maraicin rashin uwa...  Amma daga baya na fahimci dole duk daren dad'ewa haka na iya bayyana maka cewa Dije ba ita ta haifeka ba....  Idan wannan Al'amari ya bayyana maka kayi mana addu'a da fatan dacewa nida mahaifiyarka Hidaya...  Ka sani kaida Lubna ina k'aunarku fiye da komai na rayuwata,  sannan ko bayan babu ni ka rik'e 'yar uwarka kuma k'anwar ka da amana sabida ku biyu tak Allah ya mallaka min A DUNIYAR MU....  Duk da bani na haifi Kabeer ba ban yarda ku canza sa a matsayin wa ba koda gaskiya ta bayyana maku....  Jikina na bani bazaka dawo daga makaranta har mu kuma had'uwa A DUNIYAR MU ba,  amma idan har Allah ya raba ganawa zanbar wannan sak'o ma direba na Malam Ladan har ya isa gareka.... Ina maka wasalci da gaskiya da rik'on amana a duk yanda ka tsinci kanka... Allah yayi maku albarka gaba d'aya ya d'ayyiba zuri'arku...Ameen...  Daga mahaifinka SA'OUD NASEER SANTANA...._

Abbu yana ida karantawa ya linke takardan....  Naseer kam jigum yayi yana saurare har aka ida karantawa....  Ashe Kabeer ba yayansa bane,  kai bai tab'a tunanin a duniya ana samun mutane irin Innah da Kabeer ba wannan shine dalilinsu na son ganin bayansa da k'arfin gaske,  ashe shid'in barene acikin su ALLAH Sarki duniya abin tsoro,  sai gashi duk wasu tarko na mugunta da sukayita kafa masa Allah yana tseratar dashi.....  Yana cikin tunanin yaji Lubna ta rik'o hannunsa ta kwantar da kanta cikin jikinsa tana hawaye.... 

Fawaz ma k'arasawa yayi ga mahaifiyarsa suka rungume juna suna hawaye... Fad'i yake  "Mum ashe Dad ba d'an Abbah bane... Shiyasa mana,  shiyasa suka kashe Abbah,  ashe ba jinin sa bane.... Ashe nan ba gidanmu bane Mum, .... Mum na gaji da Nigeria,  zan tafi nikam bazan kuma iya ci gaba da rayuwar k'asar nan ba... Tunda na dawo babu abin arziki da na tarar sai na akasin haka....  I'm leaving this country for good....  Na gaji wllhi...."   Ya k'arashe muryar sa na tsananin rawa... 

Hannun Naseer yaji saman kafad'arsa... Ya d'ago yana dubansa...  Wasu hawaye na kuma zubo masa ya rungume Naseer yana fad'in "Uncle I'm tired,  zan tafi wani wajen daban and start a fresh...."  Ya kasa ci gaba da magana sabida kuka da yaci k'arfinsa... Rungumesa sosai Naseer yayi cikin k'arfin hali don dolensa ya zama very strong...  Cikin kwantar daehankali ya soma magana ma Fawaz... 

"Fawaz we're still family....  Ka daina cewa zaka tafi kar ka mance ko Abbah bai had'amu ba Abbu ya had'amu,  Fawaz kai jinin mu ne ko ina kaje kazo.... Sannan baka da gidan da yafi nan,  I'm still your only Uncle..... Kar na kuma jin kayi magana irin haka kaji koh... Yanzu gaba d'aya tunani zamuyi yanda zamu fuskanci wannan Al'amari,  idan kana kuka kuma Lubna mai zatayi,  be a man kaji"

Jinjina masa kai kurum Fawaz yayi ya shiga share hawayen da suka wanke masa fuska..

Naseer ya d'an tattare naman goshinsa had'i da fuzar da iska kafin ya d'an ware hannaye yace "Har yanzu babu labarin Innah,  babu wanda ya ganta...  Shi kuma Yaya d'azu daga station nake muka wuce asibiti sakamakon ruwan acid d'in da ya zuba wa k'afafunsa likitoci sunce saidai a yanke k'afafun.... So yanzu na bari za'ayi aikin...."


Aunty Saudat ce ta dubesa kana tace "Gaskiya Naseer kanada imani da tsananin tawakkali waye zai tsaya kula mutumin da ya farauci rayuwarsa har ya kula da jinyar sa....  Ire-irenka k'alilan ne bayan duk kalan abubuwan da suka maka...."

D'an k'ak'aro murmushi Naseer yayi kana yace "Aunty duk wanda ya k'ullaceka da sharri ka saka masa da akasin haka zaka kasance saman shi A DUNIYAR MU,  sannan a lahira ma kaine a sama.....  Fatana Innah da Yaya su tsaya a zartar masu da hukuncin da ya kamace su,  don bana so su tafi duniya ta koya masu hankali,  su karb'i hukuncinsu da sauran mutuncin su zaifi masu sauk'i kuma muma zaifi mana sauk'i tunda babu yanda muka iya duk yanda mukaje muka zo sud'in namu ne...."  

Gaba d'aya mutanen parlorn jinjina halin Dattako irin Naseer suke,  babu kaman Abbu wanda murmushin dake saman fuskar sa ta kasa gushewa....  

Momy ma kallonsa take tana murmushi tana jin sonsa har cikin ranta tamkar ita ta tsuguna ta haifesa.... 

****


Bayan gari Innah ta nufo duk ta d'aid'aice ta fice hayyacin ta,  nan ta hangi  wasu 'yan mata sai safaran abinci suke suna kai ma customers d'insu.... Innah tayi hamma ta had'iyi miyau....  Da jan k'afafu ta isa rumfar 'yan matan nan.... 

Budurwar sai faman cakalan chewing gum take tana k'wark'wasa sanda ta nufi samarukan tana raba masu abincin....  Innah ta rakub'e daga can gefe tana hangan yanda suke loman abincin.... 

Saurayi guda ne ya lura da Innah wacce ta kafesu da idanu... Wani mugun tsuka yayi kafin yace "Ke Piky da Allah kizo ki kori wannan almajiran tsohuwar ai saita sa mutum ya k'ware..."

Shiko d'ayan saurayin cewa yayi "Ni k'yama ma ta bani wannan ai zata sanya mutum amai....."

Cikin sauri wacce suka kira da Piky ta k'araso wajen tana k'wark'wasa take fad'in " yaya yaya wacece a wajen.....?"  Kallon mamaki take bin Innah dashi kana tace "Ke chuuss lafiya, me kikeyi a nan...."

"Abinci zaku taimaka min dashi don Allah, wllhi 'yan kud'ad'e na gaba d'aya an sace an yasheni,  ku taimaka min da abinci don Allah...."   Innah ta fad'i cikin wani irin murya... 


Dariya suka kwashe dashi kana budurwar tace "Ke tsohuwar kilaki kar ki raina ma kanki hankali, ce maki akayi muna taimako ko kuma kinga alamun taimako a tattare damu....  Gwara tun wuri ki cika ma rigarki iska kafin Magajiya ta fito ta taddaki,  wannan ke daga ganin naki zamanin baki sami kasuwa da yawa ba shiyasa kika d'aid'aice haka... Tashi ki b'ace min a nan...."   Ta k'arashe tana watsa wa Innah sauran ruwan wanke-wanke

Innah ta mik'e da k'yar da zummar tafiya nan idanunta ya sauk'a saman teburin da samarukan nan ke cin abinci,  karan sigari ta hanga Wanda rabonta dashi tun tana cikin sauran hayyacinta,  tana tsananin buk'atar zuk'an sigari koda bata sami abinci ba....  Tattare fatarinta tayi ta faki idanun mutanen dake wajen kafin ta daka wani tsalle takai ma karan sigarin nan capka lokaci guda ta ari na kare ta arce a guje..... 

Ai samarin nan a d'ari suka mik'e suka bi bayanta suna watso ashariya....  Tuntub'e da Innah tayi karan sigarin ta fad'i k'asa ya sanyata zubewa a k'asa itama... Wad'annan samari babu ko d'and'anin tausayi cikin zuciyarsu dukda shekaru irin na Innah basu fasa k'wallo da ita ba..... Suka shiga janyota a k'asa tamkar kariya.... Tuni karuwan dake layin sunyi chaaa suna kallo don dama abin kallo bai masu kad'an...

"Wllhi yau sai mun maki tsirara dan uwarki,  zigidir zamu maki yanda gobe bazaki sake sata ba....  Kai Aska kwab'e mani fatarin shegiya...."   Ya k'arashe yana zuge belt d'in wandonsa... 


Innah ihu take tana rok'insu su mata rai kar su daketa.... Inaaa tamkar aza masu wuta take.....  Karuwan kuwa sai shewa suke suna tafi babu mai yunk'urin ceton Innah... 

Jikin wata k'arfe su Aska da abokinsa suka d'aure Innah bayan sun kwab'e d'an bujen nata suka shiga wasafata babu akan karan sigarin naira ashirin babu d'igon imani cikin zuciyarsu balle tausayi..... 

Tun Innah tana ihu idan an sauk'e mata bulala d'aya har ta daina.... Saida Magajiya tazo wajen a d'ari tana fad'in "Haba Aska wai lafiyarku wani iya shege ne wannan,  yanzu mai wannan tsohuwar ta maku kuka tak'uneta jikin k'arfe kuna bugu inyi....?"

"Uwar daba ki fita kawai daga wannan zancen sata tayi kuma kinsan hukuncin b'arawo a layin nan..."

Girgiza kai Uwar daba tayi kana tace "Mai ta sata...?"

"Sigari ta sata..."  Ya bata amsa kai tsaye... 

"Yanzu kan sigari ne kuka farfasa ma tsohuwar nan jiki.. Kwance ta zan biya...."  Ta k'arashe tana cusa hannu cikin riga... 

Saida ya kuma kwand'arawa Innah bakin k'arfen jikin belt a tsakar ka kafin ya kwanceta...  Ta kuwa kuma sakin k'aran azaba.... 

Uwar daba ce ta janyota har cikin gidan sauran karuwan na biye da ita suna taunar cingam... 

****

Mamy hankali ya soma dawowa jikinta,  ta soma dawowa asalin Asma'un ta,  yau har wanka tayi ta cakare ado cikin lallausar leshinta, da kanta ta shiga kitchen ta d'aura masu breakfast, gaba d'aya k'ok'arinta ta karkato hankalin Ali Safwan ne ya kuma dawowa gareta... Shareefah kam tuni ta fice ganin Dr Siraj, don sun riga sunyi waya dashi yace da ita ta same sa a asibitin sa basai taje TH ba,  hakanma sai yafi mata sauk'i...

Kai tsaye d'akin Affan ta soma nufa don Daddy kam ya mata iyaka da b'angaren sa,  zuciyarta sai faman bugu yake sanda tayi sallama a k'ofar Affan.. Sanin darajan Sallama ne kurum ya sanya Affan amsa mata....  Kallo d'aya yayi mata ya ganta d'auke da k'aramin tray sai k'ok'arin k'ak'aro murmushi take wanda yafi kama da yak'e...

Cikin wani irin murya mai cikeda fargaba Mamy tace "Son I...  I brought you your breakfast..."

Baiko kalleta ba yaci gaba da abinda yake... 

Ganin bazai kulata ba ya sanyata ajiye 'yar tray d'in saman rug...  Ta d'an tako kusansa tana fad'in "Affan da kaina na girka maka don Allah kazo kaci kaji..."

Cak ya tsaya ya daina abinda yake ya juyo yana dubanta kafin ya girgiza kai ya maida dubansa ga mirror yana mai fad'in "Bazanci ba musamman da naji kece kika girka...."

Murya na rawa Mamy tace "Affan mai yasa...."

Cikin ko inkula yace "Because everything prepared by you is contaminated....."

Mamy taji wasu hawaye suna sauk'o mata,  shikenan iyalanta bazasu kuma yarda da ita ba.. Shikenan zamansu ya koma babu yarda...  A hankali ta juya ta fice daga d'akin nasa cikin wani irin sanyin gwiwa, had'i da takaici da danasani mai tarin yawa... 


Parlor ta dawo ta zauna saman kujeran dining ta shiga rusa kuka mai tsuma zuciya.... Har Delu ta fito ta taddata a haka...

Mamy ta d'ago kai tana duban Delu wasu sabbin hawaye suka shiga gangaro mata,  cikin kuka take fad'in "Delu bazasu kuma yarda dani ba... Shikenan na zamto abin zargi da kokonto had'i da shakku a garesu... Kaico kaicon son zuciya irin nawa,  wllhi nayi nadama nayi danasani maras iyaka Delu....."

Delu ta goge hawayen da suka d'an fito mata kana tace "Kiyi hak'uri Hajiya duk tsanani na tareda sauk'i sannan watarana komai zai wuce ya zamto labari...."


Cikin kuka Mamy ta katse ta da fad'in "Yaushene wataranan yaushene komai zai wuce.. Delu da tunanin Azeema kurum aka barni wllhi rayuwa bazata min dad'i A DUNIYAR MU ba,  ina iyaka k'ok'arina wajen ganin na dawo da zamantakewar da muke ciki a baya ba don jin dad'i na bane Delu saidon na dawo ma iyalaina farin cikinsu da suka rasa....  Wllhi Delu sam ban damu da farincikina ya dawo ba, damuwata kawai shine nasu ya dawo, nikam nasan har na koma ga mahallici na farin cikina bazai kuma dawowa ba A DUNIYAR MU.. "  Ta k'arashe cikin tsananin rawar murya... 

Tausayin Mamy da iyalanta ya cika zuciyar Delu.... 


****

K'ara ya saki sanda ya dubi k'afafunsa yaga tun daga cinyarsa babu komai ya zama dungulumi....  Cikin wani irin kuka yake fad'in "Where are my legs... Ina k'afafuna..  What happened to me..  Meye ya sameni?   A ina nake....?"  Duk wad'annan tambayoyi ma kansa yake yinsu... Lokaci guda ya d'ago idanu ya dubi Dr da Naseer tsaye gefen gadon nasa.... 


Fincika yayi zai cakumo Naseer ya kasa,  cikin wani irin huci da karaji yake fad'in "Naseer mai kayi min,  what did you do to me... Mai kayi min Naseer.."

Kafin Naseer yakai ga basa amsa sukaji an bud'e k'ofa an shigo...  Ba kowa bane illa Fawaz wanda idanunsa suka kad'a sukayi jazir... 

Lokaci guda Fawaz ya soma fad'in "Babu abinda ya maka sai alkhairi,  abinda LA shuka shine kake girbewa Dad,  na tabbata badon Uncle Naseer ya taimaka ya kawo ka asibiti ba da yanzu ka zama tarihi...  Da ka cutar da kanka shi sai ya taimaka maka....  Dad wannan ya zama izna a gareka,  kayi k'ok'ari ka tuba a zaman da zakayi a gidan yari,  don na tabbata a can zaka k'arashi rayuwarka...  Wannan shine rayuwar da ka zab'i jefa kanka ciki... D'unbin Al'umman daka zalunta Allah bazai barka ba,  kayi k'ok'ari ka nemi yafiyarsa tun A DUNIYAR MU sannan ka amshi hukuncin da za'a yanke maka hannu bibbiyu domin shine tsirar ka..... Ga wannan rubuta wa Mum takardanta, don bazan bar k'asar nan ba sai na tabbata batada sauran alak'a dakai..."

Kallon Fawaz yake hawaye suna gangaro masa...  Zaiyi magana Fawaz ya dakatar dashi ta hanyar d'aga hannu yana mai kuma mik'a masa takardan da pen... 

Tunda Alh Kabeer yake nadaman rayuwa bata tab'a shigansa ba sai yau....  Hannayensa suna rawa ya rubuta wa mahaifiyar Fawaz saki....  Aiko yana gama rubutawa Fawaz ya d'au takardan ya linke ya saka a aljihu... Har ya juya zai soma tafiya yaji hannun mahaifin nasa ya rik'osa..

"Son ka yafeni dan Allah.. Kuma kace Saudat ta yafeni ina sonta wllhi duk sharrin Innah ce,  sharrin Innah ce nason d'ukan fansa akan duk wani jinin mahaifiyar Naseer..."

A tare Naseer da Fawaz suka kuma juyowa suna duban Alh Kabeer jin wani sabon Al'amari na shirin kunno kai... 


"Fansa!!! " Naseer ya maimaita a fili... 

Alh Kabeer ya jinjina kai kafin yaci gaba da fad'in "Iya tsawon rayuwar da Innah tayi A DUNIYAR MU tayisa ne da burin d'aukan fansa akan duk wani jinin Hidaya da zata sami dama akansa,  wannan shine dalilinta da tasa aka aura min Saudat ta zugani mukayita d'aukan fansa akanta...  Innah ta kansace tana aikatau wa mahaifiyarka Naseer a lokacin da ta rabu da mahaifina... Mahaifiyarka ta tsangwame mu daga Innah har ni d'anta bata bari ba badon komai ba saidon tsanar bak'in fata da tayi...  Wannan shine babban jigo, nuna banbancin launin fata shine asalin kunnuwar wutan duk wani musiba da tashin hankalin da muka tsinci kawunanmu ciki A DUNIYAR MU..."  Tas Alh Kabeer ya labarta masu duk yanda abin ya kasance,  rasa mahaifiyarta da Innah tayi da duk wani shirinta na d'aukan fansa har kisan Sa'oud Santana da sukayi...  Daga k'arshe ya sanar dasu cewa duk nadaga cikin shirinsu na d'aukan fansa akan Naseer k'one gidan gonar Ali Safwan da yayi... Kisan mahaifin Deeni da sauransu...."


Kan Naseer yayi wani irin bugawa...  wannan wata irin rayuwa ce mai cikeda burin d'aukan fansa.. Wacce irin rayuwa ce da babu yafiya,  wacce irin rayuwa ce da babu tausayi balle imani,  saikace a jahiliya period, lokacin da za'a d'auki shekaru ana gaba k'abila k'abila...  Ashe har yanzu hakan takan faru bayan tuni muslunci ya ijeyemu k'ark'ashin inuwa guda k'ark'ashin kalma guda... Innalillahi wa Inna'ilaihirraji'un...  Kalman da yayita nanatawa kenan cikin zuciyarsa,  sai yanzu ya kuma gane yanda tsanar da Innah tayi masa ya samo asali...  Duk yanda zaiyi zaiyi k'ok'ari yaci gaba da yak'an Racism tsakanin Al'umma..  Musulmi d'an uwan muslumi ne irrespective of tribe ko kuma launin fata,  haka muslunci ya koyar damu.... Duniya ta kuma baiwa Naseer tsoro jin irin muggan abubuwa da Innah tayisu A DUNIYAR TA duk da sunan d'aukan fansa, ciki harda kisan mahaifiyar sa da sukayi itada mahaifiyarta...  Baisan yaya akayi ba baisan yaya ya iso gida ba shidai kawai yaga Fawaz na bud'e masa k'ofar mota ne,  yana fata tashin hakulan da suke faman shiga ciki suzo k'arshe A DUNIYAR Su... 

***

Daddy yasa hannu yana share hawayen sa sanda Malam yaci gaba da fad'in "Alh duk iya istiraha da zanyi gameda wannan d'iya taku bani ganin komai sai jerin kabaruruka...  A gaskiya ina tunanin Allah ya amshi abinshi amma kasan sanin gaibu sai Allah,  ban isa nace ta mutu ba ko tana raye,  saidai muci gaba da addu'a idan tana raye Allah ya bayyanata.. Idan kuma Allah ya amshi abunsa sai mu mata addu'an dacewa domin duk wanda ya kashe wani ranar gobe k'iyama da raunin zai tashi ya kuma damk'e wanda ya kashe shin yana tambayarsa mai yayi masa ya kashe sa... Muyiwa wannan yarinya fatan dacewa,  Allah ya gafarta mata kurakurenta sannan ayyukanta na alkhairi su bita... "

Daddy bai iya amsawa ba sai dafe kansa da yayi da hannunsa yana kuka sosai...  Mamy dake tsaye jikin k'ofa kuka sosai ya kufce mata,  cikin sauri ta fice tana kuka sosai.... 

A hanya ta had'u da Shareefah dawowarta kenan daga asibiti.. Rungume Shareefah Mamy tayi tana kuka sosai take fad'in "Shareefah Azeema babu... Azeema babu,  Azeema ta tafi ta barmu.... Laure ta kashe Azeema....."

Kuka sosai Mamy take lokaci guda suka zube saman kujera daga ita har Shareefar,  kuka Shareefah take tana tuna rayuwarsu da Azeema,  Allah sarki 'yar uwarta... Tana tsananin k'aunar Azeema don batada k'awa kuma aminiyar da ta fita....  Shareefah sai taso tafi Mamy shiga tashin hankali... 

Affan sai ya zama abin tausayi,  bai tab'a sanin na k'aunar Azeema ba sai yanzu,  koda ba k'aunar aure yake mata ba yanajin wani Al'amari a tattare da ita,  Allah sarki Azeema bazata fice a zukatan wad'annan bayi ba... 


Yanda Mamy ta koma gaba d'aya ta kuma d'aid'aicewa sai ta bawa Daddy tausayi,  musamman da ya lura ta jingina ma kanta hakkin mutuwar Azeema dukda ba wai sun tabbatar ko Azeemar ta mutu bane..  ...  A hankali ya turo wheelchair d'in nasa har ya shigo cikin d'akin...  Mamy ta d'anyi k'ok'arin saita kanta ga k'irjinta dake bugawa don rabonta da taga Daddy a side d'inta ta mance..  

D'an gyaran murya yayi kafin ya soma mata magana cikin kwantar da hankali...  "Asma'u ki rage damuwar nan da kike ciki,  bamu da tabbacin Azeema ta rigayemu gidan gaskiya ko tana raye.. Andu'a shine gaba,  muci gaba da mata addu'a har Allah ya bayyana mana ita,  idan kuma ta rigaye amsa kiran mahaliccin mu Allah ya datar da ita da rahamarsa,  wannan duniya dukanmu bak'ine cikinta kowa zai tafi babu wanda yazo zama... Ki kwantar da hankalin ki kinji koh,  yawan kukan ki na nufin tashin hankalin yaranki ne...  Allah yasa mu dace..."  Daga haka ya turo kekensa ya fice ba tareda ya jira amsar Mamy ba... 

Tabi bayansa da kallo tausayi da soyayyarsa na kuma ratsa zuciyarta.. 



Mamy rungume da hoton Azeema cikin k'irjinta ta kwana...  Idan ta d'ago hoton tana ganinta sai ta kuma tuna rayuwarsu a gidan Laure...  Allah sarki Azeema kyawawan ayyukan ki na alkhairi su biki... 

Kwana kusan uku Mamy tana nan a haka yau Daddy yace su shirya zasuyi tafiya gaba d'aya...  Tunda Mamy taga an d'auki hanyar Jama'are hankalinta ya tashi,  ta tuna zancen boka cewa idan ta shiga garin haukacewa zatayi...  K'aramin littafin addu'o'i na Hisnul Muslim dake cikin jakanta ta ciro ta shiga karanto azkar don yanzu ba'a rabata da azkar musamman na safiya da maraice... 

Affan na tuk'awa Daddy na gaba itada Shareefah suna gidan baya...  Affan ne yayi gyaran murya ya tambayi Mamy location d'in bishiyar da tace an birne summon a wajen... 

Mamy ta basa amsa dai-dai ba tareda tab'in hankali ba,  jin bata haukace ba har suka shigo garin ya kuma tabbatar mata boka jan mak'aryaci ne,  babu wanda ya kaisa k'arya duk duniya, boka baya baka komai saidai ya kaika ga tab'ewa da kuma halaka..  .


Har k'ark'ashin bishiyar sukak'araso,  ta shiga tuno zuwansu wajen da Laure,  sabon tashin hankali ya ziyarci Mamy...  K'unshe bakinta tayi tana hawaye tana ji inama hannun agogo zai koma baya da bata aikata abubuwan da ta aikata ba... 

Wata mota ce tayi parking daga can gefe dasu,  Su Malam D'ayyabu da Alaramma Mukhtari suka fito daga cikin motar suka k'araso gasu Daddy...  Nan suka buk'aci su Daddy su matsa daga k'ark'ashin bishiyar...  Abin sallah suka shimfid'a daga can gefe suka zauna suka soma karanto addu'o'in karya sihiri da asiri kaman yanda sunnah ya karantar...  Can suka hangi wani kusufi k'asar bishiyar daga gefe yana hayak'i sosai... Jikin Mamy ya shiga karkarwa..  lokaci guda ta runtse idanunta hawaye na gangaro mata don tuni komai ya shiga dawowa sabo a kwanyarta... 

K'arasawa sukayi wajen suka kuma karanto addu'o'i had'i da basmala da koran duk wasu shaid'anu dake wajen suka soma tonon dai-dai wajen... 

Daddy kam hawayene kurum ke zuba daga idanunsa sanda aka ciro k'ullin....  Shareefah da Affan zukatansu ya kuma girgiza,  tsoron Duniya ya kuma cikasu... 


Mamy kam koda zata zama gurguwar bata damu ba muddin Daddy zai sami lafiya... 

Su Malam D'ayyabu suna warware wannan k'ulli hayak'i ya soma tsartsafowa daga k'afafun Daddy....  Addu'o'i suka kuma yi suna tofawa Daddy a k'afafun sa lokaci guda Alh Ali Safwan yaji k'afafunsa sun soma motsawa...  Bismillah yayi sanda yaji k'arfi ya ziyarci k'afafun nasa...  

Gaba d'aya suka bisa da kallo sanda sukaga yana mik'ewa daga wheelchair d'insa. 

****

Jigum Innah ta zauna gaban shirgin wanke wanken gidan karuwan wanda idan batayisu ba toh kuwa tabbas batada abinci...  Tana nan tsugune gaban lodin wanke wanken taji Shazali d'an daudu ya fito yana shewa yana tafe hannaye yana fad'in "Wllhi an kuma,  an kuma Satan sigarin oga Aska.. Cahpp ayyye b'arauniya bataji dad'i ba wllhi wllhi Oga Aska kar ka yarda wannan karan babu sassauci ehe..."  Ya k'arashe yana gyara d'aurin kwali had'i da tafe hannaye da cinya uwa mace... 

Aiko Oga Aska ne ya fito yayi kan Innah a d'ari.. Ta zabura zata gudu ya sharb'ota sai cikin kwanukan wanke wanke...  


'Yar k'aramar Aska ya ciro a gefen wandonsa ya shiga wasata jikin garu gashi ya danne Innah babu halin gudu... 

Innah murya na rawa take fad'in "Wllhi ban sata ba,  wllhI sharri ne dan Allah kaji k'aina... Wai mai zakamin ne kake wasa aska.. 


Dariya ya bushe dashi kana yace "Bakiji sunana ba Oga Aska,  kimin wancan karan na maki uzuri ban maki tsattsauran hukunci ba toh yau zakisan dalilin kirana Aska da akeyi a gidan nan..  "Ke Shazali zo ki d'aga mini bujenta..."


Shazali ya k'araso yana k'wark'wasa yake fad'in "'yar uwa sai hak'uri abinda ake wa yara maza shi za'a maki yau da tsufarki..."


Innah gabanta yayi wani irin bugawa ta shiga kururwa sanda ta fahimci mai ake shirin mata

Innah bata fasa kururwa ba tana neman agaji da d'auki, kuka take shar-shar da hawaye tana fad'in "Oga ka min rai na tuba na tuba wllhi.. Ko kallon sigari bazan kumayi ba balle na sata,  dan Allah kamin rai wllhi ni uwar wasu ce...."  Ta k'arashe sabbin hawaye na kwararo mata....  

Dariya Shazali ya kwashe dashi gashi yak'i sakin Innah sai kakkauda kai gefe yake shi a dole kunya yakeji,  yana gyara d'aurin k'irji had'i da kame hab'a yake fad'in "Oh ni Shazali abin kunya dai bai k'arewa a gidan nan...  Kaga Oga i hak'uri ka k'yaleta kasan mu mata rauni garemu....."

Bai kai aya ba Aska ya daka masa tsawa da fad'in "Nace ka rik'e min ita,  gobe ko ajiye mata sigari akayi tsakankanin yatsunta saidai ta tsallake...."  Ya k'arashe yana k'ok'arin had'e bakin askan sa....  Innah ta danna ihu ganin da gaske wannan tantirin yaro ba afuwa zai mata ba....  Cizon data gantsarawa Shazali ne ya sanyasa sakinta a d'ari ya mik'e yana kame yatsar sa da Innah tayi kusan gutsirewa....  Tuni Innah ta arce ta nufi waje... A dai-dai k'ofa suka kusan yin karo da Uwar daba... 

"Yaya haka Chuss waye ya biyoki haka ko 'yan hisba ne suka zo kame....?"

Haki Innah take tana duban Uwar daba dai-dai sanda Aska ya k'araso wajen a d'ari... Innah ta kuma mik'ewa zata arta Uwar daba ta tarota... 

Aska na huci yake fad'in "Wllhi Uwar daba ki daina shigar ma wannan 'yar iskar fad'a don takaini bango,  babu hali na ijiye sigarina sai ta sata..."

Tafe hannaye Uwar daba ta shiga yi ga d'aurin kallabinta saman goshi wanda hausawa ke cema ture Kaga tsiya... 

"Ni wllhi Chuss da Aska kunfa isheni a gidan nan... Masifar ku ta isheni.... Ke wace irin bak'ar mayya ce da bazakiyi zuciya ki daina masa sata ba.. Inyi haba.. Wllhi gaba d'ayanku zan sa Gundumi ya maku hukunci tam....  Ni na gaji da masifarku...."

"Amma ai itace take fara janyowa,  wllhi kika kuma min sata kinji na rantse sai kinsha Aska shegiya tsohuwar banza...."  Ya k'arashe yana maida askar sa gefen aljihu... 

Uwar Daba ta rakasa da harara har ya fice kafin ta dawo da dubanta ga Innah wacce ke lab'e bayanta tana faman muzurai kana tace "Toh ke kuma kina jina... Wllhi Aska baida mutunci matan da suka d'and'ani azaban askar sa a gidan nan ba kad'an ba... Inai maki gargad'i kar ki zamto d'aya daga cikinsu tam...  Wuce kije kimin wanke-wanke ko kiyi niyyan azumin da babu lada,  kinsan dokata ba'aci a bulus...."  Daga Uwar Daba shigewa tayi tana taunar chewing gum.. 

Shazali kuwa har lokacin bai daina rawan zafin cizon da Innah ta gantsara masa ba... 

****


A tare Shareefah da Affan suka k'araso suka rungume Daddy su duka suna hawaye.... 

Mamy ma hawaye ne kurum ke fitowa daga idanunta,  tana son rungumar mijinta saidai bazata iya hakan ba... Kunya abinda tayima bazai barta ta tink'ari mijinta ba... A hankali ta sadda kanta k'asa.... 

Daddy ya k'arasa wajensu Malam D'ayyabu yana kuma masu godiya,  Malam yace ai babu komai wanda duk ya taimaki wani shima Allah zai taimaka masa ta hanyar da baiyi zato ba balle tsammani.... Affan ma k'arasowa yayi yanai masu godiya had'i da tambayarsu ladan aikin su....  Malam yace bazasu amshi ko kabo ba sabida tsakaninsu da Alh Ali ya wuce haka,  badon kariyan arziki da ya same sa ba kowa yasan kalan kyautatawa da hidima ma addini da Alh Ali Safwan keyiwa musulunci a lokacin da yake dashi.. Su kyauta sukayi wannan aiki basu buk'atar a biyasu... Babu yanda Affan baiyi ba ko kud'in man mota ne su amsa su k'ara amma fir sunk'i...  Haka dole ya hak'ura suka d'unguma suka nufo garin Bauchi... 

Sanda suka shigo gari Daddy ya dubi Affan kana yace dashi gidan marigayi Sa'oud Santana suka nufa...  Affan ya jinjina kai don shima yana tsananin son zuwa gidan ko badon komai ba sai don yayi tozali da sanyin idaniyarsa Ilham...  

Mamy kam jigum tayi a motar yayinda jikin Shareefah yayi sanyi sanda taji gidansu Naseer suka nufa, cire soyayyan Naseer a zuciyarta abu ne mai matuk'ar wuya dukda tasan Naseer d'in baya k'aunarta,  insha Allah zatayi k'ok'arin daidaita nutsuwarta koda taga Naseer da matar sa don alk'awari ta d'aukar ma kanta ta shiryu kenan da izinin Allah na har abada, babu ruwanta da mugunta da hassada ma wani,  idan Allah ya k'addari Naseer mijinta ne zasu kasance tare,  idan kuma ya k'addara ba mijinta bane shikenan Allah ya canza mata da wanda yafisa alkhairi,  wanda zai k'aunaceta for who she is.... Tana ida wannnan tunani taji zuciyarta ta cika da nishad'i ba tareda sanin dalili ba. Lokaci guda ta saki murmushi had'i da kwantar da kanta saman kafad'an Mamy... 

Kallonta Mamy tayi ta lura da guntun murmushi dake saman fuskar Shareefar,  ta kuma kai dubanta ga fuskar Affan dake cikin mirror shid'in ma guntun murmushi ne saman fuskar sa... Family d'inta sun soma dawo da farin cikin da suka rasa A DUNIYAR SU...  Fatan ta Allah yasa hakan ya d'ore... Lokaci guda Azeema ta fad'o ranta,  cikin zuciyarta take furta Allah ya dawo mana dake Azeema,  Allah ya kub'utar mana dake, idan kika dawo our family will be whole again...  Allah bayyanaki daughter..."  Ta k'arashe murmushi saman fuskarta lokaci guda tasa hannu tana shafan kan Shareefah dake kwance saman kafad'arta...  Rabon Mamy da samun kwanciyar hankali irinta yau tun kafin Laure ta shigo rayuwarta,  tabbas ta yarda bijirema Allah da sab'a masa baya haifar da komai sai k'unci da takaicin rayuwa,  gashi yanzu data tuba ta mik'a wuya ga mahallicinta DUNIYAR MU tai mata sanyi, ta kuma yarda babu abinda yakai MUGUWAR K'AWA sharri a rayuwa,  tabbas ABOKAI suna taka babban rawa a rayuwar d'an Adam,  yi k'ok'ari ka kasance da abokai na gari A DUNIYAR MU domin shuka alkhairi.... 

***

Dukkansu suna tsaitsaye a haraban gidan sunyo rakiyawa su Abbu zasu wuce.... Salma sai k'ok'arin k'watan hannunta take cikin na Naseer shiko yak'i saki,  idanma yaji zata zille sai ya kuma damk'e hannun had'i d'an sosa mata cikin tafin hannu,  gashi yak'i su had'a idanu sai maganan sa yake wato ma irin ba kulatan nan zaiyi ba...  Shiko kunyar su Abbu baiji,  ga su Momy ga kowa a wajen...

"Abbu idan kuka dawo nan d'in gaba d'aya zaifi,  Aunty Saudat ma sai tafi jin dad'i,  abubuwa da dama sun faru,  Abbu munfi son zamanku a nan idan son samu...."  Ya k'arashe murya cikeda kulawa.. 

Aunty Saudat ce ta jinjina kai kana tace "Gaskiya ne Abby munfi son zamanku a nan,  kaga Naseer ba mazauni bane sannan Fawaz ya dage zai koma k'aro karatu,  idan akwai namiji babba a gidan gida bazai mutu ba..."

Momy ce ta tari zancen da fad'in "Wannan gaskiya ne Saudat,  kuma nima gashi har mun fara sabo da Mama Kaltume kuma ace zata koma Bamaco toh lallai kuwa nima zan koma can barikin mu..."  Ta k'arashe tana kuma rik'o Ilham dake tsaye d'an gefenta... 

Aunty Saudat ta dubi Abbu kana ta d'an lank'wasar da kai tace "Abby kaji koh kowa watsewa zaiyi ya barmu....."

Naseer ya k'arada "Nima kuwa na tattara mata ta mu tafi ba sai ku zamto ku kad'ai..."

Gaba d'aya suka d'an dara yayinda Salma ke k'ok'arin mintsilin hannun Naseer.... 

Gyaran murya Abbu ya d'anyi had'i da satan kallon Momy kafin ya saita kansa don shima dolece kawai zatasa sa barin Nigeria bayan ya kuma ganin gida a Nigeria.... 

"Naji buk'atun ku,  kuma insha Allah zanyi tunani akai,  ni kaina bana so na kuma yin nesa da d'iyata , toh amma kunga yanayin zuwan da mukayi da kuma yanda abubuwa suka koma...  Idan Kaltume ta amince mu zauna a Nigeria zamu zauna,  idan kuma bata amince ba saidai mu dinga kawo ziyara,  don alk'awari nayiwa mahaifinta zan rik'eta har bayan ransa bisa gaskiya da rik'on amana...."

Abbu yana kaiwa aya suka jiyo muryar Mama Kaltum dake k'ok'arin k'arasowa wajen tana fad'in "Ai nan shine family d'inka suke,  kuma nima zanso zaman mu a nan idan ka tambayi shawarina...  Babu komai duk lokacin da ka yanke mu komo Nigeria zaka sameni ina mai maka biyayya sabida aure babu yanda baya kai mutum...."  Ta k'arashe murmushi saman fuskar ta... 

Murmushin shima Abbu yake don yasan matarshi Mace ce mai tsananin biyayya... lokaci guda ya k'arasa ya rik'o hannunta kafin yace "Allah yayi maki albarka.."  Gaba d'aya annuri ya cika fuskokin su... 

K'aran bud'e gate da suka jiyo ne yasasu maida hankulansu can... 

Naseer ya gane motar Daddy Ali Safwan ne.... Saidai yaga kaman mutane ne cike a motar daga gidan gaba har gidan baya....  

Daga chan gefen k'aton roundabout dake tsakiyar gidan Affan yayi parking...  Suna kallo Affan d'in ya fito ya zagayo mazaunin mai zaman banza ya bud'ewa mahaifinsa,  lokaci guda Mamy da Shareefah suka bud'e gidan baya suka fito.... 

Mamaki bai gama cika su Naseer ba saida suka hangi Daddy na takowa da k'afafun sa....  Naseer kam tsaban farin ciki bai san sanda ya soma takawa a hankali ba har ya isa gaban Daddy... Murmushin dake fuskar Daddy da Naseer ya kasa gushewa... 

Cikin wani irin murya Naseer yake fad'in "Daddy da gaske kaine mai tafiya... Daddy da gaske kaine tsaye a gabana....."

Murmushi Daddy kawai yake kafin ya shiga jinjina ma Naseer kai yace "Ni ne Naseer,  Allah ya kuma dawo min da k'afafuna,  ina da rabon kuma takawa A DUNIYAR MU Naseer,  Allah abin godiya ne....."

Tun kan yayi shiru Naseer yayi saurin rungume sa wani sabon farin ciki ya kuma ziyartar sa A DUNIYAR SU,  Allah sarki haka nan Allah ke lamuransa,  lokaci guda sai ya sauk'ak'a maku duk wani tsanani da kuke ciki bayan k'unci... 

Farin ciki wajen su Salma ma ba'a magana kowa yayi farin ciki ganin k'afafun Daddy suna kuma takawa.... Shareefah da Mamy sai san-san da kai suke, harda rungumar su Salma dasu Jamila,  kana ganinsu dai kasan nadama ta shigesu.... 

Gaba d'aya suka d'unguma da niyyan komawa cikin gidan hardasu Abbu masu shirin tafiya,  don ya kamata ayi introducing juna.... 

Affan da tuntuni idanunsa nakan 'yar makauniyar sa saurin k'arasowa kusanta yayi had'i da rik'o sandar ta bayan ya fakaici idanun jama'an dake wajen.... 

Murmushi kawai Ilham tayi don tasan waye.... 

"Ya Affan...!" Ta fad'i tana juya dara-daran idanunta da suke fari k'al masu kyaun gaske... 

Affan mutuwar tsaye yayi yana duban idanunta kafin yace "Beautiful ya akayi kika gane ni ne....?"

Murmushi ta d'an kuma yi kana tace "Kawai na gane ne....."

Murmushin shima yayi mai bayyana hak'wara kana yace "Nayi kewarki Beautiful...."

Ilham tayi saurin rufe fuskarta da tafukan hannayenta jin har wani sabon suna Yayan nata ya saka mata kana tace "Ya Affan nifa ba Beautiful bace...."

Affan ya kafe ta da idanu kana yace "Toh idan ke ba beautiful ba ke mecece...?"

D'an dariya tayi a tak'aice kana tace "Ni Ilham ce....."

Affan ma ya murmusa kana yace "A beautiful girl with beautiful name,  gaskiya ni a jona sunana jikin naki ko nima zanyi kyau... Bari muga *AffaNilham* wow ya kikaji bai maki dad'i ba...."

Wannan karan dariya sosai tayi kana tace "Kai Ya Affan...  Mu k'arasa ciki kar aga bamu nan..."

Kallonta kurum yake yanajin tsantsan soyayyarta kafin yasa hannu ya rik'o sandarta suka nufi cikin tapkeken parlorn.... 

Gaba d'aya idanu ya komo kansu,  Mamy da Daddy da mamaki suke duban Affan, basu tab'a kawo hakan ba,  ko ba'a fad'a masu ba Affan son Ilham yake, su Naseer kam sun san kwanan zancen.... 

Ilham kam dukda ba gani take ba sai taji kunya sosai,  Mamy ce ta k'arasa ta amshi sandar nata daga hannun Affan d'in tana mai taimaka wa Ilham d'in... 

Affan murya can k'asa ya fakaici idanun mutanen dake wajen kana yace "Mamy be careful kar ta fad'i...."  Hararan wasa Mamy ta galla masa kafin suka jiyo sautin dariyan mutanen dake parlorn alamun an jiyosu... 

Dariya Mamy ma tayi kafin ta kuma rungumo Ilham tace "Muje kinji Daughter..."

Ilham kam kunya kaman ta nitse cikin k'asa, Mamy bata ma bari Ilham ta zauna saman carpet ba yanda 'yan matan ke zaune gaba d'aya,  gefenta ta zaunar da ita.... 

Bayan an gaggaisa da juna had'i da jajanta ma juna abubuwan da sukayita faruwa a 'yan kwanakin ciki harda k'one  gidan gonar  Alh Ali da Kabeer yayi....  Su Mamy sukayita mamakin lamarin, duniya ta kuma basu tsoro....  Daddy cewa yayi babu komai, komai ya wuce haka Allah ya k'addara...

Jigum Jamila tayi tana tuna irin illan da Alh Kabeer yayi wa rayuwarta, shine silan komai tunda shine ya k'one gidan gonar Daddy har suka shiga cikin tashin hankali maras misaltuwa,  shine silan tsintar kanta da tayi a wannan yanayi da take ciki.....  She will never ever forgive him for all the damages he caused her.... 

Su Daddy sun d'an jima sosai kafin sukai masu sallama suna shirin tafiya,  nan Mamy ta buk'aci saidai su Ilham su bisu,  ko d'an kwana biyu su masu...  Jamila kam tafi son hakan don ko babu komai zata daina ganin Fawaz... 

Momy dai bataso ba don zatayi kewarsu,  runawa da tayi akwai Lubna yasa hankalinta ya d'an kwanta.... Salma ta d'an dubi Momy sanda 'yan mazan suka soma ficewa kana ta marairaice fuska tace "Momy nima binsu zanyi..."

Naseer dake k'ok'arin ficewa saida ya d'an juyo ya kuma dubanta...

Kafin Momy takai ga bata amsa Mamy ta d'an dafata tace "A'a Salma kekam ai matar aure ce, bazakije ko inaba saida izinin mijinki kinji koh... Sannan ba jimawa zasuyi ba kwana d'an biyu kawai zasuyi su dawo kinji,  ki kwantar da hankalin ki...."

Salma ta jinjina mata kai a hankali,  Shiko Naseer sai sannan ya sauk'e wara nannauyan ajiyan zuciya kafin ya take wasu Daddy baya... 

Jikin Shareefah ya kuma yin sanyi ganin ko kallo bata ishi Naseer ba,  ta yarda ta amincewa ranta Naseer ba nata bane,  cireshi gaba d'aya a zuciyarta shi yafi mata sauk'i ta nutsu ta nema ma kanta lafiya da jinyar dake jikinta

Har suka isa gida Daddy bai daina hango fuskar matar nan a idanunsa ba...  D'an ware idanunsa yayi had'i da mutstsuka su kana ya fuzar da iska yana mai furta "Aliyu what's wrong with you,  meke damun ka...?"  Kasa nemo ma kansa amsa da yayi ya sanyasa mik'ewa yana d'an taka k'afafun nasa da yake ji yau tamkar ba nasa ba,  lallai Allah abin godiya ne,  kuma ya yarda da wannan magana Bawa kar ya d'ebe tsammani daga rahamar ubangijin sa... 

Yana nan tsaye jikin window yana kuma hango fuskar nata yaji muryar Mamy tana sallama... 

Juyowa yayi yana dubanta gaba d'aya ta canza kaman ba Asma'unsa da ya sani ba har wani sabon hankali ne ya shigeta,  lokaci guda Daddy ya d'an tsuke fuska had'i da amsa mata sallaman nata, lokaci guda ya k'araso ya zauna saman chaise lounge 

Mamy kai a k'asa ta k'arasa shigowa d'akin to his greatest surprise zama Mamy tayi saman tapkeken carpet dake malale a d'akin....  Maimakon tayi magana sai kuka ya kufce mata.. 

Kasa tab'uka komai Daddy sai kariya da zuciyarsa tayi,  sam bai k'aunar ganin mace cikin tashin hankali,  dukda yasan sunyi soyayya irinta k'uruciya shida Asma'u a halin yanzu bai isa yace ga abinda yakeji gameda ita ba.... 

Sallaman da Affan yayi ne ya sanya Mamy k'ok'arin had'iye kukanta yayinda Daddy ya d'an shafi kwantattun sumarsa wanda furfura ya k'ara masu kyau....

Affan sai ya d'an sha jinin jikinsa sam bai zaci zai sami mahaifiyar tasa a d'akin mahaifin nasa ba shiyasa bai tsaya neman izini ba sllama kawai yayi ya turo k'ofar,  koda yake tsaban zumud'in abinda zai sanar da Daddyn ne shiyasa... 


D'an sadda kai Affan yayi kana yace "Em I'm sorry Daddy...."

Kallonsa Daddy yayi fuska cikeda murmushi kana yace "Come here,  shigo abinka...."

Mamy tayi saurin goge hawayenta tana k'ok'arin mik'ewa Affan yace "Mamy pls kema ki zauna dama maganar keda Daddy ya kamata nai maku...."

Mamy tayi k'ok'arin saita kanta had'i da k'ak'aro murmushi kafin ta k'arasa can bakin gado ta d'an zauna tamkar wacce za'a zabureta.... 

Affan na daga can saman carpet gefen k'afafun Daddy ya soma sanar da iyayen nasa buk'atar sa kan maganar asibitin Ilham... 

Gaba d'aya sunji dad'i dama shima Daddy da abin a ransa, gaba d'aya suka tsaida maganar a fara duba likita a nan teaching hospital kafin aji yanda ciwon ya samo asali da kuma yanda lamarin zata kaya... 

***

Sallama yayi a k'ofar d'akin Momy, ta amsa masa da sakin fuska lokacin ta ida sallan isha kenan, shima dawowar sa daga masallaci kenan... Can saman stool ya samu ya zauna yana mai gaida Momyn,  tsaf ta lura dashi magana ne a bakin sa...  Linke abin sallanta tayi kafin ta juyo sosai tana dubansa tace "Soja yaya dai akwai wani abin ne....?"

Naseer ya d'an shafi kansa kana yace "Momy dama so nake na d'an tafi can base d'inmu nayi kwana biyu,  aiki ya taru kuma tun jiya suke min waya suna nema na... So inaso na d'an lek'a ko kwana biyu ne sai nayi...."

Momy ta jinjina kai kana tace "Haka ne gaskiya kam ya kamata ka lek'a,  zaku tafi tareda Salmar ce....?"  Ta tambaya tana mai d'aukan casbahan ta saman drawer... 

Kaman wanda yake jira cikin sauri ya shiga jinjina kai kana yace "Eh da son samu Momy..."

Murmusawa Momy tayi kana tace "Ai sai ta shirya ku tafi,  tana bayi tana alwala bari ta fito sai na sanar da ita koh..."

Naseer ya jinjina kai kana yace "Toh Momy barinje nima na d'an shirya..."  Daga haka mik'ewa yayi ya nufi k'ofa.. 

Yana gab da ficewa daga d'akin Salma ta turo k'ofar bathroom ta fito....

Kallo ya bita dashi daga sama har k'asa tana sanye da doguwar riga mai laushi wanda ya kwanta sosai a jikinta kanta babu d'an kwali manyan kalaba da tayi sun d'an sassauk'a zuwa kafad'unta, ga ga sumar goshinta ruwan alola ya kwantar dasu sosai... Murmushi ya sakar mata itako gabanta ne yayi wani irin fad'uwa,  cikin sauri ta d'an maida masa martanin murmushin kafin ta sadda kanta k'asa ta shige...  Naseer ya shige zuciyar sa nai masa wani irin sanyi...

Sauraren Momy kurum take ba tareda ta motsa daga saman sallayar ba... Ita kad'ai ta lula duniyar tunanin da bata isa tace ga tak'amaimen abinda take tunani ba... 

Momy ta ida zuba mata kayan cikin k'aramar jaka kana tayi zipping jakar lokaci guda ta maido da dubanta ga Salma... 

"Kin idar da sallan ne...?"

Momy ta tambaya tana mai dubanta.. 

A hankali ta jinjina mata kai ba tareda tace komai ba,  bata san meke shirin faruwa da ita ba amma kam tinda Momy tace ta shirya zasu tafi da Soja take jin matsanancin fad'uwar gaba... 

K'arasowa Momy tayi ta zauna daga gefen Salmar kafin ta kamo hannayenta ta shiga jero mata nasiha wanda ya danganci rayuwar aure,  kama daga hak'uri wanda shine jigo, ladabi da biyayya ga miji sannan uwa uba tsabtar jiki da muhalli had'i da girki....  

Salma dai kanta na k'asa gaba d'aya ta kasa d'ago idanu ta dubi Momyn,  wani nauyi da kunyar Momy ne taji ya dabaibayeta lokaci guda, ga sanyi da jikinta yayi tunanin mahaifanta ya shiga ratsa ko wani k'ofa na zuciyarta...  A hankali ta shiga gyad'a wa Momy kai tana share d'an guntun hawayen da ya kwararo mata... 

Momy ta d'an murmusa had'i da d'ago fuskar Salmar kana tace "A'a daughter banson ganin hawayen nan,  besides sati d'an d'aya zuwa biyu jal zakuyi a can,  kuma Naseer yace  min ya sayo maki waya, ya jonata caji ne,  kinga zamuke waya kuma idan kina so da kaina ma zanje..."

Baki a d'an ture tace "Amma Momy Soja ai sai ya sanar dani da wuri fisabilillahi kofa shiryawa banyi ba...."

Maganar taso bawa Momy dariya amma ta d'an gimtse tace "Bakiji abinda Mamy ta fad'a maki ba d'azun ko..?  Kuma banda abinki ai shima ba cewa yayi zaku zauna a can ba,  aiki zai je shi kuma ma gari d'aya fah muke,  haba Salma zamanin fah kai ya waye ba'a gudun miji kinji koh...."

D'an jim Salma tayi had'i da jinjina kanta kana tace "Naji Momy...."

Jinjina kai Momy tayi kana tace "Maza tashi ki shirya yanzu shima zai fito...."

Bata jira cewar Salmar ba ta mik'e ta isa ga drawer dake gefen bedside ta ciro wani turare mai k'amshin gaske ta saka mata cikin jakar nata...  Salma dai sai kallo take faman bin Momy dashi yanda taketa shiryata lokaci guda tanai mata bayanai masu buk'atan nutsuwa...  Tamkar uwa da d'iya haka Momy ta kintsa Salma tas,  harda kwalliya ta sanyata yi sannan ta umarceta da yawaita zama da kwalliya a tattareda ita musamman lokutan data kasance tareda mijinta domin ita mace 'yar kwalliya ce haka Allah ya halicceta... 

Sosai Salma tayi kyau cikin wata doguwar riga yadin material mai taushi da kyau wanda yake kalan shud'i da toka, tupke kitsonta tayi tsakiyar kanta kana ta yane kan nata da yalwateccen mayafi ruwan toka, duban kanta ta kuma yi jikin mirror tayi kyau sosai har ta gaji,  ga wani ni'imtaceccen k'amshi dake tashi jikinta...  Tana nan tsaye a wajen tana k'ok'arin nad'e mayafin akanta ta hangi fuskar sa cikin mirror d'in..   Gabanta ya kuma yankewa ya fad'i saikace yau ta soma saninsa... Bata sami zarafin juyowa ba saidai ta kasa d'auke idanunta daga duban nasa,  Yana sanye da black long sleeve shirt, gaban rigar an rubuta _ROY_ d'an gefe kad'an kuma tambarin shararriyar kampanin ne wato Adidas,  ba sai ance maka rigar designer bace... Sosai rigar ta fito da asalin suffar jikin sa da kuma hasken fatar sa,.... A hankali take k'ok'arin d'ago idanu har ta kawo ga fuskar sa wanda ya cika da murmushi....   Cikin sauri ta sadda nata kan k'asa... 

Cikin takunsa mai cikeda charisma yake k'arasowa cikin d'akin... 

Har gaban dressing mirror d'in ya isa ya yanda ya tsaya ta bayanta fuskokinsu suka bayyana cikin madubin...  Hannu yasa ya amshi mayafin nata ya shiga rufa mata akanta dukda ba wai ya iya bane.... 

Yanda ya cukwikuye mata mayafin akan nata abun sai ya basu dariya gaba d'aya.. 

Kallonta yake sosai yanda take dariya abin burgewa kana ya d'an sauk'o da bakinsa saitin kunnenta yayi mata magana cikin muryar da tafi kama da rad'a

"Meyasaki dariya...?  Ko ban iya bane....?"

Fuska d'auke da murmushi ta shiga girgiza masa kai ba tareda ta amsa sa ba... 

Naseer yasa hannayen sa ya manneta cikin jikinsa wanda ya jefasu cikin wani yanayi maras fasaltuwa su duka biyun kana yace "Kar ki damu zan koya duk irin wad'annan abubuwan sabida na dinga maki su,  gaba d'aya harda k'unshi da kitso...."

Nan ma tak'aitaccen dariya Salma tayi kana tace "Kai Soja kitso da k'unshi saikace mace..."

"Kina mamaki koh,  bari ki gani sai na soma maki su ki yarda zan iya...  For my queen babu abinda bazan koya ba...."  Ya k'arashe yana d'aura hab'arsa saman kafad'anta... 

Kallon juna suke cikin dressing mirror d'in kafin ta sinkayo muryarsa yana fad'in "Are you ready.... Shall we go....?"

Batakai ga basa amsa ba suka jiyo sallaman Momy..... Lokaci guda Naseer ya d'an saketa ya matsa gefe yana wani shasshafa kai.... 

Salma kuwa gaba d'aya kunya ce ta dabaibayeta, cikin sauri ta shiga kwance d'aurin mayafin da Naseer ya cukuikuya mata tana mai gyarawa... 

"Soja an fito...?"  Momy ta tambaya sanda take shigowa cikin d'akin... 

"Eh Momy zamu wuce yanzu insha Allah...."

"Toh Allah shi tsare ya taimaka..."

"Ameen Momy... " Ya amsa sanda yake d'aukan jakan kayan Salma... 

Momy taci gaba da fad'in "Yanzu Saudat ke fad'a min sunyi waya dasu Abbu sun isa Kano zuwa dare jirgin su zai tashi,  yace ya kira wayarka bai samu ba...."

"Allah sarki, Allah sauk'esu lafiya,  zuwa safiya zan kirasu insha Allah...."

Momy ta amsa da ameen kafin ta k'arasa ga Salma dake ciro takalmi cikin shoe rack.... 

Naseer ya fice yana fad'in bari yayima su Aunty Saudat sallama... 

Momy kam wajen d'iyarta Salma ta k'arasa suna kuma yin tasu sallamar.... 

*****

Gaba d'aya sai gidan ya kuma masu shiru.... Babu su Jamila su Mama Kaltume sun tafi ga kuma su Salma ma sun tafi,  gidan ya rage daga Momy sai Aunty Saudat sai ko Lubna wacce itama exams ke gabanta.... 


Saida suka biya wani Mini Mart suka d'anyi window shopping kayan da zasu buk'ata kafin suka d'auki hanyar barikin nasu.... 

Tun daga gate Soji ke k'ame masa suna kwasan gaisuwa har suka shiga cikin barikin.... 

Gidan babu wani dattin d'aga hankali saiko d'an k'ura da yayi... Salma kam tuni ta shiga tattare ko ina tana gyarawa don taji sanda Naseer ya fice yana waya bayan ya ida shigar masu da kayayyakin su..... 

Bayan ta ida wanke bathroom ne ta d'aga idanu tana duban agogo bango dake mak'ale a d'akin ya nuna k'arfe tara saura wasu dak'ik'ai....  Sai hamma take alamun barci gashi gaba d'aya ta jik'e rigarta wajen wankin toilet d'in gaba d'aya rigar ta kuma bin jikinta ta kwanta...

Cak ta tsaya ta kasa ci gaba da tafiyar da take...

Murya can k'asa tace "Wanke bathroom d'in nayi..."  Yanda tayi maganar cikeda ladabi ko d'ago idanu batayi ta dubesa ba... 

'Yan yatsunta yake murzawa a hankali kana yace "Naga kinsha aiki ke kad'ai,  da kin jirani nazo mukayi tare..."

Gyad'a masa kai tayi ba tareda ta d'ago fuska ba... 

Murmushi yayi mai cikeda nuna farin ciki kana yace "Allah yayi maki albarka...."

Fuskarta naga gaban rigarsa yanda aka rubuta kalmar _Roy_ ta amsa da "Ameen Roy...."

Kallonta yayi sosai yaga yanda ta samo kalmar nata kafin yace "What did you say....?"

Girgiza kai ta shiga yi cikin sauri kana tace "Nifa bance komai ba Soja...."

Murmushi tayi kana tace "A gaban rigarka na gani...."

"Kinsan me kalmar ke nufi...?"  Ya tambaya still yatsunta cikin nasa...

Shima d'in dariya ya d'anyi kana yace" Gashi kuwa kin fad'i...  Kar ki damu kin fad'i a dai-dai don nasan ni ne basaraken birnin zuciyarki....."

Hannaye tasa had'i da rufe fuskarta tana mai murmusawa.... 

"Oya tashi ki canza wannan kayan kar kiyi mura...."  Ya fad'i yana k'ok'arin zuge mata zip d'in... 

Zaro idanu waje tayi had'i da rik'e hannayen sa kana tace "Zan.... Zan iya Soja...."

"But I insist..."  Ya fad'i yana dubanta da idanun sa masu narkar da ita... 

Baiko jira cewarta ba ya janyota cikin jikinsa yana mai ci gaba da zuge zip d'in.... 

Kuka ta soma masa tana fad'in ita dai zata iya...

Kai tsaye ta basa amsa da "toilet...."

Naseer ya d'an had'e gira kana yace "Ai kuma baki isa ba,  ki k'i yarda na canza maki sannan kice toilet zaki gudu ki canza,  saidai kuma idan zan biki na maki wanka d'iyanin...."

Zaro idanuwa tayi gaba d'aya kana tace "Tabb wanka fah kace Soja,  saikace wata baby..."

Sadda idanunta k'asa tayi hannunta rik'e da rigarta..

"Reina nasan kinsan me aure yake nufi, kin kuma san matsayin mijinki a wajen ki,  kinsan yanda hakki akanki sannan kema kinada hakki akansa.... So idan da abubuwan da zan k'ara maki akan was'anda kika sani k'alilan ne....  Ki canza kayan sai ki sameni a parlor mu k'arasa maganar koh...."

Bata iya amsa sa ba sai jinjina masa kai da tayi har lokacin idanunta na k'asa.. 

Tana jin sanda ya mik'e tsaye had'i da manna mata peck a kumatun ta kafin ya nufi parlor,  har saida ya fice kafin ta sauk'e nannauyan ajiyan zuciya

Gaba d'aya suke zaune a parlorn suna kallon film d'in Avengers infinity idan ka d'auke Jamila dake kwance a d'aki,  duk yanda tayi ta kasa yakishe tunanin a ranta.... Shareefah ce ta shigo d'akin tana amsa wayar Likitan ta Dr Siraj, tunda ta shigo d'akin take jiyo sauti a hankali daga cikin bathroom d'in kaman na kuka...

A hankali Shareefah ta mik'e ta d'an isa jikin k'ofar bathroom d'in...  Shiru tayi tana kuma tabbatar da abinda kunnuwanta ke sauraro mata,  tabbas kuka ne.....  Ta tuna Jamila kawai suka baro a d'akin kafin su fice parlor...

Shareefah har ta cire rai bazata amsa ta ba sai kuma taji ana k'ok'arin bud'e k'ofar bayin... 

Kallo Shareefah ta bita dashi yanda gaba d'aya kana ganinta kasan she's not normal.... 

K'ak'aro murmushi Shareefah tayi ta sakar mata kana tace "is all well...?"

"Ina Falaq....?"   Jamila ta tambaya ba tareda ta dubi Shareefah ba... 

"Tana wajen Mamy,  inaga ma ta goyata tayi barci....  Meyasa kike zaune ke kad'ai a d'aki bayan duk muna parlor gaba d'aya, Jamila we've been through a lot, munga jarabawa iri da kala A DUNIYAR MU amma hakan ba yana nufin shikenan bazamu ci gaba da rayuwarmu bane,  hak'uri da karb'an k'addara a duk yanda tazo maka shine ribar rayuwar duniya... Kar mu kasance masu fushi ga hukuncin ubangijin mu kinji,  dan Allah kiyi hak'uri ki rage shiga damuwa irin haka, idan ke a matsayinki na babba kina haka yaya kike tunanin Ilham zatayi,  koda ace bata ganin ki na tabbata tana jin abin cikin zuciyarta.... Please kiyi hak'uri mu amshi k'addarar mu...."


Izuwa lokacin hawaye sun soma zarya a fuskar Jamila,  kallon Shareefah tayi kana tace "Shareefah gwara damuwar kowa akan nawa,  gwara tashin hankalin kowa akan nawa..."

Shareefah bata bari taci gaba da magana ba ta katse ta da fad'in "Don't talk like that Jamila, nida ke makamancin k'addara iri guda ya auka mana....."

Jamila dake faman murmushi wanda yafi kama da murmushin takaici bata bari Shareefah ta ida maganar ba tace "Shareefah kenan,  bana fata iftila'in da ya auka min A DUNIYAR MU ya kuma samun wata 'yar uwata musulma,  Shareefah sam ba k'uncin rasa Fawaz da nayi ne ya addabeni ba,  a'a...  Kunci na da damuwata ba komai bane illa bada kaina da nayi wa mutumin da ya zame jigo na shiga k'uncina A DUNIYAR MU har yayi illa wa rayuwata da na 'yan uwana...  Shareefah da ace nasan Alh Kabeer shine sanadiyar k'onewar gidan gonar Daddy wllhi da ban kasance dashi ba,  da ace nasan shine silan komai da ban aminta dashi ba... Amma na sab'a hud'ubar iyaye na,  na yaye daraja da kima da Allah yayi min a matsayina na d'iya mace nayi watsi dashi....  Shareefah duk ba wannan ba... Wllhi bansan makomar rayuwata ba a halin da ake ciki.. Na tabbata duk abubuwan da suka sameni zasu kasance ishara wa masu kwad'ayi irin nawa....  Bana fata d'iyata ta taso ta tadda mummunar labari na...."  Kuka ya hanata ci gaba da magana... 


Shareefah dake faman hawaye cikin sayin jiki ta rungumo Jamila murya na rawa take fad'in "Ki daina fad'in haka Jamila,  mu duka 'yan adam ne kuma masu kure,  babu wanda baya kuskure A DUNIYAR MU wannan halitta ce ta d'an Adam,  babu wanda yake d'ari bisa d'ari,  sannan mahaliccin mu mai yawan gafara ne mai jin k'ai,  tun daga wannan lokacin da kika fahimci laifinki kikayi kyakkyawan tuba ya yafe ki,  sannan Falaq bazata girma ta tadda wani b'atanci daga mahaifiyarta ba insha Allah,  sabida Allah da zuciya yake aiki yaga tubanki tuntuni... Jamila don Allah ki daina saka kanki cikin damuwa kada ki haifar wa kanki wani ciwon,  maza tashi muje parlor kar su Mamy su jimu shiru,  Affan ya sayo gizzards  a Haisan,  na rabaki akwai dad'i sosai,  tashi muje kafin ya cinye don nasan sa da son gizzard..."  Ta k'arashe tana mik'ewa tsaye had'i da janyo hannun Jamilar... 


Jamila dai murmushi kawai ta d'anyi kafin ta shiga bin bayan Shareefah tana tuna lokutan baya yanda tsangwama da hantarar dake tsakanin su, Allah sarki Duniya kenan makaranta mai bada lekca iri daban daban, mai nitsa tantiri mai wargaza nitsattse... Allah kasa mu dace ameen....

Murmushi ta sakar masa kafin tace "I love you too My Roy..." 

Kallonta Naseer keyi cikeda mamaki yanda take furta kalmomin gwanin dad'i... 

Soyayya suke kan nunawa juna wajen breakfast d'inma kafin daga bisani wayar Naseer ta soma ruri.. Lambar Fawaz da ya gani ne ya sanya k'irjinsa ya d'an buga kad'an don a tunanin sa an samu labarin Innah ce.. Yana d'agawa yaji muryar Fawaz cikin matsanancin tashin hankali

Saurin mik'ewa Naseer yayi yana satan kallon Salma data bada hankali ma tashan Namun daji da suka kamo wato National Geographic Wild... 

D'aki Naseer ya shige yana mai ci gaba da amsa kiran,  banda bugawa babu abinda k'irjinsa ke masa,  kasa furta komai ma Fawaz yayi sai k'arasawa closet da yayi ya suri jallabiyar sa ruwan Madara ya zura kafin ya nufo parlor yanda Salma take,  

Haka kurum yanayinsa da ta gani ya sanya gabanta mugun fad'uwa...

K'ok'arin saita kansa yayi had'i da rik'o hannunta suka zauna saman kujera...  Lokaci guda yake mata nasiha gameda duniya da kuma tawakkali da duk wani hukuncin da Mahaliccin ka ya k'addara zai sameka...  Saida yayi mata nasiha sosai ya kwantar mata da hankali kana yaci gaba da fad'in "Salma ina so ki nustu kuma kimin alk'awari bazaki d'aga hankalin ki ba...."

A hankali ta jinjina masa kai kana tace "Insha Allah bazan d'aga ba Soja...."

Jinjina kai Naseer yayi kana yace "Jamila ce take asibiti bata da lafiya tana nan asibitin koyarwa,  tun daren jiya suke asibiti saidai basu sanar damu ba gudun kada hankali ya tashi... Amma da sauk'i don yanzu Fawaz ya min waya yana can...."

Duk juriyarta ganin batayi kuka ba saida taji hawaye na ciko idanunta,  duk yanda taji mai jinya yanzu tsoro take ji, musamman wani nata tunda ta rasa mahaifanta...  A hankali ta soma jinjina kai ba tareda ta d'ago idanun ba take fad'in "Soja ka kaini pls,  ka kaini naga Addah don Allah...."  Ta k'arashe cikin tsananin rawar murya... 

Rungumota Naseer yayi cikin jikinsa yana lallashi kana yace "Zan kaiki Salma amma sai kin kwantar da hankalin ki,  idan kikaje wajenta haka zaki kuma d'aga mata hankali ne,  kuma mai ciwo irin nata basa son tashin hankali kinji koh..."

Kallonsa Salma tayi hawaye na bin k'uncinta kana tace "Soja wani ciwo ne ke damun Addah? "

Saida ya d'an yi jim,  kafin ya shafi goshinsa ya d'ago had'i da rik'o hannayenta kana yace " She's surfing from Cardiovascular disease,.."

Girgiza kai Salma take tana dubansa kana tace "Soja wllhi ban gane ba,  hasalima ban tab'a jin irin sunan ciwon da ka ambata ba...  Me hakan yake nufi...."

Naseer ya kuma rik'ota tausayin ta na ratsa zuciyarsa kana yace "Ciwon zuciya...."

Bursting Salma tayi cikin kuka tana fad'in "A'a ba Addah Jamila ta ba k'ila dai bakaji da kyau ba... Don Allah kace min ba ita bace...."  Gaba d'aya she's going out of control... 

Sosai Naseer ya rungumeta yana kwantar mata da hankali ta hanyar lallashi had'i da nuna mata illan tada hankalin ga lafiyar 'yar uwarta...  Saida ya tabbata ta sami nutsuwa kafin suka mik'e suka nufi asibitin...

***

Suna isa suka tarar su Momy ma isowarsu kenan,  Momy da Aunty Saudat Lubna kuma ta tafi exams... 

Cikin sauri Momy ta k'arasa ta rungume Salma wacce tun daga hangosu kuka ke k'ok'arin kufce mata,  kai tsaye Amenity ward suka nufa gaba d'aya...  Sister Nafisa ce ta hangesu idanunta gaba d'aya itama sun kod'e sabida kuka, tana rungume da Falaq a hannunta,  cikin sauri ta k'arasa tana directing nasu d'akin da Jamila take.... 

Fawaz dake can gefen d'akin yana hangosu ya fice cikin sauri daga ward d'in hawaye shar-shar a idanunsa. ...

Aunty Saudat tabi d'an nata da kallo cikeda tausayin sa,  itama sai taji hawaye na neman ciko idanunta,  zuciyarta na neman karyewa.... 

***

Ilham suka hanga zaune gefen Jamilar hannayen su rik'e cikin na juna,  ga na'uran taimaka ma numfashi manne a hancin Jamilar,  idanunta a lumshe alamun batama san mai ke wakana ba... 

Shareefah da Mamy harma da Affan suna rakub'e gefe abin tausayi.... Sosai hankulansu ya tashi musamman Shareefah wacce suka sha fira da Jamilar a daren jiya,  ikon Allah kenan, cikin k'ank'anin lokaci sai ya maidaka ba komai ba,  amma d'an Adam baya hankalta.... 

K'arasawa Salma tayi jikin gadon Jamilar,  had'i da kamo hannayen Jamila da Ilham,  Ilham tanajin hannu saman nata tasan cewa 'yar uwarsu Salma ce ta iso... 

Murya na rawa Ilham take fad'in "Addah Salma,  kice min Addah Jamila zata tashi,  don Allah kice min bazata tafi ta barmu kaman yanda Baffah da Innoh suka tafi suka barmu ba..."  Salma dake k'ok'arin rik'e kukanta sam bataso ta ta kuma tada wa k'anwarta hankali,  dole tayi k'ok'arin saita kanta kafin ta rungume Ilham murya na rawa take fad'in "Ilham ki kwantar da hankalin ki Addah zata sami lafiya kinji koh... Mu ci gaba da mata addu'a.. Zata warke da yardar Allah..."  Ta k'arashe cikin tsananin rawar murya had'i da lumshe idanu tuni hawaye sun gangaro saman kumatun ta...  

Gaba d'aya mutanen dake cikin d'akin tausayi da tsoron duniya ya cika zukatansu...  Mamy kam hawaye ne taji suna zarya a fuskarta,  don ba kowa ya fad'o zuciyarta ba illa Azeema...  Cikin sauri Mamy ta fice daga d'akin don sosai taji kuka na zuwa mata...  

Alh Ali Safwan ne da  wasu likitoci guda biyu suka shigo bayan sun gama tattaunawa... Nan likitocin suka buk'aci a d'an basu waje su duba maras lafiyar...  

Salma da Ilham a tare suka fice suna rungume da juna abin tausayi...  

Affan da Naseer ma suka fice a tare don sai lokacin suka sami zarafin magana ma juna.   

Shareefah ce keta faman kwantar wasu Salma da hankali yayinda Momy ke tareda Mamy itama baki take kan faman bata... 

Aunty Saudat kuwa can bayan ward d'in yanda ta hangi Fawaz saman wasu kujeru ta nufa don basa baki,  gaba d'aya Fawaz ya fice a hayyacin sa... 

Baisan sanda ya rungume mahaifiyarsa yana kuka sosai ba... 

"Mum I love her.. I still do love her.... Mum don Allah kice Jamila zata tashi...."  Kasa ci gaba da magana yayi sabida kukan da yaci k'arfin sa... 

Sosai Aunty Saudat ta rungumesa tana shafan sumarsa take fad'in "Fawaz addu'a zaka mata ba kuka ba...  Jamila tanada rai ka daina kuka tamkar wacce ta Mace babu dawowa...  Kayita karanto mata addu'o'i kaji koh...."

Bai iya amsata ba sai jinjina mata kai da ya shiga yi tamkar k'aramin yaro.... 

Su Sadiya dasu Zainab k'awayen Nafisa dake kewaye da ita gaba d'aya tausayin Nafisa ya cika masu zukata,  musamman idan suka kalli yanda take rungume da Falaq,  duk tsiyan da suke mata sarkin tausayi sarkin imani yau sai jikkunansu yayi sanyi gaba d'aya,  sai faman bata baki suke suna fad'in k'awarta Jamila zata sami lafiya da izinin Allah...  Tabbas ba daidaiton shekaru bane k'awance idan hankali da tunani yazo dai-dai ne ake abota,  don kuwa Jamila ta grime ma Nafisa, Nafisa saidai tayi sa'a da k'anwarta Salma,  domin kuwa d'aliba ce a kwalegin d'alibai dake cikin asibitin na horas da malam jinya.... 

***

Suna zazzaune a reception suna jiran fitowar likitocin kowa da irin addu'ar dake bakinsa nan suka hangi Dr guda ya fito ya nufosu... 

A tare suka mik'e gaba d'aya suka nufi likitan...

Dr ya shiga kwantar masu da hankali yana fad'in ta farfad'o kafin ya buk'aci Salma da Ilham su shiga su gana da 'yar uwarsu kaman yanda ta buk'ata... Aiko kaman jira suke cikin sauri suka nufi d'akin,  Salma na rik'eda Ilham.... 

Jamila tana hangosu ta saki murmushi,  fuskarta tayi fayau sosai alamun mai jinya,  hasken fatarta da dogon hancinta ya kuma fitowa,  kyaunta ya kuma bayyana sosai yau d'in dama duk tafi su kyau.

Murmushi suke suna goge hawayen idanunsa sanda suka isa gareta,  bud'e masu hannaye Jamila tayi cikin murya irinta marassa lafiya tace "Kuzo nan..."

Babu musu suka isa suka rungume Addarsu Jamila... 

Ilham fad'i take "Addah nasan zaki tashi....  Nasan bazaki tafi ki barmu ba...."

Murmushi Jamila tayi tana shafan fuskar Ilham kana tace "Ina sonki,  ina sonku gaba d'aya....  Allah yayi maku albarka,  ko yau na bar Duniyar Mu  nasan 'yan uwana suna hannaye masu kyau...." Ta maida dubanta ga Salma kafin taci gaba da fad'in "Salma nasan nayi abubuwa da dama marassa kyau a baya,  amma tuni na fahimci kure na kuma na gyara,  keda Ilham da kuma Falaq ina k'aunarku,  kuma ina fata na had'u daku a rayuwar da zamuyi gaba...  Salma ki rik'e 'yan uwanki ki kuma rik'e hud'ubar dasu Baffah suka mana....  Kar kuyi watsi da wasilcin Baffah da Innoh domin kuwa iyaye jigo ne na rayuwar d'an Adam....  Sannan nima irin wasiyar da zan maku kenan,  ko kusa kada ku bari k'yale-k'yale na duniya ya rud'eku har ya kaiku ga sab'a wa mahaliccin ku...." Tari ya hanata ci gaba da magana.....

Daga Ilham har Salma kuka suke babu ko k'kk'autawa...  Ilahm kam ta kasa fad'in komai sai kuka... 

Salma cikin shesshek'a take fad'in "Addah don Allah ki daina mana irin maganganun da Innoh ta mana,  Addah nasan zaki sami lafiya,  zakiji sauk'i cikin yardar Allah.. Don Allah ki daina karyar mana da zukata don Allah....."  Kuka yaci k'arfinta itama... 

Rungume juna sukayi gaba d'aya su duka ukun suna kuka sosai mai ban tausayi...  A haka likita ya shigo ya samesu kafin ya buk'aci su Momy su fitar dasu... 

Kallon likitan kawai Jamila take tana murmushi sanda d'akin ya rage saura ita da likitan kana tace "Dr babu abinda zaka iya min a yau,  ina ganin abinda kai baka gani....  Don Allah ka k'yaleni nayi sallama da 'yan uwana...."

Jikin Dr yayi sanyi sosai don shi kansa yasan Jamila tana jin jiki yamaji mamaki da har take iya magana,  idan kuwa da gaske ban kwanan take lallai Allah ya bata daman da bama kowa yake badawa ba.... 

Muryarta ne ya katse ma Dr tunanin sa.. 

"Dr ka taimaka ka kira min Dr Fawaz Santana da kuma Sister Nafisa Arabi.."

A hankali Dr ya jinjina kai kafin yayi yanda tace... 


Nafisa ce ta soma shigowa tana rungume da Falaq, hango Jamila da tayi kwance saman gadon marassa lafiya sai ya kuma karyar mata da zuciya... 

Tunda Jamila ta hangi Falaq take murmushi har suka k'araso gareta,  da k'yar Nafisa ta zauna gefen Jamila ba tareda ta bari sun had'a idanu ba sabida hawaye ne tab cikin idanun nata... 

Hannu Jamila ta mik'a ta d'an kamo hannun Falaq da tunda suka shigo take faman mata murmushi tana tsalle alamun taga mahaifiyarta... 

Jamila ta shafi fuskar Falaq fusaknta cikeda da murmushi kana tace "Allah maki albarka masoyiya ta....  Naso na rayu dake A DUNIYAR MU na baki duk wani kulawa da kika rasa daga wajen mahaifin ki amma Allah bai k'addara hakan ba....  Ki sani Allah baya barin wani don wani, Al'amarin sa _Kun fa yakun_ ne,  ina sonki Falaq ina k'aunarki da duka zuciyata,  ina rok'on mahalicci na ya rayaki cikin aminci da tsoronsa... Allah yayi maki albarka...."  Tana kaiwa aya taji Nafisa ta fashe da wani irin kuka,  kukan da take kan faman dannewa...  A dai-dai lokacin kuma Fawaz ya turo k'ofar d'akin ya shigo,  Idanunsa shima a jik'e suke sharkaf....  Tamkar wanda ruwa ya shanye haka yake takawa har ya isa jikin gadon da Jamila take.... 

Cikin muryar kuka yake fad'in "Why?  Why Jamila,  meyasa kika saka ma ranki damuwa bayan baki d'auke da wata cutar HIV,   meyasa kika saka ma kanki ciwon zuciya,  meyasa ki kasa sanar da kowa halin da kike ciki... Meyasa kika zab'i mutuwarki sama da rayuwarki... Jamila why...?"

Murmushi take tana duban Fawaz  kafin tace "Fawaz ka sani ko d'aya ban zab'a ma kaina mutuwa ba,  ka sani idan numfashin bawa ya k'are second guda mala'ikan d'aukan rai baya k'ara masa....  Fawaz wannan shine K'ADDARA TA (littafin Hauwa Usman Hauwata)  A DUNIYAR MU,  Fawaz ina sonka sannan naso na rayu dakai A DUNIYAR MU amma Allah bai k'addara hakan ba... Ina fata in the next life mu kasance tare,  rayuwar da babu k'arshe,  rayuwar da take permanent ba temporary ba.....  Fawaz don Allah ka rik'e amanar da zan bar maka...."   Ta maido da dubanta ga Nafisa da Falaq yayinda kukan Nafisa da Fawaz ya k'aru sosai har baka jiyo sautin kukan sai zuban hawaye... 

Jamila taci gaba da fad'in "Fawaz ka rik'e min Falaq amana,  ka nisanta ta daga wannan wajen mai tarin munanan histories.... Kaida Nafisa nasan zaku iya zaku iya rik'e min amanar d'iyata kuyi nesa da ita daga nan....  Fawaz Nafisa don Allah kuyimin alk'awarin kasancewa k'ark'ashin inuwa guda,  kuyi min alk'awarin rik'e min tilon d'iyata amana...."


Fawaz ne ya katse ta cikin kuka.. Fad'i yake..  "Jay pls stop...  Stop saying all those things, Jamila zamu kasance tare A DUNIYAR MU...  Zan tambaya mana malamai muddin babu aya ko hadisi ko maganganun magabata da zai haramta aurenmu Jamila zan aureki,  wllhi zan aureki...... Zamu kasance tare A DUNIYAR MU Jamila don Allah don't leave me... I love you... So much..."  Kuka yaci k'arfin Fawaz.. 


izuwa lokacin Jamilar ma kukan take,  su duka uku kukan suke wanda tuni Falaq ma ta soma kukan kaman tasan abinda ke faruwa.... 

Cikin kuka Jamila take fad'in "Zan mutu da soyayyarka Fawaz,  ka sani ko bayan raina Jamila tana k'aunarka,  kuma zaka taddata a rayuwa na gaba cikin yardar Allah....  Nafisa na gode nasan nayi katsalanda ma rayuwarki da yawa,  but pls do this for me, for my only daughter pls Nafisa....."  Ta kasa ci gaba da magana sai tari da take babu ko k'akk'autawa....  Nafisa da Fawaz kuwa sai kuka.. 


Tuni jini ya soma kwararowa daga bakin Jamila,  a d'ari Fawaz ya fice tamkar zaucecce yana kiran sauran likitocin wanda yasa hankulan mutanen dake wajen kuma tashi....  Kan kace me Nafisa ma ta soma nata iya k'ok'arin

Saidai kafin likitocin su iso tarin ya lafa mata sai salati da take karantowa a hankali,  shigowan likitocin tareda Fawaz a dai-dai lokacin ta rufe bakinta da kalimatusshahada.... 


Durk'usawa Fawaz yayi a wajen saman gwiwoyinsa yana hango idanunta yanda suka kafe suna kallon sama... Ya nemi kukan da yakeyi ya rasa.... 

Dai-dai lokacin wani nurse da police officer suka shigo da Alh Kabeer saman keken guragu da shike yana cikin asibitin ba'a sallame sa ba,  tunda yaji an kawo Jamila babu lafiya yake rok'on a kawosa wajenta ya nemi gafarar ta... 

Juyowan da Fawaz zaiyi suka had'a idanu da mahaifinsa...  Wani irin tsalle yayi ya shak'e mahaifin nasa yana fad'in "This is all your Fault,  I swear I'll kill you,  wllhi kaima sai na kashe ka yau...."

Police d'in ne keta k'ok'arin k'watan Alh Kabeer daga hannun Fawaz don tuni ya soma zaro idanu waje....  Saida Naseer ya shigo ya janye Fawaz kafin aka samu Fawaz ya saki wuyan mahaifinsa.. 


Sosai Fawaz yake kuka yana duban Naseer yake fad'in "Uncle this man's nothing but a disaster, he's nothing but a curse.... Uncle please......"  Kasa ci gaba da magana yayi sai durk'ushewa a wajen da yayi yana kuka mai tsuma zuciya... 

Su Salma da Momy ta d'an fice dasu daga ward d'in suna hango Nafisa ta fito cikin kuka suka mik'e tsaye cikin tsananin tashin hankali.....
